notes.title: A Truly Terrifying World of Tanks Blitz Update
notes.content: [p]October is set to unleash all sorts of horrors into the night. Nameless terrors that lurk in the depths of the fog, with only mysterious sounds to be heard emanating from the darkness. Sound scary? Well, the scariest is yet to come![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="W_rDJumqxGM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Infected Front Mode[/h2][p][/p][p]A new mode sees two powers clash: 10 brave Survivalists against 4 Undead warriors.[/p][list][*][p]The Survivalists' goal is to capture a base at any cost. They must be exceptionally cautious—fallen fighters will respawn and join the ranks of the infected as enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]The goal of the Undead is to wipe out the living. They lack thick armor, but their beefed-up speed more than makes up for this. Not to mention their immortality... Think you took one down? No... Infected tanks respawn almost immediately and return to the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fear is not a word that's in the Survivalists' lexicon. Tenacity in the face of overwhelming odds only releases their hidden power. The fewer they are, the stronger they become: HP and damage increase, reload time decreases.[/p][p] [/p][p]Will the Survivalists stand firm? Or will the Undead infect them all? Rush into battle on October 9 to find out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b17edc5d1d9c087f7474ddf2d8342ebba13b6585.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Damage Indicator[/h2][p][/p][p]Enjoy full control over every battle! The battle interface has been updated with a dynamic damage indicator showing three key values in real time: Damage Dealt, Assisted Damage, and Damage Blocked.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can switch it on or off in the Settings anytime.[/p][p][/p][h2]Horrorstadt Will Make You Shudder! [/h2][p][/p][p]An evil night descends on Alpenstadt. Evil forces lurk in the darkness... Don't let their silent presence scare you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0855716a073871a9b5332b496cdb9b517245f79b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Terrifying Garage[/h2][p][/p][p]In late October, the Garage will transform and take on sinister colors. Occasionally, the walls glow with terrifying hues as mystical symbols appear. Overhead, the cold moon watches you from the dark skies. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ab6a388dcaaf635ad74e38860abc3403225096af.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz is getting a fresh update!
notes.content: [h2]Polish TDs[/h2][p][/p][p]Strong frontal armor, high firepower, and decent mobility—check out the all-new branch of Polish tank destroyers! Here's the line up: SDP 40 Zadymka, SDP 44 Burza, SDP 57 Gowika, SDP 58 Kilana, SDP 60 Gonkiewicza, and dangerous as lightning—NC 70 Błyskawica! They all handle themselves confidently on the frontline and don't shy away from prolonged firefights.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="s4tEIM2dE4Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Starting from Tier VIII, these vehicles may surprise you with new firing mechanics: the closer you get to the enemy, the more damage you'll deal! The full potential of these TDs becomes apparent at close range, so don't linger in the bushes—rush into the epicenter of battle with your allies![/p][p][/p][h2]Swedish Voiceover[/h2][p][/p][p]The crews of Swedish vehicles will speak their native language! To hear it, enable the "National Crew Voice" option (Settings → Other) and head into battle in Swedish tanks. Let's roll! Or rather— "utgå!"[/p][p][/p][h2]Ready for Some Action?[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Path of Legends: August 28 – September 24[/b][/p][p]Watch a special video about our WoT Blitz adventures, pick up a gift, and complete a quest![/p][p] [/p][p][b]"One of Three" Event: August 28 – September 30[/b][/p][p]Collect Pins via different activities to swap for one of three tanks of your choice: FV201 (A45), Škoda T 27, or Kpz. Pr.68 (P).[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Boosters for Victories: August 28 – September 5[/b][/p][p]Play European tanks and receive a Cooldown booster for every victory![/p][p] [/p][p][b]"Objective: Sheridan Missile" Event: September 12–21[/b][/p][p] Show an unearthly level of skill, earn Missiles for your victories and take the legendary Sheridan Missile — a special Collector tank with missiles![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Blacksmith Forge Event: September 19–28[/b][/p][p]Collect Iron Mugs to exchange for resources, containers, and powerful tanks like the unique LKpz.70 K![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Blitz Diamond Cup Final[/b][/p][p]Watch September's official streams covering the most important battles of the tournament and get rewards for being a viewer! All dates and details will be shared in upcoming news articles.[/p]

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz Birthday Update
notes.content:
[h1]Birthday Activities[/h1]
Blitz hits another milestone this June, and the party is bigger than ever: unique activities and a heap of gifts await! Thanks for all of your ideas in the comments—some of the best made it into this update!

[previewyoutube=1akw6RD_FsM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Seniority Award[/h3]
Log in from June 5 through July 6 to claim your festive container. The older your account, the bigger the loot inside!

[h3]Tanks From the Tutorial[/h3]
The Type 58, Tiger I, T-34-85, and Sherman Easy 8 are the very first tanks every new player meets in Blitz. We’ve given them a fresh touch and hidden them across various activities. Play this summer to grab them for free! The first one will be available via subscription from June 16 through 23. Don't miss it!

[h3]Blitz Fest Event[/h3]
Get ready for something totally fresh! You’ll have several paths to choose from, each packed with rewards. From June 20 through July 4, explore the paths and earn rewards—including the brand-new Tiger-Maus! Complete any path to get the Bisonte C45 for free!

[h3]Tank as a Gift[/h3]
Log in from June 26 through July 13 to get your hands on the Turbo Collector tank with the Firestorm Legendary camo. Festive customization included!

[h1]Maps[/h1]
You asked—we delivered! For Blitz’s birthday, we’re bringing back some beloved maps:  Lost Temple, Mirage, and Malinovka! Old favorites return, unchanged and unforgettable—just the way we loved them back then ❤️‍🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1c986b45fb2f63422f02b1ad9222649925744ef4.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Minimap Design[/h1]
In battle, quick situational awareness is key—even experienced tankers rely on the Minimap. We’ve updated its design to make it more realistic and easier to read in the heat of battle.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
We've rebalanced 12 Tier VIII–IX vehicles based on your feedback. Some got stronger armor; others now reload faster. [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/vehicle-changes-june-2025/]Find all the details on our website.[/url]

notes.title: Operation Interference in World of Tanks Blitz
notes.content:
The designers were in such a rush to send their new creation into battle, the paint hadn’t even dried yet! Notes, schematics, and circuit board traces remain on the armor—every inch infused with the spirit of engineering genius!

Take on the new Operation, step behind the scenes of the design bureau, and collect avatars, resources, and the Transceiver Legendary camouflage for the AMX 50 100!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/aadf790cc75db16db0db86f902e5ca2c524cad69.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]How Do I Get the Rewards?[/h2]

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate.
 
The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—that means everyone! The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive the rewards, increase your Pass level by completing the Operation missions.
 
The Pass level increases automatically, but you'll need to collect your rewards manually.

[h2]What Are the Rewards?[/h2]

Tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Auction: Falling Prices!
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen!
Let the auction begin—for the first time ever, it's happening right in the game!

This is your chance to expand your collection with rare vehicles at great prices. Don’t miss out—head to the event screen and claim your dream tanks before they are sold out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f005e84aaebc9192a714eeeb084fe7ff1c040af.jpg[/img]

[h2]How Does the Auction Work?[/h2]

The auction takes place right in the Garage from March 14 through April 17. You can purchase rare Collector and Premium tanks here.

[quote]Bidding takes place according to Dutch auction rules: prices decrease, but the number of lots is limited. That means... you snooze, you lose![/quote]
New lots open daily. Every 8 hours, the price drops, and after 24 hours, any unsold tanks are removed from the auction to make room for new ones.

[h2]When Does the Auction Takes Place?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Europe: March 14, 13:00 (CET) to April 17, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: March 14, 11:00 (PT) / 14:00 (ET) to April 17, 11:00 (PT) / 14:00 (ET)
[*] APAC: March 14, 15:00 (UTC+8) to April 17, 15:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]

notes.title: Operation Cardboard Dioxide in WoT Blitz
notes.content:
The science of packaging is the finest of all sciences out there. Just one small mistake and.... whoops! Argh, we've dropped a particle converter on a tank, a pile of boxes, and a roll of duct tape—but is it that bad, really?! Relax, it seems like we've accidentally invented the Catboard camo! Take my word for it, this warpaint won't let you down in battle. Just try it!

Join the new Operation and grab avatars, resources, and that very same Catboard Legendary camo for the Tiger II!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/050d0e168b7a40d94285f2fd6383019f2adc8cca.jpg[/img]

[h2]How to Get Rewards[/h2]

You'll need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate.

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each consisting of 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all regular Pass holders—that means everyone! The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To earn rewards, you'll need to increase your Pass level by completing the Operation missions.

Although your Pass Level will increase automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually.

[h2]What Are the Rewards?[/h2]

There will be tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: The Clandestine Lab Event in World of Tanks Blitz!
notes.content:
This lab is top secret for a reason—it’s working on producing an experimental Reagent. This special mix unlocks containers, a unique profile background, and tanks, including the BZ-74-1, a new Tier IX tank!

[previewyoutube=sISj-3-tGjM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How Does the Production Work?[/h2]

It's powered by the resources you collect! Premium Account, Free XP, gold, credits, boosters—you name it! They all go into making Reagent, your means to securing some pretty cool rewards.

Speaking of rewards, make sure to open those Deluxe Limited Edition Containers more often—you're guaranteed to find Cards inside. They’ll help you claim the new BZ-74-1! There's a chance you'll find one in a special container, or you can just get it directly. The choice is yours.

[h2]Clandestine Lab Opening Hours[/h2]
[list]
[*] Europe: February 21, 13:00 (CET) to March 2, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: February 21, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET) to March 2, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET)
[*] APAC: February 21, 14:00 (UTC+8) to March 2, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]

notes.title: Afterparty Event
notes.content:
That was an epic party! I think... I don't remember much, though. I think we danced till we dropped and ended up knocking a disco ball onto the head of the research department. And, hehe, we somehow tossed the Trinket Keys to the container with the magnificent Waffen F1.0—and all our Locker ID cards—somewhere in the Wasteland! Wait, what?! A whole bunch of rewards are being stored in those, including resources, camouflage, powerful vehicles, and so much more! Alright, alright, don't panic... Grab the Metal Detectors and Hammers, and search for the ID Cards and Trinket Keys. We'll get to the rewards one way or another!

[previewyoutube=0r0Gzx8OORI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Vortex of Souls Event
notes.content:
When the ghostly moon shines its dim light on a world frozen in terror, the spawn of darkness awaken from their slumber. The most terrifying of them is the Souleater, which ensnares the souls of heroes and imprisons them in Lanterns used for witchcraft rituals. Is there any hope? Yes! How can we rid the world of this evil? By fighting!

[previewyoutube=fqvGPcgGaws;full][/previewyoutube]

Farm Lanterns in battle to set heroes' souls free and summon the fearless Lightbringer. Defeat the Souleater, and you'll be remembered forever for your deeds. You'll also get a heap of rewards!

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

60 levels stretching into infinity await you with countless rewards!

Among them is the new Tier VII heavy Lightbringer, the Wyvern Scalemail camouflage, collectible items, a profile background, and Wicked Souls Containers that may drop the powerful Souleater.

notes.title: Season 5: Legends Update
notes.content:
[h2]Season 5: Legends[/h2]
Embark on a search for legends alongside outstanding explorers! Three months of unforgettable adventures await with cool rewards for the taking—Power Cells are among them! Use them to restore unique tanks and touch true legends!

[previewyoutube=Mdp5tdAKzRk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]French Medium Tanks[/h2] 
Four agile French vehicles are available to research! High speed and a two-shell magazine are among the strengths of this branch. A perfect combo for scouts!

And the powerful Projet Murat is on top. It takes this Tier X tank less than 3 seconds to deal 740 damage! Avoid enemy return fire by maneuvering and changing position in a flash. Once the magazine has reloaded—attack!

[h2]10 vs. 10 Mode[/h2]
Looking to ramp up the action? Head this way! The rules are simple: clear the map of 10 enemy tanks to lead your team to victory. Develop new battle strategies and deal even more damage to have ultimate fun!

[h2]Crew Mastery[/h2]
An experienced crew is the key to success in battle! That's why all tanks are going to come with 100% trained crew right after purchase! You won't have to spend credits and gold on crew training, and upgrading skills has become easier as well.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2] 
This update ushers in new ways of playing for Tier X tanks. The main purpose of this round of rebalancing is to brush up the gameplay of familiar vehicles and beef up the advantages of less popular war machines.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-season-5/]More Details[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: A-Typical Event in WoT Blitz!
notes.content:
Are you ready for something absolutely aTYPical? From September 3 through September 24, collect Coins both for participating in battles and for winning them! Coins are a special currency that can be exchanged for valuable rewards. Battle in different types of vehicles to make the most of them! 

[previewyoutube=Fol_5ZAiVe4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

Battle in various Tier V–X vehicles to receive 3 types of Coins:
[list]
[*] HT Coins—for playing in heavy tanks.
[*] L/MT Coins—for playing in light and medium tanks.
[*] TD Coins—for playing in tank destroyers.
[/list]
You'll get 1 Coin just for participating in a battle. But if you score a victory, you'll get 3 Coins for playing in V–VII vehicles and 5 Coins for playing VIII–X vehicles. 

Exchange them for rewards, among which you'll find warpaints, containers with Tier V–VIII Premium vehicles, and the mighty Škoda T 56 heavy tank!

notes.title: Season 1 Tanks Are Returning!
notes.content:
Progresston isn't just a utopian city where science and technology flourish. You might remember it as the setting of Season 1, where many tried and couldn't manage to claim and upgrade all the available tanks... But don't worry! It's time to wipe those bad memories away, because Retrotopia tanks are making a comeback!

[h2]Are the Season 1 tanks available again?[/h2]

Oh, yes they are! You can find them in the in-game Store until October 1. Grab Magnate, Fixer, and Regressor separately or together in one bundle. We've even added enough Kitcoins to help you pump up all the missing modules. Claim the tanks from Season 1: Retrotopia, upgrade them to perfection, and roll out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c5a7a73b1c83307db158f332ded8c48f83fd3efe.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: Grab Magnate, Fixer, and Regressor separately or together in one bundle.

notes.title: Flea Market Event
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=raDyXrBNrwg;full][/previewyoutube]
There's food for every kind of fish in this pond! The small ones and the big ones. What's that pond, you might ask? Yeah, not the best comparison when we're actually in a desert. Imagine a treasure island then! Oops, that's kinda about water too... It's really a VAST land of wonders where everyone can find their treasure: resources, camouflage, daring vehicles, and more! And you can always expect to get some free stuff, too!

[h2]How Can I Get What's Mine?[/h2]

Well, you'll need to grab Can-Openers. Get them in the Store! Use them to open Metal Barrels that can drop containers, vehicles, Legendary camos, certificates for x5 XP, Free XP, a unique avatar, and the Rammer, a new Tier VII tank.

[h2]What Free Stuff?[/h2]

We just wanted to share some little treats with our dear customers... Visit the Store to claim yours! It'll equip you with everything you need for your journey across the land of wonders, including a Can-Opener. We're at your service!

[h2]When Is the Flea Market Open?[/h2]

notes.title: Operation Into the Unknown
notes.content:
Space, the final frontier...

Stardate 2266.183. The U.S.S. Enterprise has discovered an odd-looking pyramid on an unexplored Class M planet. However, after landing on the planet's surface, the away team quickly determines that the pyramid is not what it seems! In fact, it's just a small part of an enormous starship that has moved almost entirely underground over the past centuries. This cube-shaped starship belongs to the mysterious Borg Collective. And they're not very happy to see unexpected guests!

[previewyoutube=-6D_HGZ9_MA;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the Operation Into the Unknown, find a way out of this hopeless situation, and earn piles of resources, warpaints, avatars, and the Borg Drone Legendary camo for the Spähpanzer Ru 251!

[h2]How Can I Get the Rewards?[/h2]

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all players as regular Pass holders. The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive rewards, increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation's missions.

While the Pass Level increases automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually. 

[h2]What Are the Rewards?[/h2]

Tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

tags.feature: - Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: Contraband Event
notes.content:
Welcome! This is a heavenly place, isn't it? Perfect for a birthday celebration in the family circle. It has everything you need: refreshing sea, juicy fruit, and... terrific tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/23f2ff42e8502e50c8131e8ffe0554e11a4d35aa.jpg[/img]

From June 24 through July 4, enjoy some rest and grab the BZ-58-2—a new Chinese tank; loads of containers; a profile background with summer vibes; and more!

[h2]What Do I Need to Do?[/h2]
You'll need Сoupons to get rewards—look for them in special bundles in the Store! Collect Сoupons and exchange them for bonuses on the event's main screen.

[h2]New Heavy Tank BZ-58-2[/h2]
This Tier IX tank has many advantages, but if we were to name the main ones, it would be high damage per minute, an armored turret, and good mobility. And we haven't even got started about its comfortable turret traverse! Hide vulnerable parts of the hull and use high elevation angles to fire at your enemies with confidence! Fantastic, right?

Join the Contraband event—it's YOU we've been waiting for!

tags.feature: From June 24 through July 4, enjoy some rest and grab the BZ-58-2—a new Chinese tank; loads of containers; a profile background with summer vibes; and more!

notes.title: Rewind Event
notes.content:
Birthdays often make us all super nostalgic—your first victory, first Ace Tanker badge, first Tier X tank in your Garage... But get stuck in old memories? We have the perfect opportunity to create new ones, save Snapshots with the brightest of them, and exchange them for rewards, of course! Say "cheese!"—we're getting started!

[previewyoutube=x7iyV-Mf3A0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How Can I Get the Rewards?[/h2]

Complete missions in Tier IV–X vehicles to earn Snapshots. You'll get 100 Snapshots for each regular combat mission and 200 Snapshots for each special combat mission. Every 1,000 Snapshots unlocks a new event level and special reward!

The rewards include Snapshot Boosters, which are installed automatically and will earn you 500 Snapshots per battle, regardless of the outcome! 

Use Snapshots to complete event stages and receive awesome rewards, including the K-2—our new Tier VIII heavy tank!

[h2]When Is the Rewind Event Happening?[/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Season 4: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[h2]Season 4: Anniversary[/h2]

This time, it's more than just a seasonal event with a beautiful story. For three months, we'll be broadcasting a whole spectrum of fun to you! So prepare for the most vibrant and intense summer in the game's history! And remember: if there's a screen, there's Blitz 😉

[previewyoutube=MPA5DJhsGKI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]"What If?..." Tank Progression[/h2]

You'll find a chain of stages with rewards on the Season's main screen. These are three unique Tier VII, VIII, and IX tanks with a myriad of upgrades. Each tank will be assembled in the Garage based on the resources you receive during the campaign.

The E-10, DTH-STR, and KV-JR... Vehicles that look oh-so-familiar, and that's no accident! We've selected players' favorite tanks and imagined how they could perform at another tier.

[h2]Italian Heavy Tanks[/h2]

The Italian vehicle branch just got a boost with four new heavies. These swift sharpshooters are perfect for second-line combat. The Tier VII Carro d'assalto P.88 shines with its standard gun and quick reload. Meanwhile, the Tier VIII Progetto CC55 mod. 54 and Tier IX Progetto C50 mod. 66 feature a two-shell magazine that lets them deal hefty damage in mere seconds.

At the top of the branch is the powerful Rinoceronte equipped with a two-shell gun. Mobile and accurate, with a comfortable gun and armored turret, this heavy can take down enemies in a flash! But be warned: When using your turret armor, keep moving to make it even harder for enemies to hit your vulnerable spots.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-22-05/]More Details[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Operation Cowabunga!
notes.content:
Hey Shredder, why the long face? "Operation Cowabunga!" is nowhere near the crest of the wave that it's set to make!

Hop into your favorite vehicle, and let's chase down the insidious villain together! Awesome rewards await you at every turn—including resources, warpaints, avatars, a bodacious profile background, and the Shredder Legendary camo for the P.44 Pantera. Cowabunga!

[previewyoutube=b_WVwKQJ3zg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How Can I Get the Rewards?[/h2]

You need a Tier III or higher vehicle to participate. 

The Operation includes two reward progression paths, each comprising 60 levels. The first progression path is available to all players as regular Pass holders. The second progression path offers more rewards and is only available to Premium Pass holders. To receive rewards, increase your Pass Level by completing the Operation's missions.

While the Pass Level increases automatically, you'll need to collect your rewards manually. 

[h2]What Are the Rewards?[/h2]

Tons of resources, a Collector tank, themed warpaints and avatars, a profile background, certificates that provide XP bonuses for victories, and a Legendary camo for a researchable Tier VIII vehicle!

notes.title: Season 3: Resistance update
notes.content:
[h2]Season 3: Resistance[/h2]
The main event will take place somewhere in the alpine meadows, and unfold with an epic battle scene. The best commanders of different nations will unite to stop an unknown enemy and determine the fate of humanity.

Resistance will last three months. There are many battles and challenges ahead, during which you'll collect enough Snippets to build three unique tanks!

[previewyoutube=i-jAwn_UgRU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Chinese heavy tanks[/h2]
Four new heavy tanks in the Chinese Tech Tree! Tier VII and VIII tanks are well-armored and strike hard. The Tier IX BZ-68 is just like them, and also boasts impressive speed for a heavy tank. The Tier X BZ-75 has all the advantages of these three, but with an even better armored hull. Besides that, higher-tier tanks are equipped with alternative guns with high single-shot damage and average accuracy.

[h2]New sounds[/h2]
Improved hit sound in both Arcade and Sniper Modes. Ricochet will also get its own sound.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, Tier IX tanks will have balance improvements. They're dedicated to freshening up your gaming experience with 22 vehicles. Some of them received an armor upgrade.

[h2]Camouflage Rotation[/h2]
The Spooky for the Kpz RH, Baba-Yaga for the IS-7, Terrifying for the Chimera, and Wavebreaker for the XM551 Sheridan are now available in the camo selection menu.

notes.title: Winter Fair Event
notes.content:
The northern town warmly welcomes our heroes with a holiday fair! Now is the perfect moment to rest after a long journey, enjoy the atmosphere, and try your chances of winning all kinds of prizes at the attractions! There are Snow Globes standing in straight rows, and Boxes of Presents too! Let the fun begin!

[previewyoutube=KPTvJKHASUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Win in Tier IV–X vehicles! Each victory will earn you 2 Fair Tickets. Use them to complete event stages and receive rewards!

[h2]Rewards[/h2]

Complete all of the event's stages to unlock access to the two main rewards. The first is the Chrysler K. At first glance, a turret shifted to the rear of the hull makes it clear that the vehicle is particularly well-suited for urban map battles. It boasts reliable frontal armor, a sturdy turret that easily deflects shells, a fast-firing gun, and unexpectedly good dynamics for such a steel monster. The crushing power of this colossus is highlighted by the Vanguard attachment.

The second is a Snow Globe. Give it a good shake and grab a powerful Tier VII–X vehicle. And if you're lucky, you might even get the shiny XM66F, a new Tier X!

Boxes of Presents have something for you as well. You can open them as many times as you wish! Pay for the first with Free XP and with gold for the other. You may find a Snow Globe inside!

notes.title: The Witch's Curse Event
notes.content:
In these dark woods, among the shimmering rocks and twisted roots of ancient trees, the witch's curse has woven its powerful web—there's no getting away from it! Fight bravely, complete missions, and collect your rewards!
[previewyoutube=8pnQX3__SAg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]

Among the rewards, you'll find the Forest Witch, a heavy Tier VII tank boasting good armor, an autoreloading system with 4 shells, and the Emergency Track mechanics. 

You can also get resources, collectible items from the witch's arsenal, avatars, themed camouflage, attachments, and a container with mystical tanks!

[h2]How Do I Get Rewards?[/h2]

Complete missions in Tier IV–X vehicles and earn Glyphs. You'll get 100 Glyphs for each regular combat mission, and for the special combat mission for the Dracula, Lycan, Helsing, Pharaoh, Medjay, or Forest Witch, you'll receive 200 Glyphs. Every 1000 Glyphs opens a new event level.

Among the rewards, you'll also find Glyph boosters. They are installed automatically. With this booster installed, each battle will bring you 500 Glyphs regardless of the outcome!

[*] Europe: October 20, 14:00 (CEST) to October 31, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: October 20, 06:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to October 31, 06:00 (PT) / 09:00 (ET)
[*] APAC: October 20, 14:00 (UTC+8) to October 31, 14:00 (UTC+8)

notes.title: Forest Witch Tank
notes.content:
Once a year, under October's full moon, the Folio gains enough strength to create magical weapons. This Forest Witch has become yet another child of the evil book. It is strong, treacherous, and very dangerous.

[previewyoutube=GCWhtHuxbUU;full][/previewyoutube]

[quote]You can get the Forest Witch tank during the Witch's Curse Event that kicks off on October 20.[/quote]

The Forest Witch is a heavy tank. Its looks send shivers down your spine. Just like its 85-mm gun featuring an autoreloading system with 4 shells. Its perfect armor will protect the Forest Witch from enemy shells, witch hunters' rifles, and even a werewolf's fangs.

How many travelers are now lost forever in the forest after an encounter with the witch? This is unknown! But the Forest Witch knows for sure how to escape from danger. Its emergency track is more dependable than any spells or curses!

[h3]Tame the witch and have eternal glory![/h3]

notes.title: Season 2: Constellation Update
notes.content:
Join the adventurers and lead them through the Season—a dangerous and exciting 3-month-long challenge that will bring you rewards. Together you will solve the mystery of the Swamp Monster and collect enough Fortium Shards to build three unique vehicles!

[previewyoutube=_MA90PvURrw;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a large-scale update of the game that includes new vehicles, balance changes, and fresh content. All in-game elements are designed to immerse you in a new story, from the Garage to the camos, the Orders, and the bundles in the Store.

[h2]Polish Medium Tanks[/h2]

Please welcome the newbies in the Tech Tree of the European Nation: six medium tanks flying the Polish colors! Their advantages are speed, dynamics, and great firepower!

[h2]Updated Platoon Interface[/h2]

Now your Garage looks different once you have created a platoon or accepted an invitation to join one. The camera will travel outside to show two tanks: yours and your platoon mate's. The looks of your mate's tank are updated in real-time and show the applied modules, attachment, and camo.

[h2]Updated Quick Commands[/h2]

We are working hard to improve the quick commands wheel to make it more useful and easier to understand in order to enhance coordination in battle. New commands are displayed in your battle chat, in the minimap, and on the battle screen.

The Hold position! command has been replaced with Moving here! Hover the camera's marker over a point on the landscape, or an allied or enemy tank, and press this command to let your allies see the marker on the minimap and the main battle screen. Yes! They will see exactly the hill or building the camera was pointed at!

[h2]Maps[/h2]

This Season's rotation will not include:
• Mayan Ruins
• Winter Malinovka
• Black Goldville
• Fort Despair
• Dead Rail

And these are making their comeback!
• Vineyards
• Dynasty's Pearl
• Copperfield
• Port Bay
• Ghost Factory

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We've changed a lot! We've updated the characteristics of 88 vehicles, which include 61 Tier X tanks. The goal is not only to increase the effectiveness of the tanks which can't boast great stats, but also to revamp the gameplay of the usual vehicles. Some tanks will noticeably strengthen their principal characteristics, while others will change their role in gameplay. 

[h3][url=https://eu.wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/update-season-2/]MORE[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Season 1: Retrotopia
notes.content:
Progresston is a city where technology is revered just as much as beauty. Here, ingenuity and a positive outlook on the future set the tone. If everything works as one perfect mechanism, could anything go wrong?

You'll have three months to enjoy the aesthetics, learn the history of the city, get enough of the local currency, Kitcoins, and upgrade three unrivaled tanks!

[previewyoutube=LHCAPU-9crc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]So, What is a Season?
[/h3]It's a massive event that encompasses all elements of the game, from the Garage to camouflages, and from Orders and Operations to bundles in the Store. This Season brings with it a special mood and retrofuturistic aesthetic that you'll find in the game this summer. 

On the Season's main screen, you'll find a chain of stages with rewards. These are not resources or customizations, but three unique Tier VII, VIII, and IX tanks with lots of improvements. Each excels in battle in its own way, representing a distinct aspect of life in Retrotopia. You will progressively upgrade these tanks using Kitcoins and delve deeper into the history of Progresston.

[url=https://eu.wotblitz.com/en/news/event/season-1-retrotopia/]MORE INFO[/url]

notes.title: Update 9.8
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Se4Ql-gZ1oU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Quick Commands Wheel[/h2]
Quick and smooth teamwork is what it takes to KEEP CALM AND WIN epic victories. It's high time to improve our quick commands. The first step is to update the way they look and how they are sent. Icons have become clearer while the commands are now grouped more logically. These updates have resulted in faster team coordination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/30273907a03bb89ca450f9016b432dd187999304.jpg[/img]
[h3]On touch devices[/h3]
[list]
[*] Place the quick commands wheel button on the screen where it's best for you.
[*] Tap once on the quick commands wheel button to send the "Attack!" command.
[*] Aim at a specific tank and tap once on the quick commands wheel button to let your allies know that you are going to attack this target.
[*] Tap and hold the quick commands wheel button, then select an icon you need to send out any other command.
[/list][h3]On PC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Click the quick commands wheel button and move your mouse as needed to send out quick commands. Forget about hot keys. 😉
[*] You can also send quick commands the old-fashioned way using Ctrl.
[/list]
You will learn the new controls in no time, and all your movements will become instinctive. And this is just the beginning as we are planning to roll out new commands to bring team coordination in battle to a whole new level!

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Bisonte C45[/h3]
[list]
[*] The lower glacis plate armor was increased from 25 to 55 mm.
[/list][h3]T34 and T34 (1776)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Engine power was increased from 810 to 880 hp.
[*] The turret's front armor was enhanced from 178 to 187 mm.
[/list][h2]Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
The camo selection menu has been updated with Konung for the Strv K, Sandsturm for the Tiger (P), D-Gunner for the T28 Defender, Chronos for the Object 268 Version 4 and Eagle for the E 75 TS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b1d865abaf18710ebcb8744e670f0b292414bf84.jpg[/img]

New Legendary camos will be offered to the owners of these tanks: 
[list]
[*] the hi-tech Futuro for WZ-132-1
[*] the daring Runner for Bat.-Châtillon 25 t
[*] the armor-plated Turtle for T95
[*] the extremely hazardous H-Combat for T34
[*] the racing Breakneck for Ru 251
[*] the woodland Tarnkappe for Rhm.-Borsig Waffenträger
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4a87fbc8996b2b55d352500fa936b21d6f018380.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, have been updated to a new graphics quality: E 75 and Garm, Progetto M40 mod. 65 and Gladiator, and Vickers Mk. E Type B.
[*] You can now listen to music right in the Garage. Adjust the volume in Settings/ Other/ Music Volume.
[*] A player's position on the rating battles leaderboard has been added to their profile and the rating stats screens.
[*] Vehicle research progress has been added to the second battle results screen.
[*] Replay recording is now enabled by default.
[*] Areas where vehicles became stuck were fixed, and the models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps.
[*] Ambient sounds in battle have been improved for mobile devices.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications have also been improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Rating Battles in March
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LZxRaYRuWPQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Can you feel it? The winds of change are blowing in rating battles! Though, the key things will remain unchanged – you're in for a whole month of fierce battles and mountains of rewards, including gold, camos, avatars, and the Lorraine Fearless. A warm place among the top players might as well become yours!

[i]Please note that rating battles will be fought from March 3 to March 28.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6ad12191d865d99e4cb3c95392b4a8f85c796c3c.gif[/img]

[h2]Rating Sprint Event[/h2]

A special in-game event awaits you from March 10 to March 20! Do your utmost from the very start of rating battles: The higher the League in which you'll burst into Rating Sprint, the faster you'll claim all the prizes! They include unique camos and the cool Rating Indicator attachment. It will change its appearance depending on your League!

[h2]T49 Fearless[/h2]

You still have a chance to claim the Lorraine Fearless throughout the spring! In the summer, it will be replaced with a new tank — T49 Fearless. This fighter isn't just swift and powerful. It's also extremely handsome! Just look at it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9793f8c1822098f7a20fbcc23e6fafe33243ba98.jpg[/img]

Do you know what the greatest thing about it is? You'll be able to get this new tank in March! It'll be awarded to the 1v1 tournament winners in each region. To participate in the tournament, you should be among the top 28 players of rating battles in March. The tournament will take place on March 30–31. The Grand Finals will be streamed live on our YouTube channel!

[h2]Coins[/h2]

Coins are back to rating battles! You'll receive them each time you win in the Gold, Platinum, and Diamond Leagues. There's no limit! The more times you win, the more Coins you'll get.

For each victory, you'll receive:
[list]
[*] 5 Coins in the Gold League
[*] 7 Coins in the Platinum League
[*] 10 Coins in the Diamond League
[/list]
You can spend Coins on bundles in the Store. Check the Esports tab!

[i]Don't worry if you don't have enough time to spend your Coins. They won't disappear, and they'll stay in your Storage. [/i]

[h2]Battle Schedule[/h2]
[list]
[*] Europe: March 3 to March 29, 0:59 (CEST)
[*] North America: March 3 to March 28, 16:59 (PT) / 19:59 (ET)
[*] APAC: March 3 to March 29, 7:59 (UTC+8)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.7
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0zoyq8kv7PQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Chinese Light Tanks Branch[/h2]
Meet five daring light tanks — swift, compact, featuring great damage per minute and a short aiming time! Tier IX and X vehicles come with a new Adaptive Concealment mechanic.
[h2]Sunlit Middleburg[/h2]
The map has been visually revamped! More realistic lighting and materials will make your gaming experience even more immersive. The updated Middleburg map features more light and objects, while its gameplay didn't change. Well, only that it's now covered by more trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6fbcd459f64389fb12b25cc194a40aa45be15fbf.jpg[/img]

If your device isn't ready for the new Middleburg graphics, you can enable the medium quality option for objects and terrain in the settings. At the same time, the graphics of maps that haven't yet been updated to the new visual quality will remain the same.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, changes affected four branches of different nations: Japanese heavies, French tank destroyers, and German and American medium tanks. Playing these well-known vehicles will now bring you lots of new experiences and emotions. Rebalancing will emphasize the playstyle succession inside branches, fully unfolding it at the highest tier.
[h2]Camouflage[/h2]
New Legendary camos will await owners of two predators: the snowy Irbis for the Leopard 1 and the flaming Colossus for the Löwe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/50b70cfa53eb74f1c629dd30775c06a6acdf2822.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/58256675e6b2d0e8c5c589bd5f02bc5ac3bf64d9.jpg[/img] 

More than a dozen Legendary and Rare camos, including Moderno for the Controcarro 3 Minotauro, Ammoel for the T57 Heavy Tank, and Hugo for the Caliban, became available in the camo selection menu.

The Grandma's Gift, Starlight Night, and Evergreen camos will no longer be available for purchase.
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2][list]
[*] Added Ukrainian localization of the game.
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, were updated to the new graphics quality: the Rhm.-Borsig Waffenträger, the FV4005 and Overkill, the IS-4 and Skilled.
[*] Rewards in daily containers and containers for completing missions were changed. Parts of the certificate for Premium Account will be replaced with a mission for receiving a mastery badge. Complete this mission to get certificates for x3–x5 XP as a reward.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.6
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Xf6M92k0Mao;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Clear Sound for Small Speakers [/h2]
In this Update, shot sounds have been improved so that they can be heard clearly, without being distorted or muffled, not only on high-end audio systems but also on ordinary smartphones, tablets, and small speakers. 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
IS
[list]
[*] 100 mm D10T stock gun: Aiming time of the stock/top turret was decreased from 6.6/6.5 to 6.3/6 s.
[*] 122 mm D2-5T stock gun: Gun aiming time was reduced from 6.9 to 6.6 s.
[*] 122 mm D-25T top gun: Gun aiming time was reduced from 6.8 to 6.2 s. Gun reload time was decreased from 14.38 to 13.9 s.
[*] Vehicle traverse speed on the spot was decreased from 36.49/40.4 to 30.45/34.11 deg/s for the stock/top chassis, respectively.
[*] View range of stock/top turrets was decreased from 230/240 to 225/230 m.
[/list]
[h2]Legendary Camouflages[/h2]
New Legendary camos will await owners of several tanks. The first two on the list are the Förster for the Grille 15, which looks like it came straight out of the deepest of woods, and the Steppe for the IS, that's sure to appeal to lovers of historical camouflages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7328bd1476cc4d33590e3db314c232da5cf2aba1.jpg[/img]

The primeval Jötunn for the E 100, the striking Poison for the T92E1, the historical Taiga and Tundra for the SU-152, the mythical Garm for the E 75, and the audacious Basher for the AMX 50 100 were added to the camo selection menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6ee3aec3a3165185089afae3d000415e2ce6c3df.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, were updated to the new graphics quality: Caernarvon Action X (Resolute and Morpho camos), Leopard 1 (Wild camo), and STB-1 (Adamant camo).
[*] iOS: WoT Blitz is now supported only on devices with Apple A7 SoC and later: iPhone 5s, iPad Air, iPad mini 2, iPod touch 6, and newer. Update 9.6 and subsequent game versions will not be available on older devices with 32-bit processors. The game no longer supports iOS 9 and 10. To continue playing, please make sure your device is running iOS 11 or newer.
[*] macOS: The game no longer supports macOS 10.11 El Capitan and 10.12 Sierra. To continue playing, please upgrade your computer to macOS 10.13 High Sierra or newer.
[*] A new button that allows you to copy any nickname and user ID appeared in the player profile.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Operation Hasta la Vista
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2MqmI4GvJRk;full][/previewyoutube]
The battle for humanity's future has begun!
The Skynet supercomputer, commanding an army of machines, has sent its best fighters back in time with one mission: Kill resistance leader John Connor and seal humanity's fate once and for all. You know what to do: Protect John Connor at all costs! Grab your pass chip, complete the stages, and add the Cyborg tank to your arsenal, along with its legendary T-800 camo!
[i]3 Pass levels will be unlocked as soon as Operation Hasta la Vista starts.[/i]

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
By completing Operation missions and increasing your Pass Level, you'll forge ahead and get rewards. A  Premium Pass will bring you even more rewards for the same levels. And the License will allow you to simultaneously complete missions for several unlocked weeks at once, as well as to change the conditions of one mission every week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d1d0a70bb542db89fa4688a5d28ec18b6ff92b00.jpg[/img]

[h2]Operation Duration[/h2]
[list]
[*] Europe: January 4, 13:00 (CET) to January 31, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: January 4, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to January 31, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: January 4, 14:00 (UTC+8) to January 31, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
Once the Operation ends, the Pass Level can no longer be increased by completing Operation missions. However, Premium Pass owners will be able to increase their Level using gold for one more day. During this time, Premium Pass will be available in the Store. Remember that purchasing it grants you additional rewards for all of the levels you've completed.

tags.feature: Grab your pass chip, complete the stages, and add the Cyborg tank to your arsenal, along with its legendary T-800 camo!

notes.title: Update 9.4
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=G3T6bkpJI4g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Branch of Italian TDs[/h2]
Six hardened tank destroyers featuring an impressive amount of HP are now available for research! The new branch is proudly headed by the Controcarro 3 Minotauro, an assault vehicle with a 130-mm gun. Its impeccable Moderno Legendary camouflage expertly combines state-of-the-art elements with a tribute to a myth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cee0644d83053215a9167ac80544ae17029fcaab.jpg[/img]

Starting from Tier VII, the new tank destroyers are equipped with an autoreloading system. At the same time, unlike Italian medium tanks, shell reload time is configured in a special way for the new TDs. The first shot of a fully loaded magazine autoreloads faster than the others. If you fire only that first shot, you can cause maximum damage per minute (which will be much higher than specified in the characteristics). It should be noted that autoreloading the first shell into an empty magazine can take more than 20 seconds. So it makes sense to unleash the entire magazine only in case of emergency, when the enemy will be destroyed for sure or when your allies can cover you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ab4c24586d0cfbbc5d3a8c19d85602ed97218a06.jpg[/img]

[h2]Matchmaker[/h2]
Now, there will be two queues for entering a battle. The common one is for medium or high skilled commanders. The second one is for those with low battle efficiency. After training and gaining some combat experience, players from the second group will be able to return to the common queue.

[h2]Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
Owners of the following four tanks will soon receive offers to buy new Legendary camos: the fantastic Ammoel for the T57 Heavy, the gothic Darkwing for the WT auf Pz. IV, the realistic Ghost for the KV-1, and the even more realistic Jäger for the Kampfpanzer 50 t. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0057994101121035a78b753a12b32dcc02d6cd3b.jpg[/img]

The cosmic LunarX for the Rover, the mighty Skvělý for the Škoda T 45, the shining Excalibur for the GSOR 1008, the forest Leshy for the Object 274a, and the dependable Baron for the Tiger I became available in the camo selection menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f5610db6708a19138f0e60dc0112342ba135107e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, were updated to the new graphics quality: T110Е5 (Rebel camo), M48 Patton (Pit Bull and Beast camos), Maus (Steel Predator and Legionary camos), and WT auf Pz. IV (with the new Darkwing camo).
[*] For user convenience, when you purchase an equipment slot, the cursor now automatically moves to the next one. 
[*] The mechanism of purchasing and opening containers was simplified. Now, you can purchase several identical items at once or open containers one after another without leaving the current screen.
[*] To improve the audio experience, the sound volume of various in-battle effects was balanced. In addition, the music and effects volume settings were set to 100% by default.
[*] Performance counters are now also displayed in the Garage, near the tank pedestal.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Transferring an Account from the CIS Server to the Europe
notes.content:
Dear players!

On April 4, we announced that all operations pertaining to Wargaming games in Russia and Belarus—operations for World of Tanks Blitz in particular—would be transferred to Lesta Games. This was the first step of a long-term strategy, resulting in the complete structural and financial divergence between the two companies. In terms of business and operation, World of Tanks Blitz and other products are currently managed by two independent companies: Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and Wargaming in all other countries.

The next important step will be the launch of a special account transfer campaign. Players who want to stay with Wargaming and continue playing via Steam will need to move from the CIS server to the Europe server.
[quote]The transfer will only be available for accounts linked to WG ID.[/quote]

Account transfer is an important step: Each player on the CIS server will need to decide which server to continue playing on. Below you can find the key points of this process.
[olist]
[*] The CIS server will soon disappear from World of Tanks Blitz. Moreover, new players from Russia and Belarus will not be able to register a new World of Tanks Blitz account via Steam.
[*] New players from countries that were previously included in the CIS server (except for Russia and Belarus) will still be able to install World of Tanks Blitz via Steam and create an account. When registering, they will be offered the Europe server.
[*] If you already have an account on the CIS server, you will be given the option to transfer it to the Europe server and continue playing via Steam.
[*] If you don't want to transfer your account to the EU region (Europe server), unfortunately, you won't be able to continue playing via Steam.
[/olist]
High-quality services and player comfort have always been our top priority and remain so moving forward. Regardless of the server you choose to continue playing on, we will retain all progress and all in-game assets, as well as the key services that our players are used to.

We understand that this is a significant and momentous decision for our players, and we will do everything possible to make it as easy for everyone as possible.

[h2]Additional questions
[/h2]
HOW WILL THE ACCOUNTS BE TRANSFERRED?
Soon, when logging into the game, all players on the CIS server will see special information windows. Through them, we will ask some players to add an email or password to their account.
All Steam players on the CIS server will be given the option to transfer their account to the Europe server to continue playing WoT Blitz on their current account, while their data will continue to be processed by Wargaming.

HOW WILL MY ACCOUNT CHANGE AFTER THE TRANSFER?
If you choose to transfer your account to the Europe server, you will keep all vehicles, credits, gold, other resources, all assets in the Storage, all statistics, and even your nickname, if it's not used by another player. If your nickname is already taken, your new nickname on the Europe server will appear as follows: "Your_nickname_on_CIS_server_account_ID." The list of friends will also change, and you will no longer be a member of a clan.

I PLAY FROM BELARUS OR RUSSIA AND WOULD LIKE TO TRANSFER MY ACCOUNT TO THE EU REGION. WILL I BE ABLE TO MAKE IN-GAME PURCHASES AFTER THE ACCOUNT TRANSFER?
To find out if you can make purchases directly on Steam, check the payment methods available on the platform for your country or contact Steam Support.

CAN I MOVE MY EU/NA/ASIA ACCOUNT TO ANOTHER SERVER DURING THIS CAMPAIGN?
No, the campaign is intended for CIS players only. For other players on Steam, everything will remain unchanged.

WHAT CAN I DO IF I DON'T WANT TO TRANSFER MY ACCOUNT TO THE EUROPE SERVER?
Unfortunately, in that case, you will not be able to play World of Tanks via Steam using your CIS server account.

[quote]We will publish all the conditions and technical details closer to the launch of the account transfer campaign. Stay posted![/quote]

You can now easily get back a sold Premium or Collector tank without leaving the game! Use the Restore Tank option in the vehicle carousel, on the tank stats screen in the Profile, or in the Store. You'll see a list of vehicles sold within the last 3 months, the date of sale, and the restoration price. You'll be able to restore vehicles sold before this period via Player Support. [code]The restoration price in gold is equal to the purchase price. The restoration price in credits is 10% higher than the purchase price. [/code]
[h2]Lower Resolution[/h2]

We've reworked the Lower Resolution option to enhance gameplay comfort. Owners of less powerful devices will appreciate the change in the Static Lower Resolution: It now reduces the resolution of only landscape objects and tanks, while all elements of the battle interface remain clear.

The tracking of high loads and FPS drops on iOS devices was improved: The option won't be activated unless necessary. In addition, Dynamic Lower Resolution is now available for PCs. Mac owners with high-resolution Retina displays will especially appreciate this since the option will be enabled by default.

notes.content:

A new month brings new challenges to Rating Battles, along with important changes to rating calculations. From July 5 to July 31, join the fight to get a camouflage, gold, an avatar, parts of the certificate for the Lorraine Fearless, and a hot spot amongst the top ten players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ad067f936b73e214822c69e9fabbcc3cd0adb53e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes to Rating Calculations[/h2]

In February, we added the possibility of earning rating points even if you were defeated. We closely monitored the results of battles after this innovation took place to make sure everything worked correctly.

Having processed these results, we found that quite often members of the losing team would receive more rating points than the winners. To avoid this in the future, we decided to reduce the number of rating points that players in the losing team could earn by 30%.

notes.title: Update 9.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=v3XJgXSmB6g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Japanese Heavies[/h2]
The Japanese Tech Tree has grown a new branch of six researchable heavy tanks. All of them boast strong armor and good mobility. Starting from Tier VII, tanks of the new branch feature unique equipment that improves either ground crossing capacity or vertical gun turn limits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f56cc6ebda54479c4b28ce422bef8e87d2842c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Even More Realism[/h2]
The Garage and Castilla map have received new graphics that will delight you with realistic materials and lighting. Trees sway from blast waves caused by shots and explosions, branches move apart as tanks drive through bushes… In three words, it's sheer beauty! The new dynamic resolution option will help you appreciate it to the fullest. Make sure to check out the system requirements and enjoy improvements without any drops in performance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4be9be2a49dc9750ecc18b0b92f02f1ec84231d0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reactions and Reports[/h2]
We've been planning to rework the military honor functionality for a long time and finally decided to split it into Reactions and Reports. Reactions allow one to express their emotions after battle. They're like emojis or stickers in a messaging app. Reports are a whole different story. They're intended for reporting violations, such as unsporting conduct, provocative communication, or inactivity in battle. The new system will identify and impose just punishment on regular offenders based on your reports, so don't let them get away with misbehavior.

[previewyoutube=difdJhhuCZc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Maximum Damage in the Profile[/h2]
In the player profile, military honor will be replaced with information about maximum damage, such as the amount of damage, in which vehicle, and on which map the damage was dealt, as well as the date and time. 
[quote] These stats don't include battles fought prior to Update 9.0 or battles in fun modes. [/quote]
[h2]New Aiming Mechanic[/h2]
Following many open tests, research studies, and player surveys, we've reworked the aiming system. The reticle's appearance will remain the same while its behavior will significantly change. The reticle indicator will react better to the player's actions, move smoother relative to the terrain, and follow the target more accurately.

[previewyoutube=oW1kV_2PqFU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Customization[/h2]
[quote]During this Update, all attachments will be available in the Camouflage menu at a 50% discount![/quote]
The Moose Legendary camo for the Lansen C will also be added to the camo selection menu. A beast known for its fearlessness and unpredictability will appear on the turret, cold winter colors will cover the hull, and the tank's battle name will change to Lansen Moose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/27ca82f727f306f6a82141d9866c5f77f9ab75aa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[b]STA-1[/b]
[list]
[*] The top engine's power-to-weight ratio was increased from 16.76 to 17.5 hp/t.
[*] Top speed was increased from 45 to 50 km/h.
[/list]
[b]T54E1 [/b]
[list]
[*] Magazine reload time was decreased from 17 to 16.5 s.
[*] The top engine's power-to-weight ratio was increased from 14.88 to 15.25 hp/t.
[*] Top speed was decreased from 50 to 45 km/h.
[*] The top gun's dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.35 to 0.36 m.
[*] Changes to armor:
[list][*] From 110 to 127 mm for the upper glacis plate of the hull.
[*] From 108/88.9/50.8/127 to 118/96/70.8/167 mm for the turret collar front.
[*] From 127/127/63.5 to 147/147/72.5 for the oscillating turret front.
[*] From 127 to 237 mm for the gun's mantlet.

tags.feature: The Japanese Tech Tree has grown a new branch of six researchable heavy tanks. All of them boast strong armor and good mobility. Starting from Tier VII, tanks of the new branch feature unique equipment that improves either ground crossing capacity or vertical gun turn limits.

The Garage and Castilla map have received new graphics that will delight you with realistic materials and lighting. Trees sway from blast waves caused by shots and explosions, branches move apart as tanks drive through bushes… In three words, it's sheer beauty! The new dynamic resolution option will help you appreciate it to the fullest. Make sure to check out the system requirements and enjoy improvements without any drops in performance!

Reactions allow one to express their emotions after battle. They're like emojis or stickers in a messaging app. Reports are a whole different story. They're intended for reporting violations, such as unsporting conduct, provocative communication, or inactivity in battle. The new system will identify and impose just punishment on regular offenders based on your reports, so don't let them get away with misbehavior.

In the player profile, military honor will be replaced with information about maximum damage, such as the amount of damage, in which vehicle, and on which map the damage was dealt, as well as the date and time.

Following many open tests, research studies, and player surveys, we've reworked the aiming system. The reticle's appearance will remain the same while its behavior will significantly change. The reticle indicator will react better to the player's actions, move smoother relative to the terrain, and follow the target more accurately.

The Moose Legendary camo for the Lansen C will also be added to the camo selection menu. A beast known for its fearlessness and unpredictability will appear on the turret, cold winter colors will cover the hull, and the tank's battle name will change to Lansen Moose.

notes.title: Update 8.10
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4UWNNIw_ack;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Operation Mechanics[/h2]
It's now easier to complete Operations! You can complete missions within a week without losing progress for any days you may have missed. The number of levels has been adjusted too, decreasing from 80 to 60. However, the number of rewards remains mostly unchanged. Finally, a License that allows for Operations to be completed in a more straightforward manner has also been introduced.

[h2]Premium Shells Economy[/h2]
We're continuing to refine the way the game's economy works. This time, we're making some adjustments that affect Premium shells. Their cost is now directly related to the tank's tier, as well as to their penetration and damage. Some shells purchased using gold and credits will go up in price slightly, while some will become cheaper. The cost of shells for Premium tanks will become less or remain the same.

[h2]Battle Results Improvement[/h2]
After analyzing the feedback collected from players regarding the updated battle results screens, we decided to return Base XP. It will be displayed in all battle types except Rating Battles. By default, players' results are sorted by damage caused, but we also added the option to sort them by XP. Due to interface specifics, long nicknames may be displayed in a shortened form in battle results.

[h2]Legendary Camos[/h2]
The mythical Qinglong for the Type 59, the daring Interceptor for the T-100 LT, the wild Rhino for the M48A2 Räumpanzer, the mighty Vigilant for the Object 252U, and the venomous Snakebite for the Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger became available in the camo selection menu.

Owners of the following three tanks will soon receive offers to buy new Legendary camos: the cartoonish Win Peaks for the AMX 30 1er prototype, the jade Gongbi for the WZ-120-1G FT, and the post-apocalyptic Burn for the K-91.

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Vickers Mk. F, the Jagdpanzer E 100 with its Mighty Legendary camo and Spezialset attachment, as well as the Grille 15 with its Troublemaker and RA1DER Legendary camos received improved graphics.
[*] Mad Games: Tracks can no longer receive critical damage after the High-Octane Fuel modification expires.
[*] The bug where it was difficult to get a drowned enemy tank out of the crosshairs was fixed.
[*] The bug where the sound of tracks wasn't audible when driving over some objects was fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 8.9
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5p1ZtsXjrR0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Free Camouflage Resupply[/h2]
We're continuing to adjust the game's economy by reducing the number of battles with a negative credit balance. With the release of Update 8.9, you'll be able to resupply all camos for free. Changes will affect 75 camos that, until now, were resupplied after each battle using credits. The cost of unlocking them for the first time will be significantly higher and will depend on the vehicle's tier. But each purchase will pay off over time. 
[i]Throughout Update 8.9, a 70% discount will be available on these 75 camos.[/i]

[h2]Supplies for the VK 72.01 (K) Branch[/h2]
The Tier VII–X tanks of the VK 72.01 (K) branch will receive Tungsten Rounds as consumables, as well as Improved Gunpowder, Sandbag Armor, and Enhanced Sandbag Armor as provisions. This will add some diversity to their standard gameplay while also making them less similar to vehicles from the E 100 branch.

[h2]Battle Results Improvement[/h2]
We're continuing to gradually improve battle results based on feedback collected from players. The detailed statistics can now be accessed from each of the three screens at the tap of a special button. There will be more improvements in future updates.

[h2]Legendary Camos[/h2]
The dark Noir for the Bat.-Châtillon Bourrasque, the severe Krzemień for the 60TP Lewandowskiego, the inspiring Thunderbird for the Concept 1B, and the netherworldly Monster for the E 50 Ausf. M are now available in the camo selection menu.
Owners of the Škoda T 56 will soon receive an offer to purchase a new Legendary camo—the fabled Golem.

[*] The TVP TVU, Škoda T 50, and TVP T 50/51 (including its Instigator Legendary camo) received better graphics.
[*] Level 10 avatars for winning Rating Battles were introduced. The avatars of Platinum and Diamond Leagues are animated.
[*] Item groups were added to the Store. Similar bundles will now be included in one slider.
[*] Tankenstein: The bug where the crew could receive critical damage was fixed.
[*] The bug where the "Damage blocked" ribbon was displayed upon firing at a destroyed tank was fixed.
[*] The "Recover password" button and the button navigating to your account can now be found in Settings → General → Account Management.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

[quote]Download the new version starting February 16![/quote]

[h2]Let's Go to the Netherlands[/h2]
Vecht! Roll out! Welcome to Molendijk! This map will feature battles fought in the streets of a beautiful town, in an idyllic village, and amid lavender fields and windmills. As you feast your eyes on the views, don't forget to watch out for the enemy.

[h2]Updated Battle Results [/h2]
The time has come to adjust the display of battle results. Cutting to the chase, they now look awesome and more informative! There are three screens, each of them showing your tank at its finest, along with detailed personal, economic, and team results. 

[h2]Hints for Additional Mechanics[/h2]
There are already many special tank mechanics in the game. And even more will be available as time goes on. To make it clear how they work, we're going to add hints to the Brief Characteristics menu. The new update will introduce hints for Tracer Shells (T-100 LT and Object 84) and Dynamic Armor (Titan H-N). We will gradually add info for other additional mechanics as well.
 
[h2]XP Multiplier Timer Reset[/h2]
Users of iOS and Android mobile devices will be able to reset the timer of the XP multiplier for the first victory (x2 timer). The refresh timer and the watching ads button will appear near the Battle! button. Watch an ad and the x2 XP multiplier will refresh. It's a great way to research your dream tank faster!

The drop-dead gorgeous Galaxy and Shattered Flames camos were added to the camo selection menu. The Grandma's Gift, Starlight Night, and Evergreen camos will no longer be available for purchase.

[*] The structure of the Soviet Tech Tree was improved.
[*] The bug where the price under upgrade options was displayed in Elite XP (not in credits or gold) on the screen for accelerating crew skill training was fixed. 
[*] The bug where the sound of burning may have been missing after the tank was destroyed was fixed. 
[*] The bug where the corresponding sound of resources deduction was missing upon opening a container using credits/gold was fixed.

notes.content:

Important updates are coming to Rating Battles! Rating points can now be earned even if you're defeated or lost even if you win. But the primary aspects remain unchanged. From February 5 to February 28, you can progress through the leagues and collect cool rewards, including parts of the certificate for the Lorraine Fearless. And a warm place among the top ten players might as well become yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/42bffc85bba730de76f7464ae92b6b2bf883aa84.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes to Rating Calculations[/h2]

Giving your best in battle is now more important than ever! Even if your team loses, your rating can still improve. At the same time, if you show a lack of initiative in battle, your rating will drop even if your team wins. Let's see how it works.
[list]
[*] The best player of the losing team can earn rating points as if they won. How is that possible? It's up to you and what you do in battle! The more active you are, the higher your chances of scoring points. Deal damage, spot foes, send enemies to their Garage, capture bases, and earn as much XP as possible in battles.
[*] Only one member of the losing team can earn rating points. 
[*] The players of the winning team who remained idle in battle will have the same rating they would have had if their team lost. Taking useful actions in battle will help you avoid such a fate.
[*] If there are several idle players on the winning team, each of them will receive a rating penalty.
[/list]
Get the most out of each battle and get to the top of the rankings faster!

notes.title: Dance of the Tiger Event
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3c0UflPIQ4I;full][/previewyoutube]
According to the Chinese calendar, the Tiger—the symbol of the upcoming lunar year—favors the bold and decisive. And that's you! It's also believed that this noble predator always generously rewards such warriors. 

Which is true! From January 28 to February 7, participate in the Dance of the Tiger event, earn Coins for victories in Tier IV–X vehicles, and exchange them for cool rewards: Epic boosters, Premium Account, Lockbox Keys, an animated camouflage, a Legendary avatar, and the new Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger tank destroyer!

[h2]What Kind of Beast Is It?[/h2]
Stealthy, extremely dangerous, and ideal for ambushes! The Steyr WT has everything an effective ambusher needs: small size and a powerful gun with a three-shell magazine and 660 HP of total damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/692c97ebf2edfa4d9b10c780d55834df3a127749.jpg[/img]

However, there's a nuance: the Steyr WT's weak armor is unforgiving for battlefield mistakes, which makes this tank destroyer an easy target for enemy HE shells. So you better make sure to stay out of the enemy's sight. Instead, find cover and reel off your magazine at unsuspecting opponents! Then rush to a new comfortable position thanks to the Steyr WT's ability to accelerate to 50 km/h. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/503d06798a0fe9a6cd956d96c36ef572331fbf6b.jpg[/img]

Good knowledge of maps is the key to success in the Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger. Shift quickly from cover to cover, provide fire support to allies, and feel at home among the top players by damage dealt!

[h2]When Does the Dance of the Tiger Event Take Place?[/h2]
[list]
[*] CIS: January 28, 8:00 (MSK) to February 7, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: January 28, 13:00 (CET) to February 7, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: January 28, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET) to February 7, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET)
[*] APAC: January 28, 14:00 (UTC+8) to February 7, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/event/dance-of-the-tiger/]GET THE STEYR WT![/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Update 8.7
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eyM-iISw09o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Soviet Light Tanks[/h2]
The Soviet Tech Tree got a new branch of light tanks! In addition to an older tank that was moved there, it also received three new Tier VII, IX, and X vehicles. They're all fast, quick-firing, and well-concealed, while the Tier IX and X tanks feature a new spotting mechanic—Tracer Shells.
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, balance changes were made to Tier IX vehicles. For example, the Conqueror's turret will become stronger, the Škoda T 50'sdispersion and aiming time will decrease, and the T95 will be faster, but its reloading time will increase. 
[h2]Rating Battle Changes[/h2]
Great play should be rewarded, so, starting February, in special cases, the most effective player of the defeated team will be able to get rating points as if they won. At the same time, an inactive player from the winning team will be treated as if they lost: Their rating can drop. You'll be able to learn more about these changes to Rating Battles in the February article.
[h2]Certificates for XP[/h2]
We changed how sorting occurs in Storage, and now certificates for x3 and x5 XP are displayed at the top of the list. This way, it will be more convenient to keep track of them. Moreover, we fixed the issue in the Store where it wasn't always clear which tank in a bundle the certificate for bonus XP could be used for.
[h2]Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
Owners of the following three tanks will soon receive offers to buy Legendary camos. These camos are the wild Rhino for the M48A2 Räumpanzer, the mighty Champion for the Object 252U, and the daring Interceptor for the T-100 LT.
[h2]Container for Ads[/h2]
The Store will feature a container that you'll be able to open once a day by watching two ads. Its rewards may include icongoldpart parts of the certificate for gold, icongoldboost Gold boosters, iconshards Splinters, the exclusive Sparkling Spotlight camo, and the Panther/M10. At the same time, the usual feature of receiving gold by watching ads will not change. This container is only available for mobile device users. 
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Tiger II and its Savage camo, the KV-2 and its Menacing camo, the Skorpion G and its Stinging camo, and the 50TP prototyp received better graphics.
[*] The Tankenstein's crew can no longer receive critical damage (which makes sense as a zombie tank can't have a crew).
[*] The bug when the Precision Fire crew ability was activated in Realistic Battles was fixed. 
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 8.6
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JQkk2nMSiV8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Festive Garage and Camos[/h2]

New Bay is covered in snow, and its central square is decorated with a Christmas tree and lights! A Garage like this definitely sets the festive mood before battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/90688d4c6c5e3db7f2d1c5c8c0593f9a1b5f29ac.jpg[/img]

Capture points have also been decorated! Have you been a good commander this year? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5c0b24c8ac2ecd2f01617af6149497f8aba699bf.jpg[/img]

Ideal for a cold winter, warm camos like the cozy Grandma's Gift, dreamy Starlight Night, and scented Evergreen are making their return to the camo selection menu. Dress up and have fun!
[quote] The Molten Lava and Urban Jungle camos are no longer available for purchase.  [/quote]
[h2]Legendary Camos for Tier X Tanks[/h2]

The following camos will become available in the Camouflage menu: the rough Rotkopf for the VK 72.01 (K), the stormy Typhoon for the WZ-121, the bright Overkill for the FV4005, the wild Safari for the FV4202, the biting Piranha for the T95E6, and the splendid Corsica for the AMX 30 B.

Owners of the 60TP Lewandowskiego will soon receive an offer to buy the Krzemień camo. Brutality and belligerence will pave a path to legendary victories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c3722fffa86a5f3894ab39d1a30679d77143281d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Accumulative Discount for Training[/h2]
The price of training for Regimental School (up to 75%) or Tank Academy (up to 100%) used to be fixed and didn't depend on your level of mastery. Now it decreases as your crew mastery grows. The less left until 75%, the cheaper the training for credits. The less left until 100%, the cheaper the training for gold.
[quote] These discounts are combined with other temporary discounts for crew training.  [/quote] 
[h2]Joining Light and Medium Tanks[/h2]
It's time to make changes to the way the matchmaker selects vehicles for battles. Light and medium tanks used to have different values in the matchmaker. So there were rarely cases when teams were unequal. As the way to play medium and light tanks is more similar, the matchmaker will consider them to be the same type. This means it will strive to make the ratio of light and medium tanks, as well as other vehicles, the same for both teams.

[h2]Updated HP Indicator [/h2]

Now it's easier to monitor your tank's key parameter! The indicator became bigger, its color changes from green to red, and the amount of HP lost is displayed with a visual effect. When penetrated, the indicator blinks.

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated graphics were introduced for the FV215b (183) and its Hammer camouflage, the Progetto 46 and its Reborn camouflage, and the T26.
[*] Now the Spear 'n Sear attachment shoots a stream of fire not only before battle, but also after destroying an enemy.
[*] The bug when the XP of an inactive player displayed in battle results was fixed. Now both allies and enemies will see "0" in the XP section of the team's battle results.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]
