notes.title: Update 8.5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aBkOS40W1Kg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New Voices[/h2]
We're continuing to work on in-game sounds. The crews of Italian, Czechoslovakian, Polish, and Finnish vehicles will now speak their native languages. To enjoy the international diversity, enable the "National Crew Voice" option (Settings → Other).
In addition, following the Pz. IV Ankou SP, all other tanks from the Girls und Panzer anime series universe, such as the Tiger Kuromorimine SP, Hetzer Kame SP, IS-2 Pravda SP, and Firefly Saunders SP, will also receive original Japanese crew voiceovers. 
[h2]Economy and Balance[/h2]
Great gameplay must be rewarded. Starting from Update 8.5, Ace Tanker mastery badges, Top Gun achievements, and Kolobanov's Medals earned in regular and rating battles in Tier VI–X vehicles will bring you additional credits.
We keep refining the credit economy to make vehicle research and credit farming more balanced. 
Extensive balance changes were made to Tier VI–VIII tanks. 
[h2]More Color[/h2]
Update 8.5 will introduce animated avatars! They'll add more fun to the game, and will be displayed in the Garage and battle results, as well as on the battle loading, reward, and event screens… Basically, everywhere, except for the team list in battle. Very soon, you'll be able to get the first of these avatars, Overkill, as part of bundles in the Store.

[h3]Legendary Camouflage for the E 50 M[/h3]
Owners of this medium tank will soon receive an offer to purchase the terrifying, yet captivating, Monster camo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ba10c0525b75ae4de194ddeb5743e2345c0867d3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Camo Rotation[/h3]
The Oxidized Metal, Hardy, and Digital Forest Rare camos, as well as the Carapace Legendary camo for the Turtle Mk.1 and the Graywolf Legendary camo for the Object 263, are now available in the Camouflage tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3cc7545150228509eb41e325dbb54044bbd8fa54.jpg[/img]

[quote] The Spooky Web, Pumpkin Mayhem, Pumpkin Spice, Scary Swarm, and Spidertrap camos will no longer be available for purchase. [/quote]
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Pz. II, T-54 ltwt, as well as the Chimera with its Phantom Legendary camo were updated to the new visual quality.
[*] The line of accumulative avatars for rating battles was extended. Now, each league has 9 levels.
[*] Slots can now be purchased in the Store instead of the Garage.
[*] The Hit Points parameter was added to the Brief Characteristics menu. The minimum and maximum values on the scale correspond to the lowest and highest HP in the game: the lowest value of 270 HP for the Type 95 Ha-Go and the highest value of 2,850 HP for the Maus.
[*] The bug where the consumable use time displayed above the tank was refreshed upon enabling/disabling another consumable, was fixed.
[*] Areas where vehicles became stuck were fixed, and some models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.

notes.title: Operation Fire of Victory
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-h0TdGRYrYc;full][/previewyoutube]
Your competitive spirit is calling to you! Only the brave and persistent will be rewarded! Roll out onto the battlefield and earn resources, champion camos, themed avatars, and the splendid Spark medium tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/2c42296907f8b922d99d945891fcd70dd4b30e38.jpg[/img]
[h2]How to Get Rewards?[/h2]
To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

The Operation includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to regular Pass owners. In other words, all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase your Pass Level to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Flames: 10 Flames = 1 level.

Although your Pass Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Flames per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Flames. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Flames a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Pass Level using gold.

[h2]When Does Operation Fire of Victory Take Place?[/h2]
[list]
[*] CIS: November 1, 8:00 (MSK) to November 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: November 1, 13:00 (CET) to November 29, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: November 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to November 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: November 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to November 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]What Rewards Can I Get?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/53215118152c14c304d40f928f4694cf01cf3c13.jpg[/img]

There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!

With Premium Pass, the D.W. 2 Tier IV heavy tank awaits you at Level 1. A large amount of HP and high single-shot damage are what make it successful.

And at Level 25, you'll find in your Garage the Spark—a medium tank by type, but a champion by ability. Based on the Škoda T 25, this shiny fellow keeps the best qualities like high maneuverability, good dynamics, and an autoloader with fast reloading.

After reaching Level 80 with Premium Pass, you'll get access to the special Operation Container with parts of certificates for tanks from previous Operations and a chance to win rare tanks, including the exclusive AE Phase I Tier IX tank. Cost to unlock container: 100 Flames

notes.title: The LT-432: A Soviet UFO
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lDdO2J8RMEk;full][/previewyoutube]
Hahaha, some enemies really believe that an unidentified flying object is chasing them. That's because it's not a tank, but rather a saucer with a turret! Although it can't fly, so technically it's more of a UMO—an unidentified moving object. If only opponents knew how this tank was created...

Fighting in this tank is sheer fun. Not fighting can be just as fun! First, take a detour and race at 70 km/h along the edges. Then appear behind the enemy and... boom, bam! Fire some shots and withdraw on the double! Once the battle is finished, it's time to count credits. Consider getting a bookkeeper for this.

[quote]Containers that may include the LT-432 or other rewards will be available in the in-game Store until October 29. Each container has an LT-432 Charm. Collect 25 Charms and get the tank![/quote]
[h1]The LT-432 Is Somewhere Hereabouts...[/h1]

But where exactly? That's a good question! This new light tank is lightning fast and comes equipped with a gun boasting high single-shot damage. Its road-hugging hull is covered with thin, yet effectively sloped, armor. Its concealment parameters make many tank destroyers blush in embarrassment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0e72c0863685650ab6b4aa061613f531db4615cb.jpg[/img]

The LT-432 rides perfectly on the straight. The speedometer shows 40 km/h in just 3-4 seconds. A few seconds more and the tank is already dashing at 60 km/h. The 70 km/h top speed can rarely be reached without provisions and equipment. But once applied, this value is quite reachable on the straight.

This new tank can move quickly not just forwards but backwards. The LT-432's reverse speed reaches 30 km/h! Making an enemy's life a nightmare by raking them with fire from unexpected positions will be especially comfortable. By the time the enemy can aim, the LT-432 will have already vanished into thin air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9d0a36ecce91ee1510c69afad816380c88a0ce77.jpg[/img]

Although this newbie is inferior to most opponents in maneuverability, it is anything but clumsy. The LT-432 can whiz around the battlefield and spin around hefty tank destroyers. Circling more mobile foes won't be as easy since the tank noticeably loses speed when traversing.

Like any light tank, the LT-432 is nominally armored. Its well-angled frontal armor and sloped turret will only protect against the occasional shot. At best, sidescraping can protect against Tier VII light tanks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6b16caf023ff70cc292004dafd1c9f47d4031dff.jpg[/img]

To survive, the LT-432 should take advantage of its speed, low silhouette, and good concealment:
[list]
[*] The speed will help it quickly take and change positions, as well as escape enemy fire.
[*] The low silhouette will enable it to fire and spot enemies from behind cover where only its small, hard-to-hit turret will be exposed to opponents.
[*] The good concealment will naturally ensure the tank remains unspotted. So long as the LT-432 doesn't shoot, it can hardly be noticed even on the move. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b7c1555657411b7bb1066ded59110d0afca2ad18.jpg[/img]

Due to small depression and elevation angles, this tank isn't suitable for positional combat among terrain irregularities. That's why the best spots for the LT-432 are flat areas with low cover.

When playing on open maps, carefully spot enemy maneuvers at the beginning of a battle and take a detour behind your team's lines in case an enemy scout breaks through. By that time, the main encounters will have started, which means it's time to see where the LT-432 will cause the most damage.

There's no point in looking for one-on-one clashes. An enemy already engaged in firefights is the best gift for the LT-432.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/406b4ae462ddf41b6aa08b4a1fbf8e3f1b124f1b.jpg[/img]

Roll forward, shoot the sides and rear, deal 280 HP of damage, and quickly retreat to cover to wait out the 9-second reload time. Did an enemy aim its gun at your position? Perfect! Just sit back and allow your allies to inflict damage. Or rush forward to another point to pull the same trick again.

It's no good sniping from TD positions. The 175 mm of penetration is more than enough to damage the sides, but it's hardly enough to penetrate a Tier VIII opponent from the front. Accurately aiming at the enemy's weak spots isn't the tank's strong point as well.

If you manage to preserve at least half of your HP by the end of the battle (there, there, this comes with experience!), you can hunt down isolated enemies. Slow tank destroyers and huge German heavies are perfect victims to be "snatched" to the Garage. It's quite fun to get close to some VK 100.01 (P), which is simply unable to hit such a tank with a low silhouette. But beware of ramming!

notes.title: Operation Titan Flare
notes.content:
Join the scientists from the Titan secret laboratory, get Fortium, and help the researchers uncover the formula for the perfect tank! Along the way, earn resources, epic camos, themed avatars, and the Titan T24 57 with unique armor.

[h2]How to Get Rewards?[/h2]

To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

The Operation includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to regular Pass owners. In other words, all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase your Pass Level to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Fortium: 10 Fortium = 1 level.

Although your Pass Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Fortium per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Fortium. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Fortium a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Pass Level using gold.

[h2]When Does Operation Titan Flare Take Place?[/h2]

[list]
[*] CIS: October 1, 8:00 (MSK) to October 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: October 1, 14:00 (CEST) to October 29, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: October 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to October 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] APAC: October 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to October 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]What Rewards Can I Get?[/h2]

There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0a62de7b2d26bb1c06a26eb976cfbb371feab70e.jpg[/img]

With Premium Pass, the Pz.Kpfw. II Luchs Tier IV light tank awaits you at Level 1. Armed with a quick-firing gun, this nimble tank is an ideal scout that can whirl around any enemy.

And at Level 35, the Titan T24 57, the latest development of scientists from a secret laboratory, will be added to your Garage. Using Fortium extracted from a meteorite that crashed to Earth, the unique armor was created from a titanium-fortium alloy. The new vehicle was developed from the M24 Chaffee, and it inherited the best characteristics of this tank: decent view range and impressive damage per minute. That's exactly what you'll need to be a scout and provide fire support to allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/06d4f6ac90abad77f227835fd3fb0e8c6ba5200b.jpg[/img]

After reaching Level 80 with Premium Pass, you'll get access to the special Operation Container with parts of certificates for tanks from previous Operations and a chance to win rare tanks, including the exclusive AE Phase I Tier IX tank. Cost to unlock container: 100 Fortium

notes.title: Update 8.2
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iLm4MIv1m1g;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting August 18![/quote]
[h2]Ghost Factory Is Open!
[/h2]Coal mounds, industrial vehicles, lanes among hills, and a huge abandoned factory complex at the center, which can be considered a map inside a map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1232642d4307f2e77618cc9b24cc48675f3ca16a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fancy a Cuppa?
[/h2]We're continuing to work on in-game sounds, which is why we're happy to present the much-anticipated British national voiceover! In addition, British English was added to the list of game client localizations. Here's how you can check out this stylish crew accent:[list]
[*] Play in British and Australian (included in the U.K. tech tree) vehicles with the "National crew voice" option enabled (Settings → Other)
[*] Play in any vehicles with English (U.K.) selected in the client (the new localization) and the "National crew voice" option disabled
[/list][quote]Since there is so much text to translate, you may still notice American terms here and there in the British localization. But we're working on this.[/quote]
[h2]Balance and Economy 
[/h2]Inactive players will no longer receive XP or credits for battle. Also, we reconfigured the credit economy and counterbalanced homogenization, a hidden armor parameter.

This time, balance changes were made to Tier X vehicles. The adjustments seek to maintain the gameplay comfort of heavy tanks while preventing them from replacing other types of vehicles. They also aim to enhance the benefits of other types of vehicles. Learn more about these changes on the website.

[h2]Updated Interface
[/h2]It's time to give a new design to the in-game Store. Item cards are now larger, bundle contents are more informative, and discounts are easier to notice. The vertical orientation of tabs corresponds to the Garage's screen design. Moreover, daily containers can be opened in one action. 

The Avatars screen was not left untouched either. Now, it's more similar to the Storage screen. All avatars are divided by category into separate tabs: Premium, Accumulative, Special, Other, and Temporary. Similarly to Storage, to remove the red marker on new avatars, you no longer need to select them. Now you simply need to go to the corresponding tab and view the new avatars. 

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs [/h2][list]
[*] The Strv 74, Leo, Emil I, Emil II, Kranvagn (as well as the Nidhögg and Nord Legendary camos), and WZ-120-1G FT were updated to the new graphics quality.
[*] The Pike Legendary camouflage for the Object 260 was added to the Camo menu.
[*] An effect that shows the battle result ("Victory", "Defeat", "Draw") and a corresponding note ("All tanks destroyed", "Base captured", etc.) was introduced.
[*] The line of accumulative avatars for Rating Battles was extended. Now, each league has 6 levels.
[*] Changes were made to the contents of the Basic Day's Supply and Standard Day's Supply containers. Instead of certificates for purchasing a Tier VI Premium tank, certificates for purchasing Premium tanks of other tiers will now drop from these containers more often.
[*] Some parameters were changed for the Improved Engine Power Boost consumable. Now, it increases engine power by 40%, turn rate by 5%, and maximum forward speed by 5 km/h.
[*] The "Tank Auto-Turn" option was added to the touch control settings. It is intended for newcomers who are accustomed to the fact that the camera prioritizes the direction of movement (like in other shooter games, for example). The option is disabled by default.
[*] The bug where the replay of a battle launched incorrectly if the player hadn't logged into the game was fixed. 
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Somua SM: Armor and an Autoloader
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oyCxKfZL99U;full][/previewyoutube]
It looks like the AMX 50 100 or Lorraine. What, you didn't penetrate it? That's because, unlike its lightly armored counterparts, the heavy Somua SM confidently withstands enemy hits. Its three-shell autoloading gun rids an enemy of 930 HP per magazine, pleasing its commander with victories and a solid credit income! 
[quote]Containers that may include the Somua SM or other rewards will be available in the Store through August 6. Each container has a Somua SM Charm. Collect 25 Charms and get the tank![/quote]
[h1]Grenadier Legendary Camouflage[/h1]
Sometime after your first battle in the Somua SM, you might get an offer for a Legendary camo that changes the tank's name in battle to Somua Grenadier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d464dc349b817131250adeaf1b0fcb68dccb7eee.jpg[/img]

[h1]Confident Shooter[/h1]
Despite their physical resemblance and equal armament, unlike the researchable AMX 50 100, the new Somua SM relies on protection, not on mobility. Its turret has 200 mm of armor in the lower part and 135 mm of armor in the upper part, while the thickness of the upper armor plate of its hull is 155 mm. Taking into account the slopes, these parts of the armor can withstand hits from guns that penetrate up to 240 mm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/969a7288d0dc6ec01f1910a2bdd84a520f9abe6f.jpg[/img]

A small change in the hull's position towards an enemy shot increases the effective thickness of the armor, but don't overdo it, or else you risk your tracks. The lower armor plate is traditionally weak—its thickness is only 50 mm. So try not to expose it to enemy fire. The turret's vulnerable points are the commander's hatch and a small armor strip below the gun. The Somua SM must maneuver to prevent the enemy from targeting these spots.

It's important to pay attention to the turret's position in battle. It is an oscillating type of turret where gun depression affects the slope angle of turret armor. This angle is optimal when the gun is parallel to the ground. Elevating the gun will expose the vulnerable spot below it. If the gun is depressed, the entire upper part of the turret can be easily penetrated. 
[quote]The Somua SM boasts a perfect gun depression angle of 10 degrees. This tank effectively takes advantage of terrain irregularities to hide its lower armor plate. Sticking the turret out from behind the hill, reeling off the entire magazine at the enemy, and retreating calmly to safety for reloading is a great strategy![/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5bbf187e11d9db17303ea94a50d1c2b59698ef5f.jpg[/img]

The Somua SM's gun features a 3-shell magazine with a 3-second reload time between shots. During the first 6 seconds, the tank is capable of dealing 930 HP of damage. The 232 mm of penetration is enough to penetrate most Tier VIII targets head-on. Its dispersion and aiming time are not of sniper quality, therefore, its gun is most effective at close and medium ranges.

After all three shells are fired, the tank needs quite a long time to reload: 25 seconds without equipment or 23 seconds with food provisions and Improved Ventilation installed. To survive this temporary helplessness, the Somua SM's commander must choose directions with multiple covers and avoid fighting on their own. This is especially important because the new tank can't quickly escape enemy fire and drive to the other end of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/39890c4d01d9ed6eb0b453d3b489807653a0c9b3.jpg[/img]

The Somua SM moves steadily, just like a heavy tank with decent armor should. It will take just a couple of seconds to accelerate to 20 km/h, before reaching 30 km/h in about 6 seconds. Accelerating to the maximum of 40 km/h is possible when moving on a long, straight road or down a hill. The leisurely-paced suspension doesn't allow this tank to meet every shot from fans of outmaneuvering with its frontal armor, but the quick turret will ensure that the Somua SM always keeps offenders at gunpoint and doesn't fail to return fire.

Though the Somua SM is decently armored, it's not suitable for playing on the first line of attack. Its protection should be primarily used not for blocking damage but for effectively trading damage with enemies. To take aim and deliver all three shells right on target, the Somua SM must take advantage of its increased protection and stop.

In clashes with other heavies, the Somua SM will demonstrate great results on the second line of attack, teaming up with the most durable heavies like the Tiger II. Unleashing the entire magazine and safely reloading under the cover of an ally will allow this tank to successfully breach enemy defenses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/fb402f23d20a9149f00125818cbac6cdd2e45e0e.jpg[/img]

If medium tanks on the enemy team outnumber those on the allied team, the Somua SM can reinforce this flank. Its appearance will surprise the enemy while its frontal armor and firepower will help allies to quickly wipe out the enemy "cavalry". It's important that allied medium tanks stay low key and wait for the Frenchman's arrival, as it doesn't stand a chance on its own.

In any case, the Somua SM is capable of dealing impressive damage, and the amount of credits earned in battle will delight the commander of this new tank.

notes.title: Update 8.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GBKq7QkN4AQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting July 15![/quote]
[h1]Changes in Armor Highlighting[/h1] 
We tried to eliminate situations when red zones are penetrated and grey ones aren't. Now armor highlighting will be more precise for many tanks. For example, the probability of penetration will display better in situations when armor is at an angle to the aiming point, when there are two layers of armor, or if a shell can punch right through armor.
[quote]Remember that armor highlighting is a hint and not an ultimate rule. It simply shows the possibility of penetration. It doesn't guarantee it. The result of a shot is still affected by multiple factors like +/-5% to dispersion, enemy maneuvers, and other factors. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7a1c9d81e4795cb8ce0059c65d45b9b1b7db326a.png[/img]

[h1]Updated Bonus Containers[/h1]
We reworked the content system of bonus containers (daily, weekly, and three-day containers). 

Newcomers will now get more resources like credits, Credit boosters, and Combat XP boosters from these containers to accelerate their game progress. For skilled commanders, there will be Gold and Cooldown boosters. The higher the vehicle tier, the more valuable the content. 

Moreover, drop chances will be clearer for all containers in the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ad516754c8c117171796952e53fedafd0c20d358.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Battle Chat Features[/h1]
If one player destroys a tank that was previously damaged more than 51% by another player, both of them will receive a new notification type. It will show not only the name of the fighter who destroyed the tank, but also the name of the player who assisted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0c3eca1f5ccc844b5fdce8d627e58796adb898dd.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
In the new update, the parameters of many Tier VII vehicles were adjusted. The changes seek to ensure that tanks of this tier and of the same type have comparable performance and can better play their battle role. In addition, the characteristics of Tier VII–X Collector and Premium vehicles were improved. For example, the FV217 Badger tank destroyer is now faster and more accurate. 
[h1]Control Features[/h1]
Partial support of popular gamepad models for Android is back. Also, all supported platforms now feature sensibility and inversion settings. 

The following main control options are set as default: 
•	Android/iOS: "Touch"
•	Windows 10: "Keyboard and Mouse" (displays as permanently disabled for mobile devices) 

When connecting the gamepad, the "Gamepad" control type will be displayed in settings. You'll need to choose it only once. For future instances, it will be enabled automatically.

The "Same Control Mode" will no longer be available for PC. However, it will be preserved for touch devices. This change will essentially decrease the queue time for PC players.
[h1]Camouflage Rotation and Update[/h1]
We're continuing our big Storage spring cleaning! If your Storage is overflowing with camos, there's a solution: Some of them can now be exchanged for Splinters. Splinters can be exchanged for a Camo Container that will always be available in the Store. This Container features different types of camouflage including standard and animated, with free resupply, and for any vehicle tier. The contents will change from time to time.

There are new items in the Camo menu: the Daredevil Legendary camouflage for the Kunze Panzer, the Standard Bearer attachment for the T-22 medium, and the Mighty Legendary camouflage and Spezialset attachment for the Jagdpanzer E 100.

[quote]The Ghost, Unexpectable, and Thunderbolt camos will no longer be available for purchase.[/quote]
[h1]Legendary Camouflage for the T110E3[/h1]
The owners of this menacing tank destroyer will get an individual offer featuring the Bulwark camo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8349500c74296fd5278c2d9b555f9fcfeccd74dc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs [/h1]
[list]
   [*]The Vickers Light, Vickers CR, and FV301 were updated to the new visual quality.
 [*]Missions for new players were reworked. 
 [*]The Mines map was removed from rotation for Tier VII–X Rating battles.
 [*]Object 252U: Spare parts kits are now identified as spaced armor.
 [*]The bug where the sinking tank timer was displayed incorrectly in replays was fixed.
 [*]Issues with volume when loading the game and playing the sound of moving tracks were fixed.
 [*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
 [*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

tags.feature: We reworked the content system of bonus containers (daily, weekly, and three-day containers).

Newcomers will now get more resources like credits, Credit boosters, and Combat XP boosters from these containers to accelerate their game progress. For skilled commanders, there will be Gold and Cooldown boosters. The higher the vehicle tier, the more valuable the content.
Moreover, drop chances will be clearer for all containers in the game.

If one player destroys a tank that was previously damaged more than 51% by another player, both of them will receive a new notification type. It will show not only the name of the fighter who destroyed the tank, but also the name of the player who assisted.

tags.balance_change: In the new update, the parameters of many Tier VII vehicles were adjusted. The changes seek to ensure that tanks of this tier and of the same type have comparable performance and can better play their battle role. In addition, the characteristics of Tier VII–X Collector and Premium vehicles were improved. For example, the FV217 Badger tank destroyer is now faster and more accurate.

tags.feature: Partial support of popular gamepad models for Android is back. Also, all supported platforms now feature sensibility and inversion settings.
The "Same Control Mode" will no longer be available for PC. However, it will be preserved for touch devices. This change will essentially decrease the queue time for PC players.

If your Storage is overflowing with camos, there's a solution: Some of them can now be exchanged for Splinters. Splinters can be exchanged for a Camo Container that will always be available in the Store. This Container features different types of camouflage including standard and animated, with free resupply, and for any vehicle tier. The contents will change from time to time.

There are new items in the Camo menu: the Daredevil Legendary camouflage for the Kunze Panzer, the Standard Bearer attachment for the T-22 medium, and the Mighty Legendary camouflage and Spezialset attachment for the Jagdpanzer E 100.
The owners of this menacing tank destroyer will get an individual offer featuring the Bulwark camo.

tags.bug: The bug where the sinking tank timer was displayed incorrectly in replays was fixed.
Issues with volume when loading the game and playing the sound of moving tracks were fixed.
General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

notes.title: The Resilient TS-5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=u3Z57FYBEl0;full][/previewyoutube]
As it crawls from position to position, the TS-5 methodically takes out foes using its quick-firing gun with high penetration. Enemy return fire will bounce off of the sturdy, rounded cabin, thus making this TD's commander feel powerful and superior. It also earns plenty of shiny credits, so much that it's easier to weigh than count.

[quote]Until July 19, containers that may include TS-5 or other rewards will be available in the Store. Each container has a TS-5 Charm. Collect 25 Charms and get the tank destroyer![/quote]
[h2]Bison Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
In the largest set of containers, you will find a certificate for the Bison Legendary camouflage. You'll also get an offer for this camo some time after your first battle with the TS-5. May the spirit of this mighty beast support you in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7d10e8a17a42260f889127bfa2244e7c6de995b6.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/a868f4f7ed4b72bd6153487fcdde81a7156c7f8f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/20626e0feb54c54362fe392d0af25248eee7fc9a.jpg[/img][/url]   [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f459ad8df46bc1ec03af35b740bdc66a47522119.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6700fc887d304833e165c83af75aafcba041162e.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0bf4c46e101e63e847e7dbfb335f61f87532a854.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/76392a27b64b4617d5a5ed14038ca91f89900412.jpg[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8eb9572b8f0bdd7949933635e0b6ba6230c7f8f9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7c39bfe14ec0d58ec60451a3fa0bdd3bfa0f982f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Confident Attacks, Concrete Defense[/h2]
Thanks to its rounded shape and 250 mm of thick armor, the TS-5 is able to withstand the fire from the most powerful guns. When in a position that hides the vulnerable strip of armor just below the gun, the vehicle becomes almost impenetrable. It's possible to drive it out from its lofty perch only with powerful HE shells or by attacking from the flanks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/23671f58592cfe1535b2a0cefc7bed237d8378e2.jpg[/img]

The TS-5 will perform well as offensive fire support. By following heavy tanks, skillfully maneuvering, and smartly using cover, it's capable of inflicting the lion's share of damage on a group of attackers. If necessary, this vehicle can lead the attack, but only as a last resort. In close combat, the enemy will be able to target the commander's hatch, the armor strip below the gun, and parts of the suspension.

However, you can try to lock fronts against a tank with small elevation/depression angles. When "butting", the enemy won't be able to reach the lower armor plate, and hitting the commander's hatch while actively maneuvering won't be easy. But this is a desperate tactic because there's always the danger that the enemy will aim at your side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4f322917e6443e343eac213f38b559de96105c76.jpg[/img]

Low speed and maneuverability are a fair price to pay for heavy armor. It's better for the TS-5 not to act alone, as even some heavy tanks can circle it. An ally (or better yet, a platoonmate) nearby is the best remedy for such troubles.

The TS-5 has a maximum speed of 26 km/h that it can reach in a matter of seconds. To be useful in battle, constantly stay on the move. As is often the case in regular battles, by the time the TS-5 arrives at the clash, other fighters have already exchanged first shots, which means it's time to join the attack and put pressure on enemies on the chosen route. Or cover the retreat of battered allies and stop the breach.

[b]With 258 mm of penetration, 400 HP of single-shot damage, and a reload time of 8.7 seconds, the TS-5 is an expert at destroying enemy vehicles. Whether it's the front of the hull or the turret, this tank destroyer is able to penetrate most enemies without carefully targeting vulnerable points. Especially strong ones will feel the HEAT, which burns through 340 mm of armor.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cac707f3f11f6ab7ba723c5f7a245a95dbf5896f.jpg[/img]

The combination of a high rate of fire and durable armor gives the TS-5 the ability to deal with enemies without rolling back into cover too often. With ammo and equipment, its potential damage per minute exceeds 3,000 HP. Enemies will have to stand in line to return to the Garage!

tags.balance_change: With 258 mm of penetration, 400 HP of single-shot damage, and a reload time of 8.7 seconds, the TS-5 is an expert at destroying enemy vehicles.

notes.title: Operation Salvation
notes.content:
Become a commander and join the Resistance to save humanity in the latest World of Tanks Blitz operation! This battle will be a fierce one. But if you manage to survive, you won't only free Earth, but you'll also earn resources, Collector vehicles, camos, and other rewards.

[previewyoutube=tj53rMYC09M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Get Rewards[/h2]
To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

The Operation includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to everyone with a regular Pass, meaning all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Microchips: 10 Microchips = 1 Level.

Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Microchips per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Microchips. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Microchips a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

[h2]When Does Operation Salvation Take Place?[/h2]
[list]
[*] CIS: July 1, 8:00 (MSK) to July 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: July 1, 14:00 (CEST) to July 29, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: July 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to July 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: July 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to July 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]What Rewards Can I Get?[/h2]
There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/acb0744daa99756ffedd09f72944a5f85a84e8de.jpg[/img]

With Premium Pass, the T40 Tier IV tank destroyer awaits you at Level 1. The gun's decent characteristics and weak armor define its playstyle. When being used as a sniper, the T40 is at its best. Hide behind cover, target an enemy's weak spot, deal damage, and—content with your job—watch the enemy's health points rapidly decrease. 

And at Level 35, the BLTZ9000 tank will be added to your Garage. Its mechanics were based on that of an M18 Hellcat adapted to the harsh realities of a cybernetic world (just take a look at that Minigun attachment!). Luckily for us, this fighter is ready to take on rebellious vehicles and fight for humanity. With speed and stealth—its main advantages—the BLTZ9000 quickly changes positions, aims fast, and features a great reloading speed. And when it attacks, it can remain unseen. With you as the commander, it's ready to win and lead humanity to liberation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3a416db0add937aeb7de81ccba17ab00ace559b6.jpg[/img]

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/event/battle-pass-11/]MORE DETAILS[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Blitz Turns 7: Entertainment Coming Soon!
notes.content:
The 7th birthday of World of Tanks Blitz is coming soon! This means there will be even more in-game events, specials, bonuses, and gifts than usual. At the huge Blitzland theme park, where the monthly Operation is already taking place, new attractions are opening up. Check out the current events guide and let's celebrate together!

[previewyoutube=G1LF2y9Rga4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Shooting Gallery[/h2]
Open June 14–June 21
Shooting Gallery counts medals, badges, and victories. 

To participate in the medal and badge count, bring medals and badges to the Shooting Gallery and exchange them for resources:
[list]
[*] High Caliber medal: 1 day of Premium Account
[*] Top Gun medal: 1 certificate for x3 XP
[*] Ace Tanker badge: 3 Gold boosters
[/list] 
To take part in the victory count, just [b]win 20 battles[/b] before the Shooting Gallery closes. If you do, you'll get the main prize—the Pz. IV Gargoyle Tier V Collector tank! 

[url=wotblitz.com/news/media/birthday-events/ style=button]LEARN MORE![/url]

[h2]Strength-o-Meter[/h2]
Open June 21–June 28

Once the Shooting Gallery closes, visit the Strength-o-Meter tent. 

[quote]You'll need to cause as much damage as you can in 10 battles. You can start a new series of battles once a day each day while the Strength-o-Meter is open.[/quote]
So that some random incident doesn't ruin your result, you can start the series of 10 battles only by tapping "Ready!" Before you start, we recommend you warm up properly and select a high-tier tank. 

Depending on your achievements, you can win Gold boosters, Premium Account, and the Urban Spark Rare camouflage from the Strength-o-Meter. If you manage to strike the maximum result, a shiny new Kunze Panzer Tier VII Premium tank will become yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/28b05858eeebe347e19c85c03068d337b3bcf1e7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Souvenir Stall[/h2]
Open June 21–June 28

There are... souvenirs... available at the Souvenir Stall! You can buy tanks from the game's previous birthdays, the Crucible profile background, the Unforgettable 7 avatar, and containers with various camos as a keepsake for this magnificent celebration.

You'll need Tickets to purchase souvenirs. You can get them from bundles with gold.

[h2]Ceremonial Gift-Giving[/h2]
Open June 16–July 16

You'll receive a festive container on a separate stage. This container includes Premium Account, gold, Free XP, and an avatar. If you've been playing the game for a long time, you'll also find a Rare or Epic camouflage. Players who have been playing the game for 5+ years will receive an additional container with a Tier V or Tier VII tank! Note: Your account should be created before June 14, 2021. 

Take what's yours and tell your friends all about it!

[h2]Special![/h2]
Open June 25–June 28

During the celebration, a special with bonuses and discounts will be available in the game! Enjoy five times more XP for victories, a bonus on converting Elite XP to Free XP, and DISCOUNTS on almost everything: researchable and Premium tanks in the Tech Tree, camos and attachments, crew training, Garage slots, provisions, consumables, and equipment. 

Well, what can we say? When we celebrate, we celebrate BIG!

[quote]Check out the detailed schedule and conditions of all events in the game.[/quote]

notes.title: Update 8.0
notes.content:
[quote=author]Download the new version starting June 8![/quote]
[previewyoutube=X10XqM_3Ees;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]More Tanks[/h1]
We recreated American experimental concepts presented in 1953. Four Tier VII–X heavy tanks are ready to be researched! The new Americans are eager to attack, and the high-tier tanks are capable of elegantly retreating since they're equipped with emergency tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c2bf1b095916805b69bd9b6ce278f9724e0e39bb.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Realism[/h1]
Check out massive graphics improvements! Each tank will have an individually tuned dynamic suspension. It won't affect gameplay, but the laws of physics never looked so beautiful in action!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7961fcbaf6552289fe176154007e12746508c975.jpg[/img]

An even bigger change awaits! We're going to update vehicles to a new graphics quality! What does this mean? Check out the new Yohs: all materials look and seem more realistic. Tanks can become covered in snow or mud. And they clean off after being rinsed down by water. We will gradually rework all tanks so that your gaming experience will become even more immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d54bd68b69e2bf8c9c2ff47793850c4a065a06a7.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Comfort, More Style[/h1]
Now, camos that you have a suitable certificate for are marked with an exclamation sign in the Camo menu of each tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/2d88712f08f52c5d242c03d59a002707d4f8be56.jpg[/img]

The Instigator Legendary camouflage for the TVP 50/51 is now available in the camo selection menu.
[quote=author]The Hardy, Oriental Waves, and Staunch Defender camos will no longer be available for purchase. [/quote]
[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1]
- Smasher. The bug where AP shells didn't lose penetration over distances was fixed.
- Now the Camo menu becomes available once the player gets a Tier IV tank.
- The bug where auto-aim switched to a passing tank was fixed.
- Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
- General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

notes.title: Operation Blitzland
notes.content:
Welcome to Blitzland, a magical place where half the world's joy and happiness is stored. At Blitzland, you'll see rivers of sparkling water and mountains of cotton candy. But most importantly, there are tons of crazy, breathtaking rides.
Fasten your seatbelt, commander! Master the roller coasters of Blitzland and get cool rewards, including resources, avatars, camos, and Collector tanks!

[previewyoutube=Kk8Vsn6vPbc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]How to Get Rewards[/h1]
To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

The Operation includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to everyone with a regular Pass, meaning all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Tokens: 10 Tokens = 1 Level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/155c7ec6fd0ab907f941b1f2b7d1d775554c8896.jpg[/img]

Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually. 
You can earn up to 30 Tokens per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Tokens. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Tokens a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

[h1]When Does Operation Blitzland Take Place?[/h1]
• CIS: June 1, 8:00 (MSK) to June 29, 8:00 (MSK)
• Europe: June 1, 14:00 (CEST) to June 29, 14:00 (CEST)
• North America: June 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to June 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
• Asia: June 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to June 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)

[h1]What Rewards Can I Get?[/h1]
[i]There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks![/i]
With Premium Pass, the A-32 Tier IV medium tank awaits you at Level 1. This fast and maneuverable vehicle is an expert at surprises—it's perfect for sudden flanking attacks and blistering raids behind enemy lines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c8df510bcb1a8df5dc710571206e5e562b4e557d.jpg[/img]

And at Level 35, the Turbo, a unique Tier VI medium tank, will be added to your Garage. This vehicle was designed for fun and joy! Good mobility and maneuverability enable it to spin clumsy heavy tanks around like a carousel, while its quick-firing, fast-aiming gun can unleash loads of shells right at them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1b2c6d01f1bebd674a90a623473ab0f887dd0e85.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Skirmish
notes.content:
Surge into Skirmish, the crazy-fast mode where you'll always be in the middle of the action! Compete inside small, compact battle zones where there's no chance for a retreat and no time to think. And remember—only the fastest, most accurate, and most decisive warriors will win!

[previewyoutube=W7rllS3KDMc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Schedule[/h1]
Here's when you can fight in Skirmish:
[b]May 21—May 24[/b]
• CIS: May 21, 8:00 (MSK) to May 24, 2:00 (MSK)
• Europe: May 21, 8:00 (CEST) to May 24, 2:00 (CEST)
• North America: May 21, 8:00 (PT) / 11:00 (ET) to May 23, 23:00 (PT) / May 24, 2:00 (ET)
• Asia: May 21, 8:00 (UTC+8) to May 24, 2:00 (UTC+8)

[b]May 28—May 31[/b]
• CIS: May 28, 8:00 (MSK) to May 31, 2:00 (MSK)
• Europe: May 28, 8:00 (CEST) to May 31, 2:00 (CEST)
• North America: May 28, 8:00 (PT) / 11:00 (ET) to May 30, 23:00 (PT) / May 31, 2:00 (ET)
• Asia: May 28, 8:00 (UTC+8) to May 31, 2:00 (UTC+8)

Participate in Quick Tournaments under Skirmish rules!
Dates: [b]May 21 and May 28[/b]. Registration for participation starts on the day of the tournament and closes half an hour prior to the end.
Tournaments are held separately for three vehicle categories: Tiers V–VI, VII–VIII, and IX–X.
Battle format: 5v5
Control mode: Mixed

notes.title: Operation Victory Road
notes.content:
Make your way down Victory Road in the latest Operation in World of Tanks Blitz! As you go, you'll discover not only honor and glory but also resources, Collector vehicles, camos, and other rewards.

[previewyoutube=nlGv58FjNHU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Get Rewards[/h2]
To participate in the event, you'll need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

Operation Victory Road includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper progression is available to everyone with a regular Pass, meaning all players. The lower progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Flags: 10 Flags = 1 Level.

Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Flags per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional daily mission that provides an extra 10 Flags. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Flags a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

[h2]When Does Operation Victory Road Take Place?[/h2]
[list]
[*] CIS: May 1, 8:00 (MSK) to May 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: May 1, 14:00 (CEST) to May 29, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: May 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to May 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: May 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to May 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)

There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f0bbd13f5376cdbff3d9c035fbe4899a1cbbd321.jpg[/img]

With Premium Pass, the M3 Lee Tier IV medium tank awaits you at Level 1. Considering how it resembles a tank destroyer, playing it as such is the recommended way forward. Find a safe ambush position and give the enemy a good idea of what high damage and a penetrating gun entail!

And at Level 35, the Triumphant tank will be added to your Garage. This hero has everything you need to score victories! To start with, it has a penetrating gun capable of dealing sizable damage to foes bold enough to attack. On top of that, it enjoys excellent speed and maneuverability, which is exactly what you need to conveniently whirl around opponents and quickly change positions. And check out its appearance! It's a look befitting a hero. Charge into battle and show your enemies what you've got!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e561068a9389d5e6cb6b72735a5ea0098b59adfa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 7.9
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IqZRKVmjVgA;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting April 27! [/quote]
[h2]A Smooth Entrance into the Game[/h2]
We reworked the tutorial! From now on, newly-minted commanders won't be sent to the proving grounds. Instead, they'll find themselves in 5-on-5 battles on the Mines map. The first battles will be accompanied by hints depending on the situation. For example, "Enable Aiming mode" in case of a miss or "Target gray parts" in case of a non-penetrating hit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/21e45590bca439ddfa7e0b964ef417bc9ddc8f88.jpg[/img]

The first tank that a newcomer will take into battle will be one of these three famous combat vehicles: the Tiger, the T-34-85, or the Sherman. Moreover, the number of bots will gradually decrease.

[h2]Updated Mines[/h2]
It now has its own special atmosphere! We added effects, actions, and indestructible objects outside the playable part of the map and improved terrain textures. Now, there are planes flying in the sky and warships fighting in the sea. Every new player's first three battles will happen on Mines. But the map will remain available for battles of all tiers.

Mirage and Lost Temple are being reworked and will temporarily be unavailable in the game. They will return with improvements to visuals and gameplay. Both maps will be made available for more tiers, while Mirage will receive a version for Supremacy.
[h2]Colorblind Mode[/h2]
Colorblind mode was added to graphics settings for those who see the world just a bit differently. It changes the colors of important elements in battle so that players with color blindness, such as deuteranomaly, protanopia, and deuteranopia, can better distinguish them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ea1ce09eb8a419f097190bbd02253788a9646e19.jpg[/img]

[quote]This option may affect game performance on some mobile devices. 
[/quote]
[h2]Order in Storage[/h2]
It's time for some spring cleaning! All resources are now carefully divided among four tabs: Certificates, Appearance, Boosters, and Other. What's more, we got rid of excessive tapping. To remove the red dot for new items, you need only scroll down the screen. Red dots will also be removed from accumulative avatars, and they will only appear on the latest avatar in the chain.
[h2]News for the Jagdpanzer E 100[/h2]
It finally happened! If the Jagdpanzer E 100 existed in reality, this is what it would look like. After your first battle in this powerful tank destroyer, you may receive a personal offer for the Mighty Legendary camouflage and Spezialset attachment. There are no bells or whistles—just historical insignia and vivid colors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/2b99c654fdb0fcdf4672daae9f367a31237afabb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Controller Support [/h2]
We returned partial support for popular controller models on iOS, Android, and Windows 10. Now, with the help of a controller, you can do more than just shoot, aim, and move. You can also enable/disable auto-aim, use the Lookout Area camera mode, and switch between shell types. Besides that, the sensitivity of both sticks was adjusted and Garage controls were added. 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, just a small number of changes was made to vehicle characteristics. The T-34-100 received improved armor under the turret. Previously, it could be easily penetrated by HE shells. Ammunition capacity increased from 65 to 70 shells and 45 to 48 shells for the Crusader and T54Е1, respectively.  [h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list][*]Container infoscreens were reworked. Their content is now more informative. You can even preview vehicles and camos. 
[*] The sounds of switching shells during battle and tanks exploding in Aiming mode were adjusted.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.7
notes.content:
[h2]Meet the Czechoslovakians![/h2]
Joining the lineup of the European nation is a branch with five researchable Tier VI–X medium tanks! They are all dynamic fighters with powerful weapons. Three tanks feature quick autoloaders, while two boast classic cannons with high penetration and impressive single-shot damage. At Tier X, the fast and maneuverable TVP T 50/51 awaits with a four-shell magazine-based gun capable of dealing 1,240 HP of damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8a9896d580ded929370bb5403c64aa769fd6378b.jpg[/img]

[h2]For Newbies and Skilled Players[/h2]
Here's an opportunity for all players to enlarge their tank collection! From now on, after completing the tutorial, each new commander will take part in Steel Raid. This event includes a special mission that will help players better understand the game mechanics while rewarding success with the Т6Е1 and other resources. Experienced players can exchange Mastery Badges for Loza's M4-A2 Sherman during the Assemble event.
[h2]Updating Sound![/h2]
We’ve started the process of replacing the game’s sound engine with a better one, which will enable us to gradually perform a complete sound renewal. At first, the new engine will only be available for some devices. Later on, it will be introduced for all platforms. We haven't made any major changes yet. You may notice a slight difference in the tone of sounds in battle and in the Garage, which might seem a little unusual at first. In the future, all the old files will be replaced, the game sounds will become richer, and national voiceovers and much more will be introduced.
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2][list]
[*] Support for iPad 3 is ending as its technical characteristics can no longer provide a comfortable gaming experience, even at low settings. In the future, this device will stop receiving updates. 
[*] The bug where the provisions panel was displayed instead of the modifications/abilities panel after the battle start countdown in Mad Games and Uprising was fixed.
[*] The bug where the player's position and minimap markers weren't displayed for the platoon mate after the player respawns in Uprising was fixed.
[*] The bug where the name of the tank was displayed in white despite its type on the Rating: Favorite Tanks screen was fixed. Premium tanks are now displayed in gold and Collector tanks in blue. 
[*] The areas where vehicles would become stuck were fixed and some models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps. 
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: The Quickscoping M41D
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=O3AyUqXChOY;full][/previewyoutube]
This Lunar New Year, not only will the strong and proud Ox come to the battlefield, but so will the fast and furious M41D! Ready to unleash a devastating, accurate firestorm, this nimble sniper will easily outmaneuver the enemy.

[quote]During Lunar Rising, you may receive an offer to acquire the M41D. Grab this new Chinese Tier VII light tank before it's too late![/quote]
[h2]Jade Legendary Camouflage[/h2]

In one of the bundles, you'll find the Jade Legendary camouflage in addition to the tank. The dragon on the camo will give the enemy a hint of who'll they be fighting with! At the same time, the tank's battle name will change to M41D Jade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4bd9ba64873d9c9505ab41ac94cc05821ab6521a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4f484081793df3fc56ff3373c190c92d487c2fd9.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Nippy Scout[/h2]

The M41D is a light tank that perfectly combines speed and maneuverability with decent firepower. It's time for it to wreak havoc on the battlefield! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/83fcb336c0816e242e27b84910a226f66706dcf7.jpg[/img]

This Chinese fighter is a version of the American M41 Walker Bulldog, which is why it features good dynamics. Thanks to the 30.1 hp/t power-to-weight ratio, it can quickly accelerate to 70 km/h. Just what you need to effectively scout and spot! 

It's also great at changing positions. After dealing with one enemy, you'll be able to quickly withdraw before falling victim to return fire. Due to the M41D's weak armor, any enemy shell could prove devastating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6f8170b33842d154e4ab3f62afdae053331280a7.jpg[/img]

In order to deal with enemies, the M41D has everything a tank might need! To begin with, it has two types of APCR shells. While the first penetrates 160 mm of armor and inflicts 170 HP of damage, the second penetrates 220 mm and inflicts 145 HP of damage, making it excellent for strong enemies. The reloading time of 4.03 s enables this tank to shoot two or three shells at a confused enemy without fear of losing its HP or reputation.

The gun's 8-degree depression angle allows the vehicle to not only effectively spot enemies from behind hills, but also to fire at them. All you need to do is change positions. Don't wait for the enemy to figure out where your shells are coming from. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/39a1fc2af51559994cee9fd47307bf02c03d326e.jpg[/img]

And remember: the front line is not your cup of oolong. You'll enjoy much more success by providing fire support to your allies from the second line (which will be quite feasible with the M41D's gun!) or sniping from safe distances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/03acd3d52d287456d13f58549f64565ea1d00ebe.jpg[/img]

During battles in the M41D, your goal is to make a commotion and hide before the enemy can connect the dots and take aim at you. This requires careful action, but it will ensure memorable battles, piles of XP and credits, and a spot as one of the top players by damage dealt!

In one of the bundles, you'll find the Jade Legendary camouflage in addition to the tank.

notes.title: Operation Lichun
notes.content:
To kick off the new lunar year, World of Tanks Blitz will celebrate Lichun—the beginning of spring. Our battlefields will prove fruitful by providing resources, Collector vehicles, camos, and other rewards to hard-working and fearless commanders. 

[h2]How to Get Rewards?
[/h2]
To participate in the event, you need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 
Operation Lichun has two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper (silver) progression is available to regular Pass owners. In other words, all players. The lower (gold) progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Coins: 10 Coins = 1 Level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7ebdda4ccc50e0eb93d1c3bb8e17b56c062c2198.jpg[/img]

[quote]Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually. At the beginning of the Operation, 4 levels will be unlocked.[/quote]
You can earn up to 30 Coins per day. Premium Pass owners enjoy access to an additional mission that provides an extra 10 Coins. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Coins a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

[h2]When Does Operation Lichun Take Place?
[/h2][list]
[*] CIS: from February 1, 8:00 (MSK) to February 28, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: from February 1, 13:00 (CET) to February 28, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: from February 1, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET) to February 28, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: from February 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to February 28, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]What Rewards Can I Get?
[/h2]There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!
With Premium Pass, the T-28 Tier IV medium tank awaits you at Level 1. The accurate, rapid-firing gun, decent damage, and fast turret make it an ideal support vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/12eb699770fff630b06f48e171adfe7f9a1db646.jpg[/img]

And at Level 35, the Ox tank will be added to your Garage. Its sloped armor can withstand the fiercest moments of intense battles, while the good dynamics and nice maximum speed will carry you to victory, no matter the obstacle. The large pointed horns and massive ring will strike terror in your foes! That is the 
Ox Tier VI medium tank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0997f6493ce3734d49f46ae212db66e6bec83d3e.jpg[/img]

More Details in the Game!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GFzAcqbFrN4;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting January 27![/quote]
[h2]For Observant Tankers[/h2]

A new Free Camera function was introduced to replays. This function makes it easier to study maps or view battle situations in detail. And taking cool screenshots and videos became a breeze!

Legendary warpaints, such as Blade for the VK 90.01(P), Intrepid for the T25 Pilot Number 1, Shark for the T54E2, Fiery Serpent for the WZ-111 model 5A, and both Nidhögg and Nord for the Kranvagn, are now available in the camo selection menu.

notes.title: The Dreaded Viking EMIL 1951
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=yURyvdQm-Kk;full][/previewyoutube]
A powerful and piercing gun with a 3-shell magazine, a sturdy turret, and a great depression angle—meet the new EMIL 1951 Premium tank. Welcome this mighty Swedish warrior to your collection and earn impressive amounts of credits each battle!

[quote]Containers that may have the EMIL 1951 or other rewards will be available in the in-game Store until January 22. Each container has EMIL 1951 Charms. Collect 25 Charms to get the tank![/quote]
[h2]Viking Legendary Camouflage[/h2]

Some time after your first battle in the EMIL 1951, you might get an offer for a Legendary camo that changes the tank's name in battle to EMIL 1951 Viking. The tank will be decorated with a pattern, round shields, a banner on a spear shaft, a battle horn, and poleaxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e2a7185eb5fc6e87122318f02eb64587ef395d25.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1cef86bea38bebd268e4d2598057a31825af9ac4.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Born Warrior[/h2]

The EMIL 1951 is a heavy tank that effectively combines an autoloading system, a 10-degree depression angle, and a robust turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/700d7ccd1079b6d1480c5d69d1682ffaafeadfa6.jpg[/img]

On level ground, during battle, the EMIL 1951 turret withstands hits from guns that penetrate up to 240 mm. If you put the 10-degree gun depression to use and place the tank on a hillside, the armor of your turret will also become impregnable for guns with 270 mm of penetration. It's critical to take advantage of your turret because the hull armor is quite vulnerable against most opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/92530b9059ba500dc59087c54a58e4bafc1ca8e7.jpg[/img]

The EMIL 1951 slays enemies with a gun that boasts an autoloading system and a 3-shell magazine. Thanks to its 230 mm of penetration, this tank can damage enemies with every shot it takes and deal an average of 930 HP of damage per magazine! APCR shells will come to the rescue when encountering a heavily armored foe as they can penetrate 270 mm and inflict 780 HP of damage per magazine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d95fd4e13d18cd89c260dd53aaf7f6970cad5a67.jpg[/img]

Reloading takes 3 seconds, which means the EMIL 1951 fires all 3 shells in just 6 seconds. After that, the tank needs to retreat behind some cover and wait 22 seconds for the magazine to reload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d7cb348e0617ab08e02bd0cbd152ce57a4924e0e.jpg[/img]

Even though it's a heavy tank, the EMIL 1951 has quite a low profile and weighs only 26 tons. It's even lighter than the T-54 ltwt.! The 350 h.p. engine, however, makes this tank march with the dignity of a huge, looming heavy. Its acceleration enables this heavy to achieve 20 km/h in 3 seconds and 30 km/h in about 8 seconds. Without equipment and provisions, the vehicle can reach its maximum speed of 40 km/h when going downhill only. Thanks to the high reverse speed, the EMIL 1951 is able to swiftly retreat to cover.

notes.title: Operation Eternal Winter
notes.content:
World of Tanks Blitz is traveling to an alternative future where Earth is covered in ice and snow while humanity struggles to survive. But not all is lost as this harsh, cold world rewards your efforts with resources, tanks, and other prizes. Unafraid of a challenge? Then join us for Operation Eternal Winter!
[h2]How to Get Rewards?
[/h2]To participate in the in-game event, you need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 
Operation Eternal Winter includes two reward progressions, each consisting of 80 levels. The upper (silver) progression is available to everyone with a regular Pass, meaning all players. The lower (gold) progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Cryotainers: 10 Cryotainers = 1 Level.

Although your Level increases automatically, you will need to collect your rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Cryotainers per day. Premium Pass owners get access to an additional mission that provides an extra 10 Cryotainers. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Cryotainers a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.
[h2]When Does Operation Eternal Winter Take Place?
[/h2]• CIS: from January 2, 8:00 (MSK) to January 30, 8:00 (MSK)
• Europe: from January 2, 13:00 (CET) to January 30, 13:00 (CET)
• North America: from January 2, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET) to January 30, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET)
• Asia: from January 2, 14:00 (UTC+8) to January 30, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[h2]What Rewards Can I Get?
[/h2]There will be huge amounts of resources, themed camos and avatars, a profile background, certificates for XP bonuses for victories, and Collector tanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4052a44f2e031782026e33dff47446bf36080695.png[/img]

With Premium Pass, you'll get the Pz.Kpfw. II Luchs, a Tier IV light tank, at Level 1. Armed with a quick-firing gun, this nimble tank is an ideal scout that can whirl around any enemy.

And at Level 35, the Icebreaker, a unique Tier VI heavy tank, will be added to your Garage. This tank, powered by a cryogenic engine, is the child of the Eternal Winter. Its parts give off a cold glow, its armor is tempered by the harsh frost, and its commander's heart won't be melted by the hottest battles in history!

notes.title: Update 7.5
notes.content:
The Garage is covered in snow, a magical train is tooting along, the ground crunches beneath your feet, distant planets are approaching... This Update is going to be loaded, magical, and festive! We'll tell you about the events a bit later, so for now, here's a look at the main changes, balance tweaks, and fixes.

[h2]ATGMs for Fun Modes[/h2]Missiles will be removed for the guns of the T92E1 and XM551 Sheridan. Instead of ATGMs, they'll be able to use HEAT shells with the same penetration and damage. However, fans of missiles will still have an opportunity to fire them as such players will receive the ATGM-equipped Sheridan Missile Collector tank as a gift. This tank can play in Uprising, Gravity Force, Burning Games, and other fun modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c219c4a6e35548d33b6bab5af9f077b0b41d3a72.jpg[/img]

[h2]Holiday Camos[/h2]
Ideal for a cold winter, warm camos like the cozy Grandma's Gift, dreamy Starlight Night, and scented Evergreen are making their return to the camo selection menu. Dress up and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/216f6e3509834e0f02ab5937a21b55494a066504.jpg[/img]

[i]The Sinister Traces, Galaxy, Vertigo, Shattered Flames, and Flux camos will no longer be available for purchase.[/i]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
Many Tier VI tanks became more effective: the T-2020 is stronger, the Bat.-Chatillon 25 t reloads shells in its magazine faster, and the KpfPz 70 penetrates more frequently and inflicts more damage. Some changes affected high-tier Swedish and British tanks.

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs
[/h2][list]
[*] For portable and mobile devices, joystick inversion to move backwards was added. This option is disabled by default and available via the Controls tab in Settings.
[*] Nintendo: the bug with incorrect reading of controls type when running the game with a disabled joy-con was fixed.
[*] Nintendo: the bug with incorrect link navigation on info screens was fixed.
[*] iOS: the bug when an email address wasn't linked to the game account when using the "Sign in with Apple" function was fixed.
[*] The bug when sound didn't work upon switching camouflage season slots was fixed.
[*] The bug when Pyroleum Boosters were still displayed in the booster panel was fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.4
notes.content:
[i]Download the new version starting November 11![/i]

[previewyoutube=IkvghJcKDPE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Shot Result Status[/h2] "Enemy is hit!" But where? Which tank part did you damage? From now on, everything will be clearer! Upon a ricochet or non-penetrating hit, as well as upon damaging or destroying a module, you'll see a corresponding icon and text on the screen. The text color also indicates the extent of the damage: red means the module was knocked out of action, orange shows the module was critically damaged, and white refers to minor damage to the module, as well as non-penetrating hits. If you damaged several modules to different extents with a single shot, the results of the heaviest damage will be shown.

[i]This setting is enabled by default, but you can disable it completely or select icons without text at any time. The shot result status is available for all modes except Realistic Battles.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c8a973481330313069127511eb017989a69690cf.jpg[/img]

[h2]Clan Missions
[/h2] Honors have become tangible! Earned <icon> Honors will now allow you to receive credits, Free XP, unique camouflage, Premium Account, boosters, and even gold. But be aware that a lone wolf won't get these trophies as the new type of missions is only available to clan players. The contribution of each player is critically important! Join a clan, complete Personal and Clan Missions, earn Honors, and receive a reward every week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1d36bb6ddda25174e690631efad97fb291dd8894.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Avatars for Victories[/h2] The Skirmish! and Space Corps accumulative avatars for victories in Skirmish and Gravity Force battles were introduced. These modes appear in the game from time to time. Follow the news to learn when they're available and earn a brand new avatar! 

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2] This time, changes were made to the characteristics of tank destroyers. Many Tier VI–VIII TDs received increased penetration and damage. The AT 8, Jagdpanther, T28, and other vehicles became more dangerous. In addition, the research cost of several modules was changed.

[url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-7-4/]Learn more![/url]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LAN3RHGqcR0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LAN3RHGqcR0[/previewyoutube]

Spy games in World of Tanks Blitz! A top-secret tank, cloak-and-dagger avatars, mysterious camouflage, and lots of other rewards await you in a new Operation.

[h2]How to get rewards?[/h2]

To participate in the in-game event, you need a Tier III vehicle or higher. 

Operation Off The Grid includes two reward progressions, each of which is divided into 80 levels. The upper (silver) progression is available to everyone with a regular Pass, meaning all players. The lower (gold) progression is only available to Premium Pass holders. Increase the Level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Negatives: 10 Negatives = 1 Level.

Although the Level increases automatically, you will need to collect the rewards manually.

You can earn up to 30 Negatives per day. Premium Pass owners get access to an additional mission that provides an extra 10 Negatives. With Premium Pass, you can earn 40 Negatives a day and unlock 4 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your Level using gold.

[h2]When does Operation Off The Grid take place?[/h2]

[list]
[*] CIS: from November 1, 8:00 (MSK) to November 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: from November 1, 13:00 (CET) to November 29, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: from November 1, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET) to November 29, 05:00 (PT) / 08:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: from November 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to November 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]

[h2]What tanks can I get?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/bf507c65445d0aaa85e075d116649152a35b01c6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Burning Games
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c1fd26f81b487f560b53f2d0ee9fcc22c1325c91.jpg[/img]
You know, buddy, life in the Wasteland is no picnic. You never know what'll come rolling at you from behind the nearest hill: a traveling circus, an ant the size of a bus, or a band of raiders. But of course, it's mostly raiders. In such an environment, you need something to keep your spirits up. And I don't mean your ordinary kind of entertainment. Luckily for you, I know exactly where to find it—in the rocking, crazy town of Rock City!
It all began about a year ago. In his dream, a local genius called "the Professor" saw a formula for a special fuel that can be made from sand, mud, and oily rags. And believe me, we've got more than enough of this stuff! But... the fuel turned out to be too strong. Pour it in the fuel tank and the vehicle just starts to burn up, its HP supply getting depleted right before your eyes! The weird thing is, if you deal damage to an enemy vehicle, it will restore some of your vehicle's HP. If you fire at an ally, you'll heal their tank a little. Don't ask how it works cause no one really knows! The Professor said something about beta decay and quantum entanglement. Then he filled our tanks with this fuel and created this whole mess... 

[i]And that's how the Burning Games started. Burning Games is a mode where your tank's HP burns up right before your eyes, leaving you balancing on the edge. Act fast to snatch your opponents' HP and make their precious points yours! Heal your allies and return to battle even after being destroyed! [/i]
[previewyoutube=tzW-1lTOkcI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you found this journal before October 24 and you have a Tier V vehicle or higher, join Burning Games and see for yourself! But just between us, Rock City has some fierce, adrenaline-packed battles, excellent music, and generous loot to offer. Especially if you dare to follow the Way of the Raider! Hit the road, Commander! 
[h1]Schedule [/h1]
Fight in Burning Games from October 16 to October 24
• CIS: from October 16, 8:00 (MSK) to October 24, 2:00 (MSK)
• Europe: from October 16, 14:00 (CEST) to October 24, 2:00 (CEST)
• North America: from October 16, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to October 23, 23:00 (PT) / October 24, 2:00 (ET)
• Asia: from October 16, 14:00 (UTC+8) to October 24, 2:00 (UTC+8) 

Every night, Burning Games becomes temporarily unavailable:
• CIS: from 2:00 (MSK) to 8:00 (MSK)
• Europe: from 2:00 (CEST) to 8:00 (CEST)
• North America: from 23:00 (PT) / 2:00 (ET) to 8:00 (PT) / 11:00 (ET)
• Asia: from 2:00 (UTC+8) to 8:00 (UTC+8)
[i]Burning Games battles don't affect your stats.[/i]
[h1]To Enter Burning Games [/h1]
To join a Burning Games battle, select it in the menu next to the "Battle!" button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ee3a652923821924b894b6bb6ebbe31bd950a0d1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Briefing[/h1]
[i]Only Tier V–X vehicles are allowed in this mode.[/i]

Since you found this journal, let me share some advice on how to succeed in Burning Games.
• Don't waste your time! 20 seconds into a battle, the vehicle will start losing hit points. The good news is, even in the worst-case scenario, the total amount of HP won't fall below 1 on its own. But then a well-placed enemy shot will easily wipe you out. So stay sharp!
• To hold out in battle for as long as possible, you'll have to leech HP from opponents. By dealing damage to enemy vehicles, you'll be able to partially restore your HP reserve. The logic is simple: the more damage you deal, the more HP you'll restore. And if an enemy vehicle is destroyed in the process, you'll get 'healthier' with some additional hit points. 
• If an ally has it bad and needs 'healing', the advice is the same—shoot. Every hit on an allied vehicle restores some of its HP and earns you additional XP and credits at the end of the battle. 
• And don't forget to capture bases! This way you'll replenish the HP pool for the whole team and slow down the HP depletion speed. If you lose a base, your hit points will start fading away at the regular speed. More good news is that bases are captured faster than usual! 
• And the most interesting part is that if your vehicle gets destroyed, that's not the end for it. You'll have a chance to return to the battlefield once more, and this time, you'll be even more dangerous than before! Your tank will enjoy increased speed, engine power, and single-shot damage, along with a reduced reload time.

[i]When I asked the Professor just how all this was possible, he started rolling his eyes like a lunatic before shouting "It's physics!!!" and running off into the desert. By the way, he still hasn't returned. [/i]
Ah, I nearly forgot! Here's your main advice: to succeed in battle and score as much XP and credits as possible, it's not enough just to smash opponents left and right. You need to catch up on all fronts: destroy enemy vehicles, deal damage, heal allies, and capture bases.
