notes.title: Update 7.3
notes.content:
[h2]Swedish Tanks
[/h2]The Tech Tree of the European Nation has grown a new, strong branch consisting of Tier VI–X tanks! The Swedes have brought national food for their provisions. Among consumables for higher-tier tanks, you will find Improved Engine Power Boost and Reticle Calibration. On top of that, two Legendary camouflages are available for the Tier X Kranvagn at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/dddc8097913467ca4ac56bba553fa0d16d357770.jpg[/img]

[h2]You Shall Pass! 
[/h2]We fixed crossing capacity and got rid of bugs. Low-silhouette tanks will no longer drown under the bridges in the center of the Canal map. It is now easier to destroy logs on Copperfield. From now on, vehicles won't get stuck on the crest of the waterfall on Yukon, or near the water tower on Alpenstadt. On top of that, the issue where shells didn't pass through the slit in the door of the hangar on Himmelsdorf has been fixed.

[h2]Brutality is the Color of the Season
[/h2]Such severe warpaints as Fire Sentinel, Hardy, and Oxidized Metal are back in the camo selection menu. The costs vary from 65 gold to 750 gold, depending on the vehicle tier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/47f48757d1f29fcff861a3cc4e88c28d91e90e32.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8cc5c369c92fc2458b2fa87253cbe157b62125ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/84714dc3dd0e523e3a5e08639748320e0e9fb1a3.jpg[/img]

[i]The Jade Shards, Golden Carp, and Effective Concealment warpaints are no longer available for purchase.
[/i]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
• The camera sensitivity default settings have been changed from 95% to 120% in arcade mode and from 65% to 100% in sniper mode. Also, the gyroscope sensitivity has been decreased.
• The navigation panel has been added for the Consumables and Provisions screens.
• The Minus button now displays/hides the list of players.
• The bug where the Plus button didn't open the Store screen when switching from the Avatars screen has been fixed.
• Upon spending and returning in-game currency at the same time, a total final figure is now displayed instead of two ratios—"Will be returned" and "Will be deducted".
• On the Provisions and Consumables screens, if consumables are not applied, the most effective one is selected by default.
• Destroying the IS-2 Chinese heavy tank now counts towards The Lion of Sinai medal.
• The Allies HP restored ribbon has been added for some modes.
• During the pre-battle countdown, the boosters panel is now also displayed when team lists are hidden (previously, it was only displayed when the lists were shown).
• The cases of incorrect reload indication during the pre-battle countdown have been fixed.
• The bug where some logos didn't load on the tournament page has been fixed.
• The bug where the Watching Ads button didn't disappear from the battle results screen after watching an ad has been fixed.
• The bug where the vehicle panel position wasn't saved upon going to another menu and upon returning to the Garage later has been fixed.
• Various screens, descriptions, and notifications have been improved.
• General bugs and client crashes have been fixed.

[h2]Balance Improvements
[/h2]We're continuing to work on the game comfort when playing in lower-tier vehicles. In this update, the changes affected the maneuverability of several tanks, such as the M7, A20, R35, Matilda, М5 Stuart, and АМХ 38. As for higher-tier vehicles, the gun mantlet armor was changed for the Chieftain Mk.6, Super Conqueror, Object 140, T-62А, E 100, and Löwe.

[url=https://eu.wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/update-7-3/]More details in the game!
[/url]

notes.title: Operation Code: Fatal
notes.content:
The future. Cozy... bright... shining... At least, this is what you see after you've been enhanced with neural implants. You can hardly recall what reality actually looks like: smoke-filled days, endless nights, acidic puddles reflecting pink and blue neon lights instead of stars... Everything may be packed with technology, but the city lives by the same rule as it did hundreds of years before: take what's yours at any cost.

[previewyoutube=GHNtc6GnEGA;full][/previewyoutube]
Operation Code: Fatal includes two reward progressions, each of which is divided into 80 levels. The upper (silver) progression is available to all players, while the lower (gold) progression can only be accessed by Premium Pass owners. Increase the Level of your  Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Chips: 10 Chips = 1 level. Although the Level increases automatically, you will need to collect the rewards manually.
[list]
[*] CIS: from September 1, 8:00 (MSK) to September 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: from September 1, 14:00 (CEST) to September 29, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: from September 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to September 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: from September 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to September 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]The Temptations of the Future
[/h2]In the world of Code: Fatal, nobody struggles to survive. Power, might, wealth, exclusive camouflage, avatars, profile backgrounds, top vehicles... These are the things that matter. All this can become yours if you earn Chips and increase the  Pass Level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/af35e60af22e0566ec2d7166c2e1c1586c941b22.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Best Weapons[/h2]
With a  Premium Pass on hand, you'll get the tier IV Durchbruchswagen 2, a retro heavy tank from the old days, at Level 1. With a great amount of HP, high damage per shot, and not a single microcircuit, nobody will be able to hack and override it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3e405eaa6c787a3933c39a5ed2260c3c273a7912.jpg[/img]

Then at Level 35 of the  Pass, you'll gain access to the Tier VI Eraser BP44. There are two scary things in this world. The first is the kill code that erases your data. The second is the Eraser.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/71a023326b05bf243771afdec930cb23005ab134.jpg[/img]

The drone scans the area in front of the tank before the battle. The cold fusion engine shines brighter depending on the speed. And while there's a compartment with riot control weapons hidden on the left part of the turret, the Eraser never gets to use them because the gun, a reliable though significantly reworked piece of firepower, is usually sufficient.

Thanks to its improved recoil and gas systems, high damage, and sturdy armor, the Eraser BP44 is the best weapon in this new world. High-tech, ruthless, extremely effective, and fatal.

[h2]Code: Fatal Profile Background[/h2]
A special decoration awaits you at Level 80. In the style of Operation Code: Fatal, your statistics screen will be decorated in neon and with the Eraser. The same picture will appear in the background of your nickname in battle results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b253c404d1bb35678392986e4069811f2fc692c2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Resource Vaults
[/h2]They accumulate credits and Free XP as you win! Premium Pass gives you access to the Gold Vault, which starts off with 125 Gold and has an overall capacity of 2,000 Gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cbdfbd48982c88a78158d48e5fabb975a8b2cab7.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=MJzO6D0e8sI;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote][h3]Download the new version from July 15![/h3][/quote]
[h2]To the North![/h2]

This location is available for Tier IV–X vehicles in regular and rating battles.

notes.title: Skirmish: Quick Battles
notes.content:
If we were to describe World of Tanks Blitz in just a few words, we'd say, "intense tank mayhem". Well, strap yourself in, commander, and get ready for a wild ride. We've prepared a brand-new mode for you with fast and furious tank mayhem!
[previewyoutube=W7rllS3KDMc;full][/previewyoutube]
Take part in Skirmish and battle on small, compact maps where you'll always be at the point of the attack! There's not much time to think and plan.. Just act quickly, decisively, and effectively as possible!
[i]Note: Skirmish battles are not included in statistics and won't earn you medals and achievements.  [/i]
[h1]Schedule[/h1]
You can fight in Skirmish from July 9 to July 14.
CIS: from July 29, 10:00 (MSK) to July 14, 23:00 (MSK)
Europe: from July 9, 10:00 (CEST) to July 14, 23:00 (CEST)
North America: from July 9, 7:00 (PT) / 10:00 (ET) to July 14, 20:00 (PT) / 23:00 (ET)
Asia: from July 9, 10:00 (UTC+8) to July 14, 23:00 (UTC+8)
[h1]Skirmish features[/h1]
In Skirmish, battles are fought inside small zones at familiar locations: Desert Sands, Dead Rail, Yamato Harbor, and Falls Creek. Both teams are concentrated within a small section of the map, making the battle truly intense and fast-paced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/a9dbdabd669a6bf829556781773a5e21e125e280.jpg[/img]
Skirmish battles are held according to Encounter rules. The base is smaller and the capture time is reduced. Act quickly and exert control over the battlefield. Your first successful attack may turn into a victorious base capture!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c93c4181f07e7bef780c2a1107216c9e2aa57f8a.jpg[/img]
Each team has five players instead of seven, so knocking out one enemy can give your team a valuable advantage. But the opposite is true as well. Losing an ally will significantly reduce your team's ability. Cover your teammates and try to weaken the enemy as fast as you can!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6273338eac5dda2e4900e151a39170daaf7dde9a.jpg[/img]
[h1]How to enter Skirmish[/h1]
To join a Skirmish battle, select it in the menu next to the "Battle!" button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/2b7646c6efe42e3a653716d43a45d3e9d9a6daf5.jpg[/img]
[i]Skirmish battles are only available for Tier V–X vehicles.[/i]
[h1]Quick Tournaments[/h1]
Participate in Quick Tournaments under Skirmish rules!
[i]Dates: July 10 and July 13. Registration for participation starts on the day of the tournament and closes half an hour prior to the end. [/i]
Tournaments are held separately for three vehicle categories: Tiers V–VI, VII–VIII, and IX–X.
Battle format: 5 vs 5
Control mode: Mixed
Registration: non-clan
[i]Detailed regulations, the schedule by region, and the reward list for winners can be found in the tournament description in the game client. [/i]
[h1]Missions[/h1]
Battle in Skirmish and get rewards for the first 10, 20, and 30 victories:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/57f9e3e30bf00b5706e42ead9c0c4c9c63bde10a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b1fb0b94456f817c9a192201e6c35fa8c37eb2d8.png[/img]

[i]Please note that these missions can only be completed in Skirmish battles. Battles in Quick Tournaments under the rules of Skirmish are not counted. [/i]
Good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: Update 7.0
notes.content:
In a big way with a bang! This update features both our ideas for improvement and lots of player requests. Thank you for actively and genuinely caring about the game! The new update will delight you with its improved graphics, advanced settings, and even new tanks and effects. There are lots of cool things to see and things to try out!

[previewyoutube=RuZk46n9S6c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Realism and beauty[/h2]Just take a look! Several remarkable graphics improvements make the atmosphere of battles more intense, including improved effects for object destruction, flames, smoke, dust, dynamic shadows, gun recoil, shell hit marks, and tank track traces. And don't worry. None of these new features affects gameplay or causes dramatic changes to the game's appearance. If your device can't pull off any of these effects, you can simply turn them off in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ff2f8266e2a523311f2d4817d17e26beb27d122d.png[/img]

[h2]The British Tech Tree has grown[/h2]Three new Tier VIII–X light tanks are available for research! The impetuous FV301, Vickers Cruiser, and Vickers Light 105 just can't wait to get in your Garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e1922544c8cf272dd0bdf57d5f367d32f39b880d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Map changes[/h2]We've made some map improvements! Some bugs and spots where vehicles could get stuck were eliminated while the models of buildings and objects were adjusted. On top of that, we've removed unplanned positions on the maps Himmelsdorf, Castilla, Mayan Ruins, Naval Frontier, Winter Malinovka, Copperfield, New Bay, Dynasty's Pearl, Faust, Hellas, and Normandy.

[h2]You've got the power![/h2]There's no reason to hold back! It is now in your power to blow off the turrets of tank destroyers that were unlucky enough to have one! And you can do it in style! Just the way we like it. Making their epic departure from the battlefield are the Helsing, FV215b (183), FV4004 Conway, Charioteer, FV4005, Challenger, T30, T67, and T28 Defender.

[h2]Balance Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Bat.-Châtillon 25 t[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dispersion on the move/hull traverse was decreased from 0.12 to 0.1.
[*] Engine power was increased from 720 to 745 hp.
[/list]

[h3]STB-1[/h3]
View range was decreased from 270 to 260 m.

[h3]XM551 Sheridan[/h3]
Engine power was decreased from 650 to 485 hp.
ATGM
[list]
[*] Flight range was decreased from 450 to 300 m.
[*] Turn speed was decreased by 25%.
[/list]

[h3]T92E1[/h3]
ATGM
[list]
[*] Flight range was decreased from 450 to 300 m.
[*] Turn speed was decreased by 25%.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Reticle Calibration and Improved Engine Power Boost consumables were added for the following American tank destroyers: the T25 AT, T28, T95, and T110E3.
[*] The Volume setting was divided into two settings: Music Volume and Effects and System Sounds Volume.
[*] The Cooldown booster was added to the pre-battle booster panel.
[*] The username can now be changed only from the player profile (previously it was also possible from Settings).
[*] Improved shooting effects for the E 100 and the VK 90.01 (P).
[*] Improved Modules and Defense System standard equipment was replaced with Improved Modules + and Defense System + for the Firefly Saunders SP.
[*] For iOS users, the bug where the "Sign in with Apple" window appeared every time players (re)log in to the game was fixed.
[*] The bug where push notifications didn't expand for some Android devices was fixed.
[*] Cases where item icons were displayed incorrectly in Storage were fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: British Scouts
notes.content:
Like a gust of wind, three top-tier scouts blast onto the scene in Update 7.0. They're astonishingly fast and maneuverable while boasting accurate, rapid-firing guns. On top of all that, they're remarkably vigilant. Take a closer look at these newcomers before they rush into battle!

[previewyoutube=IWAYa7MICX8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Tier VIII FV301[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/294f44ea2546399bc15b20027bdb2955f49a3c3a.jpg[/img]
The FV301's speed alone is worth a long and colorful narration. Let's count the reasons:
[list]
[*] One: near-instant acceleration to an average speed of 40 km/h, with a maximum speed of 62 km/h
[*] Two: confidently maintains speed on irregular terrain, making you just want to forget about the battle and go for a pleasurable drive among the hills and dunes
[*] Three: practically doesn't slow down when turning, which makes spinning around clumsy rivals especially fun
[*] Four: swerves sharply enough at full speed that you actually dodge shells
[*] Five: drives fast, shoots fast
[/list]
That's right! The top gun reloads in 4.8 seconds and aims really quickly. The damage per minute exceeds 2,300 HP while penetration is enough to punch holes not only in the sides but also in the front of enemy vehicles.

[h2]Tier IX Vickers CR[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5c17da356eb78a63f39b1f6090c5901c8087d936.jpg[/img]
This vehicle might have slightly weaker dynamics and road crossing capacity compared to the FV301, but just check out its top gun! The 245 mm of armor penetration will be the object of envy for many same-tier medium tanks. Thanks to the high penetration, an impressive 350 HP of damage can be dealt every 8 seconds with enviable efficiency.

[quote]In the hands of an experienced commander, the Vickers CR can snipe from afar (accuracy permits it) and remain invisible thanks to its huge view range.[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f21b578149e281a0fd8dcc26b3466cf3941b72e3.jpg[/img]
Like any true light tank, the Vickers CR has no armor. But the large gun mantlet can confidently withstand shots from even the powerful guns of tank destroyers. This will especially come in handy when you play hull-down from medium or long range. The 10-degree gun depression angle further underscores the soundness of this tactic. Terrain is your best armor!

[h2]Tier X Vickers Light[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/eb4177737515acdc7bdb679b457a30b9dc211048.jpg[/img]
The view range of the Vickers CR may be huge, but the Vickers Light has one that's simply beyond imaginable: 280 meters without upgrades. Add equipment and provisions to the equation, and you'll get 325 whole meters! That means the Vickers Light is ideal for a light tank's main task—reconnaissance.

You probably won't feel this advantage at first, but with every battle in the Vickers Light, you'll have more insight into how far this warrior can see. Make good use of this feature and your team will always know where the enemy's hiding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6591552cdb5d68c12f286b51aabcb605a767c1bd.jpg[/img]
[quote]The key to success is to learn how to stay where you can see the enemy, but he can't see you. And for you to blaze away at poor, unsuspecting targets![/quote]

Just like the Vickers CR, the Vickers Light is equipped with the same 105 mm gun. However, at Tier X, the reloading time decreases to 7.38 seconds without equipment and provisions. The penetration, damage, and accuracy are definitely good enough to use any tactic. Flank the enemy and punch a hole in the sides and the rear with every shot or surprise opponents with well-aimed shots to the front! Rest assured that with this gun, there's nothing you can't do.

Again, while this tank lacks armor, the turret is effective at deflecting shots. Even the mighty Ho-Ri Type III can only pierce the large gun mantlet every other time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e6766c7992876f9167e7f11e561c05494dfae6f4.jpg[/img]
Speaking about dynamics, the Vickers Light is just as nimble, maneuverable, and good at crossing terrain as the Tier VIII FV301. Pick a spot on the map (just make sure you can find your way there) and take it in a matter of seconds. Effortlessly ascend hills, dodge shells, and don't let clumsy heavies or tank destroyers even have a chance to point their guns at you! The quick-turning turret of the Vickers Light will allow you to always keep the enemy in your sights. At the same time, the gun can punch through enemy armor even when shooting at random.

What do these British light tanks have? Unique handling, driving speed, and crossing capacity. Powerful guns that even many heavy tanks will envy. Unprecedented view range, strong mantlets, and a 10-degree gun depression angle. This is everything a British scout needs. Start accumulating experience with the Comet now so that you can research the new branch once Update 7.0 is released!

tags.feature: Like a gust of wind, three top-tier scouts blast onto the scene in Update 7.0. They're astonishingly fast and maneuverable while boasting accurate, rapid-firing guns. On top of all that, they're remarkably vigilant. Take a closer look at these newcomers before they rush into battle!
The FV301's speed alone is worth a long and colorful narration. Let's count the reasons:

tags.balance_change: One: near-instant acceleration to an average speed of 40 km/h, with a maximum speed of 62 km/h
Two: confidently maintains speed on irregular terrain, making you just want to forget about the battle and go for a pleasurable drive among the hills and dunes
Three: practically doesn't slow down when turning, which makes spinning around clumsy rivals especially fun
Four: swerves sharply enough at full speed that you actually dodge shells
Five: drives fast, shoots fast

That's right! The top gun reloads in 4.8 seconds and aims really quickly. The damage per minute exceeds 2,300 HP while penetration is enough to punch holes not only in the sides but also in the front of enemy vehicles.

tags.feature: This vehicle might have slightly weaker dynamics and road crossing capacity compared to the FV301, but just check out its top gun! The 245 mm of armor penetration will be the object of envy for many same-tier medium tanks. Thanks to the high penetration, an impressive 350 HP of damage can be dealt every 8 seconds with enviable efficiency.

Like any true light tank, the Vickers CR has no armor. But the large gun mantlet can confidently withstand shots from even the powerful guns of tank destroyers. This will especially come in handy when you play hull-down from medium or long range. The 10-degree gun depression angle further underscores the soundness of this tactic. Terrain is your best armor!

The view range of the Vickers CR may be huge, but the Vickers Light has one that's simply beyond imaginable: 280 meters without upgrades. Add equipment and provisions to the equation, and you'll get 325 whole meters! That means the Vickers Light is ideal for a light tank's main task—reconnaissance.

You probably won't feel this advantage at first, but with every battle in the Vickers Light, you'll have more insight into how far this warrior can see. Make good use of this feature and your team will always know where the enemy's hiding.

tags.balance_change: The key to success is to learn how to stay where you can see the enemy, but he can't see you. And for you to blaze away at poor, unsuspecting targets!

The penetration, damage, and accuracy are definitely good enough to use any tactic. Flank the enemy and punch a hole in the sides and the rear with every shot or surprise opponents with well-aimed shots to the front! Rest assured that with this gun, there's nothing you can't do.

tags.feature: Again, while this tank lacks armor, the turret is effective at deflecting shots. Even the mighty Ho-Ri Type III can only pierce the large gun mantlet every other time.

notes.title: Operation Onslaught
notes.content:
The glorious day has come, commander!

The roar of the engines belonging to millions of tanks will tear through the air while the sound of thousands of battles echoes around the world. Operation Onslaught will be forever etched into your memory as it will bring you honor, glory, and an indescribable amount of rewards: resources, rare items, and Collector vehicles. All missions are set, so it's time to start completing them for rewards!

[previewyoutube=FTEYgJblWQQ;full][/previewyoutube][list]
[*] CIS: from May 1, 8:00 (MSK) to May 29, 8:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: from May 1, 14:00 (CEST) to May 29, 14:00 (CEST)
[*] North America: from May 1, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) to May 29, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: from May 1, 14:00 (UTC+8) to May 29, 14:00 (UTC+8)
[/list]
[h2]How to get rewards?[/h2]Operation Onslaught includes two reward progressions, each of which is divided into 40 levels. The upper (silver) progression is available to all players, while the lower (gold) progression can only be accessed by Premium Pass owners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/510fde9f7e717e130ed9f4ba5cbf4a048dac810e.jpg[/img]

Increase the level of your Pass to get rewards. To do so, complete missions and earn Stamps:

[b]10 Stamps = 1 level[/b]

Although the level increases automatically, you need to collect the rewards manually.

You can earn a total of 15 Stamps each day. Premium Pass owners get access to an additional mission that provides another 5 Stamps. With Premium Pass, you can earn 20 Stamps a day and unlock 2 levels with rewards. Also, Premium Pass lets you instantly increase your level using gold.

[h2]Untold Riches![/h2]The higher the level of your Pass, the bigger your fortunes and the fuller your Storage. For completing all levels, you can get up to:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6dfafb1f2660d1c901a0160e47a85bb443bbdb8e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Collector Tanks![/h2]
At Level 1 of the Operation,  Premium Pass owners will get tier-IV [b]Covenanter[/b], a mobile light tank with impressive firepower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/abfa8c415d8e60676b5cc1b71d8f58ceec693230.jpg[/img]

At level 35, you'll get tier-VI [b]Thunder[/b]. It's a special version of the KV-1S with a powerful 122 mm gun and reinforced armor, but, at the same time, decreased mobility. The main attraction of this tank is its appearance. Nothing in the world could be more beautiful than the Thunder at full speed. The star on the side of its turret shines so brightly that it immediately inspires you to glorious victories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/476b473932655c2f622025bef5bcfe0ef09c5945.jpg[/img]

[url=https://wotblitz.eu/en/news/event/news-battle-pass-2020/]LEARN MORE![/url]

notes.title: Gravity Force
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/67e03528e133ecf6653b13b73c64dabdb72dba93.jpg[/img]
We'll tell you a secret. When tanks were little, they dreamed of becoming astronauts. Their dreams have finally come true! From April 10 through April 16, the vehicles in World of Tanks Blitz will break free of the Earth's gravity and explore new horizons in space.

[previewyoutube=VKPUUoRuPhs;full][/previewyoutube]
Experience the new Gravity Force mode! Fight in the moon's gravity and float over the lunar surface on the Sea of Tranquility map! Take flight over the battlefield or send your enemies hurtling across the entire map!
[i]Gravity Force battles don't affect your stats.[/i]
[h1]Schedule[/h1]
Here's when you'll be able to fight in Gravity Force:
CIS: from April 10, 10:00 (MSK) to April 16, 23:00 (MSK)
Europe: from April 10, 10:00 (CEST) to April 16, 23:00 (CEST)
North America: from April 10, 7:00 (PT) / 10:00 (ET) to April 16, 20:00 (PT) / 23:00 (ET)
Asia: from April 10, 10:00 (UTC+8) to April 16, 23:00 (UTC+8)

[h1]Briefing[/h1]
[i]Only Tier V–X vehicles are allowed in this mode.[/i]
Space battles are a serious matter. So first off, a mission briefing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1639787a85833e5c9be0c35b4a4c9c65dbcf4c39.jpg[/img]

Here are the basic rules for fighting in the moon's gravity:
[list]
[*] In Gravity Force, gravity is several times lower. Just put the pedal to the metal and let the terrain help you blast off!
[*] Even while in flight, you won't lose control of your vehicle. You can turn or tilt the hull to slightly change your trajectory.
[*] Lower gravity makes falling less painful. In Gravity Force, damage from falling is significantly reduced. 
[*] In low gravity, the recoil from taking a shot becomes much more noticeable. The lighter the tank and the larger the gun caliber, the farther the vehicle is thrown backwards upon firing. Spin it to your advantage. Fire to speed up or change your flight path. 
[*] When a shell hits an enemy tank, it will not only cause damage but push it backwards. The more powerful your gun and the smaller the target's weight, the farther the enemy is thrown back. Shoot an enemy tank as soon as its tracks leave the surface and watch it fly away! ATGM shells are best suited for this purpose as one precise hit will send the enemy on an express trip to the other side of the map.
[*] In Gravity Force, tanks' engine power and top speed will be significantly increased. Don't be surprised when you see heavies drifting on turns or light tanks soaring over the battlefield like birds. Space birds with large caliber guns. 
[/list]
[h1]Sea of Tranquility[/h1]
In Gravity Force, you'll have to leave your home planet and join the fight on the surface of the moon. Welcome to the Sea of Tranquility! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7f5a967c885e8804627eda0c5c6246d230eecc1f.jpg[/img]

All the sights of the Moon await you here: fantastic space views, a complex landscape with many hills and natural ramps, and even a secret scientific base.
Cosmic cold and lunar darkness make it the perfect place for intense tank battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5c8736f66c05cf57554cfbdeff182edbfbdc27f0.jpg[/img]

[i]Due to an unknown anomaly, the moon's gravity has taken effect even on Earth. In addition to the Sea of Tranquility, Gravity Force battles will be available on the Mirage, Desert Sands, Dead Rail, Oasis Palms, Winter Malinovka, and Normandy maps.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8bcafa934d252729915e0d7521d9ef1b6d6a37d9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Missions[/h1]
Battle in Gravity Force and get rewards for the first 10, 20, and 30 victories!

[table]
[tr]
[th]
10 victories

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/79dce55876859a07fcea9f035d362b57fba7d260.png[/img]
One
Huge
Container
[/th]
[th]
20 victories
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7de78674125388d3afb56b7cea3ec7b97320e6b2.png[/img]
One permanent
Astronaut
Rare avatar
[/th]
[th]
30 victories
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8eaccbf168d0ba83009a8185e65ede6bfa1ea24c.png[/img]
One certificate for
the Starlight Night
Rare camouflage
[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]
A last little tip before starting: it’s cold in space, so don’t forget to put on a spacesuit. And a hat!

notes.title: Update 6.9
notes.content:
[b]Download the new version starting March 25!
[/b]
[h2]Japanese Branch[/h2]For everyone who's been waiting for so long, four tank destroyers from Tier VII to X were added to the Japanese Tech Tree. Each of them is mobile and has impressive firepower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/344af3ff606aed9a4a7aac84d76a7f0739839300.png[/img]

[url=https://wotblitz.ru/ru/news/updates/japanese-td/]Take a Closer Look![/url]

[h2]Legendary Warpaints
[/h2]A camo for a new Tier X tank! The Ho-Ri Type III Samurai warpaint has a combative and elegant look, reflecting the best traditions of Samurai culture. Available in the Appearance tab for 2,550 gold.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/98dd437e42d54754cdfd0b9db01efb697364427e.jpg[/img]

We've also got something for fans of German tanks: the Savage Legendary camo attachment for the Tiger II for 1,450 gold.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/fb3f31489ad3fec9ab444e845e4236a94498bd7e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hybrid Control
[/h2]The game now features a new hybrid type of joystick. It can be activated by tapping anywhere in the lower left corner of the touch screen. You can enable this new control type in Settings under the Controls tab.

[h2]Boosters: New Look, New Booster
[/h2]The design of boosters was updated, and boosters were moved to the Offers tab of the in-game Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f0406bf0d8c6a9d0f52695fbe7c42cd20a02c80.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tier X Heavy Tanks Just Got Heavier
[/h2]The HP for each Tier X heavy tank was increased by 5-20% depending on its characteristics. Now the role of heavy tanks suits their class better as they'll live longer, block more damage, and act more confidently. 

[i]Reworks also affected the characteristics of the VK 16.02 Leopard, T23E3, and Jagdpanther.
[/i]

[url=https://wotblitz.ru/ru/news/updates/vehicle-changes-6-9/]Learn More![/url]

[h2]Reworks and Fixed Bugs
[/h2][list]
[*]A dynamic filter was added for x5 XP certificates. If you have a certificate in your Storage, you'll see the Suitable Tanks button. After tapping it, you'll go to the Garage and, in the vehicle carousel, you'll see only the tanks that are suitable for applying this certificate. 
[*]Battle types were renamed battle modes and vice versa. As an example, Uprising is a battle type and Encounter is a battle mode.
[*]ATGMs: the bug that caused the absence of the sound of a flying missile when in Sniper mode was fixed.
[*]The Appearance tab: the bug that caused incorrect swiping to the installed camouflage when switching between camouflage slots was fixed.
[*]Players no longer receive notifications when their rating falls and they enter a lower league.
[*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Japanese Tank Destroyers
notes.content:
Big, protected, surprisingly mobile, and armed with powerful guns firing a special set of shells, the game's first Japanese tank destroyers will immediately make you respect them. And when the four new tank destroyers enter the battle, no one will survive their onslaught. Learn about them now and prepare to research a new Tier X vehicle!

[i]The top guns of the Japanese tank destroyers can fire two types of AP shells. The main AP shell for each new vehicle features high penetration and devastating damage. The improved AP shell has lower damage, but it can penetrate practically all enemies.[/i]

[h2]Tier VII.  Chi-To SPG
[/h2]Researched after the Chi-To for 43,400 exp. Cost: 1,345,000 credits.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/603c88d4a39eea7ff69f127ddb667b363f235bea.jpg[/img]

Many enemy shells will simply bounce off this tank destroyer's armor, especially if they're fired from medium or long range. Considering its great armor, the mobility of the Chi-To SPG is inspiring. Its suspension, taken from a medium tank, has a max speed of 45 km/h, a high power-to-weight ratio, and decent maneuverability. 

The most difficult aspect is to get a better gun than the stock one, which has quite low penetration. You'll have to take more frequent risks until you unlock the top gun. On the bright side, with the top 105 mm gun, the Chi-To SPG will penetrate 215 mm using standard shells and 265 using alternative ones to inflict over 2,500 HP of damage per minute. Put holes in enemy tanks at any distance without having to aim at their weak spots!

[h2]Tier VIII.  Ho-Ri Type I
[/h2]Researched after Chi-To SPG for 76,950 exp. Cost: 2,570,000 credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4f59bbe047ec1060284c9fd4d0f2e78a85f848dc.jpg[/img]

Thanks to a max speed of 45 km/h and good specific power, the Ho-Ri Type I moves almost like a medium tank or a very mobile heavy tank. The armor of its cabin reaches 190 mm, but the enemy will easily spot its weak places at medium or close range. This tank destroyer's weak spots are the cabin sides or the vertical parts of the armor. At the same time, many shots will be blocked by the big, thick gun mantlet.

The stock gun of this monster should be familiar to you as it's from the Chi-To SPG. It works great at Tier VIII, so you'll easily collect the XP required for the top gun. And when you have it, even seven samurai won't be able to put up a fight. 248 mm of penetration and 400 HP of damage with a standard shell and 297 mm and 340 HP of damage with an improved one! Add good accuracy and 6 shots per minute, and this huge ship gun deserves to be on a Tier X vehicle!

[h2]Tier IX.  Ho-Ri Type II
[/h2]Researched after the Ho-Ri Type I for 160,000 exp. Cost: 3,450,000 credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/60d11651883e914035720e4b8d23991a670fb2af.jpg[/img]

The second variant of the Ho-Ri tank destroyer is a lot heavier, causing it to lose some speed and maneuverability while adding more protection. Its sloped frontal armor survives almost any hit, but the vertical 190 mm armor of the cabin will frequently make you lose HP. Try to sidescrape when under fire. Even a small change in the hull's position will give you a greater chance to reduce damage taken. Use this trick!

The stock gun of the Ho-Ri Type II resembles the one of the Maus. It has 246 mm of penetration, 460 HP of damage, 11 seconds of reloading time, and good accuracy. However, even this 'Maus gun' looks like a child's toy in comparison to the top gun, which has 290 mm of penetration with a standard AP shell and 340 mm with an improved one while dealing 560 and 545 HP of damage respectively. Almost every shot from this gun will inflict damage and bring you closer to an even more devastating vehicle: the Ho-Ri Type III.

[h2]Tier X.  Ho-Ri Type III[/h2]Researched after the Ho-Ri Type II for 271,000 exp. Cost: 6,100,000 credits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/fc003445e16274703710c6a5eb3dc4408cb1b547.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the top of the mountain! Here, surrounded by white blooming sakuras, it listens to the silence and meditates to the sound of running water. The name of this honorable vehicle is the Ho-Ri Samurai. This mighty warrior maintains extreme calm, yet is full of pulsating fury. The Samurai skillfully controls its anger, focuses it, and channels it into one accurate and lethal strike with its katana-gun, showing no mercy. 

[i]The Legendary Samurai camouflage changes the tank destroyer name in battle to Ho-Ri Samurai. It is effective on all map types and doesn't require replenishment. Price for unlocking: 2,550 gold. [/i]

The cabin and upper part of the hull, which have 250 mm of armor, may not look too impressive at Tier X, but this protection will block many shells coming from long and medium distances. Your sidescraping skills will be put to good use. In close combat, the enemy will be able to penetrate this tank destroyer if they aim at the driver's hatch and the vertical part of the hull armor. 

You don't expect a huge monster like the Ho-Ri Type III to be too mobile. That makes it even more pleasant to see the Samurai top out at 25-35 km/h and surprise outrageous medium tanks with its traverse speed. 

And its gun... It isn't the best in single-shot damage, but it takes 560 or 545 HP from the enemy every 10-11 seconds. And a look closer at its characteristics reveals a standard AP shell penetrates 310 mm and an improved one 380 mm! If you don't want to achieve penetration, you'll need to aim as badly as possible and ask luck to stay away. The Ho-Ri Type III cuts through enemy armor like a katana through lettuce! The Ho-Ri Samurai will serve you with honor, so command it with wisdom!

When spring is here, it's already a holiday. But spring will be much more fun with a new tank in your Garage! Participate in Operation Rolling Spring to get the M4/FL10 and tons of other prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0aba2b31d848dc04e01b8f606e70893ff6eab2e0.jpg[/img]
[url=https://wotblitz.eu/en/news/event/spring-2020/]READ MORE[/url]

[h1]M4/FL10[/h1]
The M4/FL10 is a hybrid that combines the hull of the American M4 Sherman and the turret of the French AMX 13. It features a good amount of HP, decent mobility, and a quick-turning turret. However, the main advantages of this tank are its shell-slinging, fast-aiming gun and a three-shell autoreloading magazine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/72653ab861fe110343d0ee56bd5e37d7bc597218.jpg[/img]
[h1]When does Operation Rolling Spring take place?[/h1]
CIS: from February 28, 8:00 (MSK) to March 6, 8:00 (MSK)
Europe: from February 28, 13:00 (CET) to March 6, 13:00 (CET)
North America: from February 28, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET) to March 6, 5:00 (PT) / 8:00 (ET)
Asia: from February 28, 14:00 (UTC+8) to March 6, 14:00 (UTC+8)

[i]To participate in Operation Rolling Spring, new players need a vehicle Tier V or higher.[/i]

[url=https://wotblitz.eu/en/news/event/spring-2020/]READ MORE[/url]

notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E9y4TUIJgV8
[quote]Download the new version from February 19![/quote]
[h1]A Touch of Antiquity[/h1]
The Hellas map, a picturesque place with the ruins of an ancient civilization, was added. This map is available for Tier V–X vehicles in regular and rating battles.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xz01TDxh-H8
[b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/hellas-map/]ENJOY THE VIEW![/url][/b]

[h1]Wet Paint[/h1][list][*]The Legendary Sidewinder camouflage for the XM551 Sheridan is now available in the Appearance tab for 5,500 gold.[*]Two Rare camouflages were added: Sinister Traces and Molten Lava. The cost varies from 65 to 750 gold depending on the vehicle tier.
[/list]

[h1]The Tree Burst Into Bloom[/h1]
The Tech Tree has been reworked:[list][*]The design was updated.
[*] The menu with game nations was shifted to the left.
[*] Vehicle tiers are now displayed at the bottom.
[*] The national flag is now shown for researched and purchased vehicles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9f5100f5aee633bf935452b3faa58a6b79af6a77.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/atgm-branch/]The American XM551 Sheridan and T92E1 missileers[/url] turned out to be overpowered. We decreased their damage and penetration values to make these vehicles correspond more to their class and battle role while also making them less effective in head-on combat with heavily armored tanks. In addition, the ATGM shells became less versatile. At the same time, the vehicles' key features remained the same. Commanders can still rely on speed and maneuverability, striking opponents from the flanks, dealing a significant amount of damage per shot, and firing from behind cover using ATGMs when necessary.

The T54E1 was made faster to help it keep up with its counterparts. We also made the Somua SAu 40 stronger so it can feel more confident in battles against Tier V vehicles.

[b]XM551 Sheridan[/b][list][*]The average penetration of an APCR shell decreased from 240 to 230 mm.
[*]The average penetration of a HEAT shell decreased from 340 to 310 mm.
[*]The average damage of a HEAT shell decreased from 560 to 490 HP.
[/list]
[b]T92E1[/b][list][*]Armor thickness for the upper glacis plate decreased from 76 to 52 mm.
[*] For the 152 mm XM150E3 gun:[list][*]The average penetration of an APCR shell decreased from 240 to 230 mm.
[*] The average penetration of a HEAT shell decreased from 340 to 310 mm.
[*] The average damage of a HEAT shell decreased from 560 to 490 HP.[/list][/list]
[b]T54E1[/b][list][*]The top forward speed increased from 44 to 50 km/h.
[/list]
[b]Somua SAu 40[/b][list][*]The frontal armor was increased:[list][*]From 36 to 75 mm for the upper glacis plate and commander's cupola.
[*] From 36 to 75 mm for the vision block flaps.
[*] From 25 to 75 mm for the front shield of both guns' armor masks.[/list][/list]
[b]Consumables[/b][list][*]The Reticle Calibration duration increased from 15 to 20 seconds.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1][list][*]The cost of unresearched vehicles in credits was returned to the vehicle module research screen. Now both the research cost and the purchase cost can be seen.
[*] The booster panel displayed at the beginning of a battle now shows a counter indicating the number of remaining boosters.
[*] The battle counter in the player's profile was fixed: regular, rating, and tournament battles are now counted.
[*] The issue when the sound in the game might disappear due to an incoming call, alarm, or other notification was fixed in the iOS version of the game.
[*] The grass in Sniper mode is now displayed if this setting is enabled.
[*] The damage icon was fixed in the Vehicles tab in the player's profile.
[*] The issue of characteristics changes displaying not for the selected provisions in the Provisions screen was fixed.
[*] The loading proportion of shell type for standard ammunition when unlocking a new tank or gun was adjusted.
[*] The issue with the display of penetration zones for the Panzer 58 was fixed.
[*] The camouflage display for the FCM 36 Pak 40 and T95E2, as well as the Wings of Night attachment display for the BT-7 and M5 Stuart, was fixed.
[*] The design of some screens has been updated, while descriptions and notifications have been improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Realistic Battles Are Back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/11b65a1f65ac22ee3ca5ecbb81232304993e4196.jpg[/img]

Commander,

Realistic battles are back once again to give you the chance to feel the power and drive of a true tank warfare. Load up for battle and put your gaming skills to the test!

Here's when you'll be able to compete in realistic battles:
[list]
[*] February 7 through 9
[*] February 14 through 16
[/list]
[i]Note: in Realistic Battles, an additional condition will apply—players will be unable to see the HP of enemy tanks spotted by allies.[/i]

[h1]Tournaments[/h1]
Don't miss the chance to participate in two Realistic Battles tournaments!

[b]First Realistic Battles Tournament[/b]
Dates: February 8-9 Registration for participation starts on February 4.

[b]Second Realistic Battles Tournament[/b]
Dates: February 15-16 Registration for participation starts on February 11.

Battle format: 7x7 battles
Vehicle tier: X
Control mode: mixed
Registration type: non-clan registration

Check out the tournament description in the game for the detailed regulations and timetable for your region.

[i]1st place will earn 6,142,500 credits for the whole team and 14 days of Premium Account time for every participant![/i]
The rewards for other prize places are listed in the All Rewards section of the tournament in the game client.

[h1]Missions[/h1]
Fight in Realistic Battles or participate in Realistic Battles tournaments and get rewards for the first 10, 20, and 30 victories.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/5d3465f13907a281cb087e22c3b2d2f75c9ffc1a.png[/img]

[i]Please note: Realistic Battles will be available twice (from February 7 through 9 and from February 14 through 16), and each time will give a chance to earn prizes for the first 10, 20, and 30 victories.  [/i]

[h1]Pre-Battle Briefing[/h1]
Realistic battle presents a true challenge for your skill. All the usual tips and comforts have remained in regular and rating battles.

[b]Key features of the realistic battle:[/b]
[list]
[*] No armor highlighting is available in Sniper Mode.
[*] Armor penetration and damage do not vary: if a vehicle's characteristics mention 148 mm as a shell's average penetration and 340 mm as average damage, then the gun will always penetrate 148 mm of armor and deal 340 HP of damage. An HE shell can cause lower splash damage if it hits more protected parts of armor.
[*] Enemy vehicles are not displayed on the minimap.
[*] The opponents' vehicles are visible at any distance unless they are hiding behind obstacles.
[*] The light bulb doesn't flick on if you've been spotted by an enemy.
[*] Markers above the enemy vehicles are displayed only when the enemy falls into the aiming circle.
[*] Icons of consumables and damaged modules are not displayed above the opponents' vehicles.
[*] The Enemy Spotted ribbon does not show. 
[*] Battles are held only in Supremacy mode on the Desert Sands, Oasis Palms, Rockfield, Normandy, Dead Rail, and Winter Malinovka maps.
[/list]
[i]Note: the results of realistic battles are not included in statistics.  [/i]
[code]Realistic battles can only be accessed using Tier V–X vehicles. Vehicles that are not allowed in realistic battles: IS-3 Defender; O-47; T28 Defender; Tankenstein; Nameless; Lupus; Predator UM; Gravedigger; Smasher; Edelweiss; Hafen; T6 Dracula; Helsing; WZ Blaze; Vindicator UM; Y5 ELC bis; Kuro Mori Mine; Pz. IV Anko SP; Y5 Firefly; Scavenger; Y5 T-34; Vulcan; Lycan; Nightmare.[/code] 

[h1]Schedule[/h1]
Here's when you'll be able to compete in realistic battles:

[b]February 7-9[/b]
CIS: from February 7, 10:00 (MSK) to February 9, 23:59 (MSK)
Europe: from February 7, 10:00 (CET) to February 9, 23:59 (CET)
North America: from February 7, 10:00 (PT) / 13:00 (ET) to February 9, 23:59 (PT) / February 10, 2:59 (ET)
Asia: from February 7, 10:00 (UTC+8) to February 9, 23:59 (UTC+8)

[b]February 14-16[/b]
CIS: from February 14, 10:00 (MSK) to February 16, 23:59 (MSK)
Europe: from February 14, 10:00 (CET) to February 16, 23:59 (CET)
North America: from February 14, 10:00 (PT) / 13:00 (ET) to February 16, 23:59 (PT) / February 17, 2:59 (ET)
Asia: from February 14, 10:00 (UTC+8) to February 16, 23:59 (UTC+8)

Every night, Realistic Battles will be temporarily unavailable:
CIS: from 2:00 (MSK) till 8:00 (MSK)
Europe: from 2:00 (CET) till 8:00 (CET)
North America: from 22:00 (PT) / 1:00 (ET) till 2:00 (PT) / 5:00 (ET)
Asia: from 2:00 (UTC+8) till 8:00 (UTC+8)

notes.title: Rating Battles in February
notes.content:
Battle for rating while earning yourself bonuses for the first victory, rare camouflage, avatars, and MORE GOLD. All because the reward for the top-10 players has been increased!
[list]
[*] Play in Tier VII-X vehicles from February 5 through February 29.
[*] Fight ten calibration battles. Based on the results, you will be placed into one of five Leagues: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond.
[*] Earn rating points and progress up the leaderboard, while moving from one League to another.
[/list]
Remember: the better you perform in battle, the more rating points you will receive.
[h2]Streamer contest![/h2]
One contest will be held for the CIS region and another for all of Asia, North America, and Europe. We invite YouTube channel owners with over 500 subscribers. Fame and glory await for the best three streamers: links to the channels in the Rating Battles of March news and Premium vehicles to be won among your subscribers — give more players a chance to learn about you! Read more on our [url=https://discord.gg/vGmyWBY ]Discord channel[/url]. To watch the streams, look them up using the [b]#RB_infebruary[/b] hashtag.

[h1]Rewards[/h1]
[h2]Gold[/h2]
Traditionally, the top ten tankers of each region will receive a reward:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9da6000cd10795b1d23ff705fdb4e69fbc43fb52.png[/img]

[h2]Camouflage and avatars[/h2]
After ending the month in the Diamond League (at least 5,000 rating points):
[table]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9d25ed632688e738bcfd16754a3cf9996fceefd9.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f0f6be97002fdf1a07c3a32e8976c3a7627f4b79.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
After ending the month in the Platinum League (at least 4,000 rating points):
[table]
[tr]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7e4262c30697066d4f78bbc4a47fd3f1ff3205f6.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e8f4477f3e1496d439d263134c2b2323658f9081.png[/img][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

After ending the month in the Gold League (at least 3,000 rating points):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f868428a76c6acab9f3e7c876a15ca16d86b83ba.png[/img]

Camouflage for the Diamond League is regularly updated. When a new warpaint is introduced into the Diamond League, the old one becomes available for the Platinum League.

[h2]How and where to install camouflage.
[/h2]
You can install the camouflage on the Tier VII–X vehicles that you drove most often when fighting this series of Rating Battles. You can get up to four warpaints for a corresponding League: one for each eligible vehicle tier, as long as you have fought at least 50 battles in vehicles of that tier.

If the camouflage cannot be installed on a vehicle or if it is already installed, you will receive 250,000 credits as compensation.

[h2]This month, bonuses for victories will still apply[/h2]
[h3]Bonus to credits:[/h3][list]
[*] Gold League: 0–32%
[*] Platinum League: 33–65%
[*] Diamond League: 66% or higher
[/list]
[h3]Bonus to Combat XP:[/h3][list]
[*] +10% to XP for Tier VII vehicles
[*] +15% to XP for Tier VIII vehicles
[*] +20% to XP for Tier IX vehicles
[*] +25% to XP for Tier X vehicles
[/list]

Please note that this is a fixed bonus for winning a battle, not an increase in the total amount of XP and credits earned.

notes.title: Update 6.7
notes.content:
[quote][b]Download the new version from January 15![/b][/quote]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0sbPEw11wYE
[h1]They're Firing Missiles![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/91f23cc8dd9b621023798aefd20f424c05734956.jpg[/img]

Two light tanks were added to the American Tech Tree. Now, the T49 can be researched to the T92E1, which will further lead you to the Tier X XM551 Sheridan. The key feature of these new vehicles are guided missiles. This is a special type of shell marked with a new icon. And you can control their flight! The other two types, APCR and HE shells, work as usual.

[b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/atgm-branch/]READ MORE[/url][/b]


[h1]Avatars for Medals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ad88b21c6d54c53de5b0d2a8aff5ad0aa6aa3302.jpg[/img]

Accumulative avatars for Kolobanov's, Top Gun, and High Caliber medals were added to the game. The more medals you earn, the cooler the corresponding avatar looks!

[b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/avatars-for-medals/]READ MORE[/url][/b]

Those who don't use an avatar will see a different version of the "empty" avatar.


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b4fe035120df9069b4462cd7ab987f076c995556.jpg[/img]

[b]Tiers IX and X[/b]

121B:[list][*]Reload time was reduced from 7.19 to 6.9 s.[/list]
FV215b:[list][*]Vehicle durability was decreased from 2,100 to 2,000 HP.[/list]
Grille 15: [list][*]Concealment upon firing while stationary was increased from 1 to 2%. This means now you'll have to move a bit closer to spot a firing Grille 15.[/list]
AMX 50 Foch (155):[list][*]The average damage of an AP shell was decreased from 640 to 560 HP for both guns.
[*]The average damage of a HE shell was decreased from 960 to 680 HP for both guns.
[*]The reload time was reduced from 15.34 to 13.42 s for the 155 mm AC SA58 gun.
[*]The magazine reload time was reduced from 17.26 to 14.38 s for the 155 mm AC SA58 mod. 2 gun.[/list]
Progetto M40 mod. 65:[list][*]Aiming time was increased from 3.5 to 4.1 s.
[*]Dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.326 to 0.345 m.
[*]Engine power was decreased from 670 to 632 hp.
[*]Hull traverse speed was decreased from 52.15 to 50.06 deg/s.
[*]Dispersion on the move, as well as on hull and turret traverse, was decreased.[/list]
Prototipo Standard B:[list][*]For the Cannone da 105 Rh V1 gun:[list][*]Dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.336 to 0.345 m.
[*]Dispersion on turret traverse was increased.[/list][/list]

[b]Tiers VI and VII[/b]

The frontal armor was enhanced for some Tier VI–VII vehicles. Thus, the number of tanks that can easily penetrate them from the front will reduce. Now, you'll have to aim at vulnerable areas or attack the flanks more often when firing at these vehicles.

Enhanced main armor:[list][*]Black Prince: from 152 to 180 mm for the hull's front.
[*]IS-2: from 90 to 120 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
[*]IS: from 120 to 155 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
[*]IS-2 (1945): from 100 to 140 mm for the turret's front.
[*]KV-3: from 120 to 165 mm for the hull's front, from 100 to 145 mm for the stock turret, and from 130 to 165 mm for the top turret.
[*]T29: from 102 to 120 mm for the hull's front.
[*]T25 AT: from 120 to 145 mm for the hull's front.
[*]Jagdpanther: from 80 to 120 mm for the hull's front.
[*]Panther I: from 85 to 110 mm for the hull's front and from 120 to 160 mm for the top turret.
[*]Tiger I: from 100 to 165 mm for the hull's front.[/list]
Also, different parts of the frontal armor (cabins, hatches, cupolas, guns and their mantlets, etc.) were reinforced for the AT 8, AT 7, and aforementioned vehicles.


[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/fc833b44e52dd8c81d78fd04191ded632b204ef7.jpg[/img][list][*]The "Receive messages only from friends" setting was added. It is enabled by default.
[*]An eleventh mission was added for the iOS and Android versions of the game: watch 5 video ads. Reward: 500–1,500 Free EXP depending on the mission level.
[*]When selecting a turret, the change to elevation/depression angles is now displayed in the vehicle characteristics.
[*]The Panzer IV Anko Special was renamed Panzer IV Ankou Special upon our partner's request.
[*]Differences in the cost of researching the same engines used on several vehicles were eliminated.
[*]Clan discount on camouflage is now displayed in the Appearance section.
[*]The red indicator for new messages in chat is no longer displayed if all messages have been read.
[*]New messages in clan chat are now displayed as one unread message.
[*]Upon purchasing a tank, consumables are now automatically mounted on it.
[*]The bug where Adrenaline didn't disappear on the consumables screen upon changing a standard gun to a magazine-based was fixed.
[*]The bug in the range finder armor on the E 75's turret was fixed.
[*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

Accumulative avatars for Kolobanov's, Top Gun, and High Caliber medals were added to the game. The more medals you earn, the cooler the corresponding avatar looks!

tags.balance_change: Reload time was reduced from 7.19 to 6.9 s.
Vehicle durability was decreased from 2,100 to 2,000 HP.
Concealment upon firing while stationary was increased from 1 to 2%. This means now you'll have to move a bit closer to spot a firing Grille 15.
The average damage of an AP shell was decreased from 640 to 560 HP for both guns.
The average damage of a HE shell was decreased from 960 to 680 HP for both guns.
The reload time was reduced from 15.34 to 13.42 s for the 155 mm AC SA58 gun.
The magazine reload time was reduced from 17.26 to 14.38 s for the 155 mm AC SA58 mod. 2 gun.
Aiming time was increased from 3.5 to 4.1 s.
Dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.326 to 0.345 m.
Engine power was decreased from 670 to 632 hp.
Hull traverse speed was decreased from 52.15 to 50.06 deg/s.
Dispersion on the move, as well as on hull and turret traverse, was decreased.
Dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.336 to 0.345 m.
Dispersion on turret traverse was increased.

The frontal armor was enhanced for some Tier VI–VII vehicles. Thus, the number of tanks that can easily penetrate them from the front will reduce. Now, you'll have to aim at vulnerable areas or attack the flanks more often when firing at these vehicles.
Black Prince: from 152 to 180 mm for the hull's front.
IS-2: from 90 to 120 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
IS: from 120 to 155 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
IS-2 (1945): from 100 to 140 mm for the turret's front.
KV-3: from 120 to 165 mm for the hull's front, from 100 to 145 mm for the stock turret, and from 130 to 165 mm for the top turret.
T29: from 102 to 120 mm for the hull's front.
T25 AT: from 120 to 145 mm for the hull's front.
Jagdpanther: from 80 to 120 mm for the hull's front.
Panther I: from 85 to 110 mm for the hull's front and from 120 to 160 mm for the top turret.
Tiger I: from 100 to 165 mm for the hull's front.
Also, different parts of the frontal armor (cabins, hatches, cupolas, guns and their mantlets, etc.) were reinforced for the AT 8, AT 7, and aforementioned vehicles.

tags.feature: The "Receive messages only from friends" setting was added. It is enabled by default.
An eleventh mission was added for the iOS and Android versions of the game: watch 5 video ads. Reward: 500–1,500 Free EXP depending on the mission level.
When selecting a turret, the change to elevation/depression angles is now displayed in the vehicle characteristics.

tags.bug: The Panzer IV Anko Special was renamed Panzer IV Ankou Special upon our partner's request.
Differences in the cost of researching the same engines used on several vehicles were eliminated.

tags.feature: Clan discount on camouflage is now displayed in the Appearance section.

tags.bug: The red indicator for new messages in chat is no longer displayed if all messages have been read.
New messages in clan chat are now displayed as one unread message.

tags.feature: Upon purchasing a tank, consumables are now automatically mounted on it.

tags.bug: The bug where Adrenaline didn't disappear on the consumables screen upon changing a standard gun to a magazine-based was fixed.
The bug in the range finder armor on the E 75's turret was fixed.
Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

notes.title: Rating Battles in December
notes.content:
Winter has set in, kicking off another busy season of battles for ratings! We know it's not just about the desire to get to the top of the leaderboard. The prizes, including bonuses for scoring a victory, a rare camouflage, avatars, and gold, are good enough to give inspiration, too! Right, Commander?
[list][*] From December 5 through 31, play in Tier VII-X vehicles.
[*] Fight ten calibration battles. Based on the results, you will be placed into one of five Leagues:  Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or Diamond.
[*] Earn rating points and progress up the leaderboard, while moving from one League to another.
[/list]
Remember: the better you perform in battle, the more rating points you will receive.

You can get up to four warpaints for a corresponding League: one for each eligible vehicle tier, as long as you have fought at least 50 battles in vehicles of that tier.

notes.title: Update 6.5
notes.content:
This is it! The update that will save Horrorstadt from the midnight spells and change everything (well... almost everything) back. In this update, we reworked the interface, added new camouflages and avatars, and improved the characteristics of Premium vehicles. Also, someone played with the brightness, contrast, and saturation sliders, and a certain day of the week became much darker.

[h1]Watch the update video review and download the new version from November 20![/h1]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w9wxvI5wlRY
[h1]New Garage Interface[/h1]
The design of numerous screens was updated, animations were added, and access to important functions became easier. The key changes include:
[list][*]The main menu is now always open and is displayed as icons on the left side of the screen. It became easier to enter the needed section and notice any updates thanks to red indicators. In the left side menu, you can find: profile, news and notifications, Tech Tree, missions, storage, clans, platoon game, tournaments, communities, and settings.[/*][*]The player's current rating and the corresponding league are now displayed under the avatar in the upper left corner.[/*][*]In the vehicle panel, vehicles are now sorted from the highest tier to the lowest, and the button with filters is on the right.[/*][*]The menu with tank filters was improved. The filters of Elite and Non-Elite vehicles are now separated from the vehicle type (researchable, Premium, Collector). A counter of filtered vehicles was introduced.[/*][*]The Upgrades and Crew tabs were added to the vehicle enhancement screen. Now, info about the level of enhancements of the selected vehicle, as well as all possible actions with this vehicle, are available in one place.[/*][*]Clan search, nickname change, replays, and the list of received rewards can now be found in the Profile screen.[/*][*]Notifications in the upper part of the screen became more compact and no longer fully cover this part of the screen.[/*][/list]
In fact, the improvements are much more numerous. But, as it's said, it's better to see them once than to hear about them a thousand times. The screens and interface elements that remained untouched will be changed in future updates.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list][*]WZ-113, WZ-121, and M4A1 Revalorisé: increased damage.[/*][*]WZ-120: reduced reload and aiming time.[/*][*]Chieftain/T95: enhanced armor and increased penetration.[/*][*]T95E2 and Churchill Mk. VI: enhanced armor.[/*][*]The profitability of researchable Tier III tanks was changed.[/*][*]The cost in credits of researchable Tier IV vehicles was increased.[/*][*]The cost to unlock equipment for Tier I–V vehicles was significantly reduced.[/*][/list]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/vehicle-changes-6-5/]Read more[/url]

[h1]Appearance and Avatars[/h1][list][*]A Legendary camouflage called Roaring was added for the E 50 Ausf. M. Cost: 2,550 gold.
[/*][*]Rare camouflages called Elemental Breath and On the Edge, winners of the [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/event/smashing-camo-contest-results/]camo contest[/url], were added. Cost: 42,000–600,000 credits depending on the vehicle tier. Can be resupplied for free.[/*][*]A Rare camouflage called Ancient Relic was added. Also, the Iron Will warpaint became available for purchase again. Cost: 65–750 gold depending on the vehicle tier. Can be resupplied for free.[/*][*]The following warpaints were removed from sale: Spooky Web, Pumpkin Mayhem, Hardy, Missile Salvo, Missile Arsenal, Thunder and Lightning.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/d78afa65813f94ec062fe734c5d611c93478d039.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/247e7e5b3658f001be47a287ced8b94303932765.jpg[/img]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/camouflage-6-5/]More screenshots[/url]


Iron your handkerchief, make chamomile tea, and start to squeeze a stress-relief toy. An emotional set of avatars is available now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/19e0165c29984dfb1468d0b62ea4673aea2996b2.png[/img]
Temporary versions of the new avatars can be found in bonus containers in the Store. Permanent ones can be received from the Basic Week's Supply container awarded for completing missions, and later also from Avatar Containers in the Store.

[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1][list][*]Weather effects were optimized on the Himmelsdorf, Winter Malinovka, and Canal maps. Now they don't affect the FPS that much.[/*][*]The "Damage with your assistance" ribbon was added. It is awarded when your ally causes damage to an enemy vehicle that you spotted or immobilized by destroying their track.[/*][*]Common: total damage is less than 30% of your tank's HP.[/*][*]Rare: total damage is 31–50% of your tank's HP.[/*][*]Epic: total damage is 51–70% of your tank's HP.[/*][*]Legendary: total damage is 71% of your tank's HP or more.[/*][*]The highlighting of penetration zones in Sniper Mode now considers the decreased penetration of HE shells from the Defense System + equipment.[/*][*]The Jack-in-the-box effect is implemented for all turret vehicles, except for tank destroyers, Gravedigger, Matilda, and Cruiser Mk. III.[/*][*]The bug where the marker of damage received in battle could be displayed with an incorrect direction was fixed.[/*][*]The bug where it was impossible to enter the battle after dismissing the platoon in situations where the platoon commander selected rating battles was fixed.[/*][*]A Swedish flag is now displayed under the Stridsvagn 74A2 icon.[/*][*]The indicator of loaded shells was fixed for the Helsing. tags.feature: The main menu is now always open and is displayed as icons on the left side of the screen. It became easier to enter the needed section and notice any updates thanks to red indicators. In the left side menu, you can find: profile, news and notifications, Tech Tree, missions, storage, clans, platoon game, tournaments, communities, and settings.
The player's current rating and the corresponding league are now displayed under the avatar in the upper left corner.
In the vehicle panel, vehicles are now sorted from the highest tier to the lowest, and the button with filters is on the right.

The menu with tank filters was improved. The filters of Elite and Non-Elite vehicles are now separated from the vehicle type (researchable, Premium, Collector). A counter of filtered vehicles was introduced.

The Upgrades and Crew tabs were added to the vehicle enhancement screen. Now, info about the level of enhancements of the selected vehicle, as well as all possible actions with this vehicle, are available in one place.
Clan search, nickname change, replays, and the list of received rewards can now be found in the Profile screen.
Notifications in the upper part of the screen became more compact and no longer fully cover this part of the screen.

A Rare camouflage called Ancient Relic was added. Also, the Iron Will warpaint became available for purchase again. Cost: 65–750 gold depending on the vehicle tier. Can be resupplied for free.
The following warpaints were removed from sale: Spooky Web, Pumpkin Mayhem, Hardy, Missile Salvo, Missile Arsenal, Thunder and Lightning.
An emotional set of avatars is available now!
Weather effects were optimized on the Himmelsdorf, Winter Malinovka, and Canal maps. Now they don't affect the FPS that much.
The "Damage with your assistance" ribbon was added. It is awarded when your ally causes damage to an enemy vehicle that you spotted or immobilized by destroying their track.

notes.title: Uprising: The Mystical Abilities
notes.content:
Master invisibility, illusions, time jumps, and lightning strikes to enemy tanks. These mystical abilities that break the laws of the universe are available now in the new Uprising battle type.

Harness them and make your combat capabilities almost unlimited! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f987c315f29b8cf2e183f816891587ed10bb8077.jpg[/img]

There are 16 abilities featured in Uprising. They can be divided into two types:
[list]
[*] [b]Active abilities[/b] that you can enable yourself when you see fit by tapping the Abilities button in battle
[*] [b]Passive abilities[/b] that work permanently from the moment you join the battle.
[/list]
[i]In Uprising, every tank possesses one active ability depending on the vehicle class. Generally speaking, light and medium tanks feature Shadow or Time Jump, heavies use Play Dead or Dust Devil, while tank destroyers have Hunter's Mark or Blood Trail. [/i]

Elixir earned in battle can get you ten more passive abilities. You can select them from three random options as you wait to return to battle: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/086d303ecca00495a5bbd8ed280b9c97810c340d.jpg[/img]

The acquired passive abilities work permanently during battle even after the vehicle has been destroyed and returned to battle.

[i]Some passive abilities are available in two variants: standard (Grade I) and a more expensive and enhanced one (Grade II).[/i]

The more Elixir you accumulate, the more abilities you can get.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/32ed9e2d0707b6e89100120d6c42d8913dad1ba6.jpg[/img]

The stock of Elixir is being constantly accumulated during battle. To earn more Elixir, you need to perform useful actions in battle. For example, deal damage, destroy enemy vehicles, or perform the scout role.

[i]Effects from different abilities can add up and complement one another. For example, adding the Doubleshot ability to Chain Lightning will enable you to attack three opponents at once and with double the speed. Create your own strikingly powerful combination of abilities and unleash them upon your enemies![/i]

[h1]Active Abilities[/h1]
[b]Time Jump[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3d4bfcfd81725418af8f24e41ff1c90bb19588af.png[/img]
Takes your tank 4 seconds into the past to the same position on the map and with the same amount of HP it had.
This ability does not take effect if your tank is destroyed.
Cooldown time: 30 seconds

[b]Play Dead[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b38990e09c9ec8d8ea1f315006728f3884916914.png[/img]
To enemies, the tank takes on the illusion of a destroyed one: its appearance changes, HP is not displayed, and when spotted, it's not marked as an enemy vehicle.
In this state, the vehicle can drive, rotate the turret, and shoot. The effect ends when the tank gets damaged. While the ability is in effect, the enemy tank's first shot doesn't do any damage.
Duration: 15 seconds
Cooldown time: 35 seconds

[b]Shadow[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/759f0009e7e19d00a2c7396c5558dfadf62ef299.png[/img]
The tank becomes invisible and moves at an increased speed. The effect ends when the tank takes a shot or receives damage.
+300% to engine power.
+30 km/h to maximum speed.
Duration: 10 seconds
Cooldown time: 35 seconds 

[b]Hunter's Mark[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ac3d3a77e5927a4dd18b86667a97dd993f4f2762.png[/img]
Enables allies to deal increased damage to the enemy vehicle that Hunter's Mark was aimed at.
+60% to damage by all allies to the target vehicle bearing the Hunter's Mark.
Duration: 10 seconds
Cooldown time: 30 seconds 

[b]Blood Trail[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9aa97166cbe2184df3ceafc38542e52812ae5733.png[/img]
Enemy vehicle marked by the Blood Trail loses HP while moving. 
−10% from the maximum HP every 10 m.
Duration: 10 seconds
Cooldown time: 45 seconds 

[b]Dust Devil[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/568483303563e4aef14b33390e6392e4eccbb15b.png[/img]
Instantly spins the enemy tank in a random direction. 
Cooldown time: 50 seconds

[h1]Passive Abilities[/h1]

[b]Doubleshot[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5b8ce4ceb8eb43e734fbcdc9eb06ff40c064537a.png[/img]
Enables your vehicle to fire 2 shells per shot.
Results in increased gun dispersion and aiming time.
+140% to gun dispersion.
+80% to aiming time.
Cost: 400 of Elixir

[b]Chain Lightning (Grade I and II)[/b]
Enables you to deal damage not only to the target vehicle, but also to its two closest allies, all with one shot. Inflicts increased damage to all affected vehicles and takes effect only upon penetrating enemy armor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/079cf8c9ec247bb3e4e276ece3cac0b5efb43657.png[/img]
Grade I
Effect Radius: 60 meters
Bonus to damage: +25%/+15%/+10% to single-shot damage of your vehicle.
Cooldown time: 6 seconds
Cost: 200 of Elixir

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/f6db070f1172427ccbbc6d2994563f711e9528d8.png[/img]
Grade II
Effect Radius: 70 meters
Bonus to damage: +45%/+35%/+25% to single-shot damage of your vehicle.
Cooldown time: 6 seconds
Cost: 400 of Elixir

[b]Last Gasp[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ac434f08233c6679783c234b37d6d9dd44fff22b.png[/img]
Upon receiving fatal damage, the vehicle is not destroyed but it continues playing with 1 HP left.
The ability does not take effect in the event of an ammo rack explosion.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[b]Supernatural Power (Grade I and II)[/b]
Boosts the vehicle's speed and mobility during a battle. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/15f0eb97557faaf39041ae49ccb29f3ce3611589.png[/img]
Grade I
+110% to engine power.
+10 km/h to maximum speed.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cdce7fd8da117b490f62bb97f9ef8f5e8435da24.png[/img]
Grade II
+210% to engine power.
+20 km/h to maximum speed.
Cost: 200 of Elixir

[b]Sixth Sense[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1536b23b69f49a830675382a81acb58c09501baf.png[/img]
Allows you to see the reload bar above enemy vehicles.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[b]Inferno[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/a78dd9bd7c7920065cf7e7ba507b6aa5a168f5bf.png[/img]
When fired at any target or object on the map, the shell explodes and causes splash damage to all enemies within a 25 m radius.
+30% of your tank's maximum HP to damage.
Cooldown time: 30 seconds
Cost: 400 of Elixir


[b]Jagged Shells (Grade I and II)[/b]
Increases damage from a shot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/faf66e2b40d9a521319552fe3748ff0d1203feb6.png[/img]
Grade I
+20% to damage from one shot.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/54f029f2289cb395e79e71b324e1b260dd433a87.png[/img]
Grade II
+40% to damage from one shot.
Cost: 200 of Elixir

[b]Rapid Fire (Grade I and II)[/b]
Increases firing speed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/66899dfcab969d4b5ffc7c074e67c8f741f5126d.png[/img]
Grade I
−20% from the gun reload time.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/89a81f01758301623c92e5a2cd5b63394569d874.png[/img]
Grade II
−35% from the gun reload time.
Cost: 200 of Elixir

[b]Wolf Strike (grade I and II)[/b]
Increases the efficiency of ramming attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4e44d43f7d2d7a4b4c463b0f43296ee9fc24c15c.png[/img]
Grade I
+60% to damage caused to an enemy vehicle by ramming.
−35% from damage by enemy ramming.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/5e128841569516b6d1e66e236853b93cb7b4bbec.png[/img]
Grade II
+110% to damage caused to an enemy vehicle by ramming.
−65% from damage by enemy ramming.
Cost: 200 of Elixir

[b]Phantom[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/379a4041bc559fc9537aec9dbf7c506ffa1df34d.png[/img]
When leaving the spotting range, the tank becomes invisible. The light bulb appears immediately.
Cost: 100 of Elixir

[i]Harness these mystical abilities and crush anyone who stands in your way![/i]

notes.title: Uprising: Dark Magic on the Battlefield!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/a856d5f3889d0702ca0254ced4dcd96145504171.jpg[/img]

As the Hunter's moon rises in the sky, the wind sings its mournful song. In times like this, the line between life and death becomes thinner and the laws of the universe begin to crack. But the battle must go on!

Test your skill in the new Uprising battle type. Unleash your tanks' mystical abilities upon the enemy and continue the fight even after being destroyed!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kKLyLSerztY
[h1]Uprising[/h1]
In Uprising, the destruction of a tank does not mean the end of the battle. On the contrary, combat is in full swing! During each battle, your tank can respawn twice, becoming even stronger and more dangerous than before. But don't get too comfortable. If your tank is destroyed a third time, you're out.

After each respawn, your tank becomes invisible and receives a major speed boost for ten seconds. Go full speed towards the spot of your destruction and wreak vengeance on the opponent who tried to send you to the Garage!

[i]Please note that respawns and abilities available in the new battle type will enable you to cause more damage, which will pay off in increased credit earnings. However, the cost of repairs will also increase because in each battle, your tank can be destroyed several times. [/i]

[h1]Abilities[/h1]
In Uprising, special mystical abilities that change the laws of the universe will be at your disposal. Harness them to make your combat potential almost unlimited!

Caught in a trap and received damage? Just rewind time.

Spotted an enemy tank? Turn invisible and strike from behind.

Found yourself surrounded? Rush off at inconceivable speed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c2ecbfd0b3199077971da4d20d3c6fed1d2fc7b6.jpg[/img]

In Uprising battles, each tank features one permanent ability depending on your vehicle's type. Ten more abilities can be purchased in battle using the accumulated Elixir.

[i]More details about all abilities used in the Uprising battle type can be found [url=https://wotblitz.eu/en/news/event/uprising-mystical-abilities/]here[/url]. [/i]

[h1]Elixir [/h1]
Elixir is gradually accumulated throughout the whole battle. Your effective actions in battle, such as causing damage or spotting enemy vehicles, will earn you even more Elixir, which will allow you to purchase more abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ac6953be105a3bb97e7839ef91dafcec40b62827.jpg[/img]

[h1]Schedule[/h1]
The Uprising battle type will be available:
[list]
[*] CIS: from October 18, 08:00 (MSK) through November 2, 08:00 (MSK)
[*] Europe: from October 18, 14:00 (CEST) through November 2, 13:00 (CET)
[*] North America: from October 18, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET) through November 2, 6:00 (PT) / 9:00 (ET)
[*] Asia: from October 18, 14:00 (UTC+8) through November 2, 14:00 (UTC+8) 
[/list]

[i]To play an Uprising battle, select it in the menu next to the "Battle!" button.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/14ffc588722ecfc93d2149c620b966ac1dafa251.jpg[/img]

[h1]Vehicles[/h1]
Battles are fought in Tier V–X vehicles.

[h1]The Mode and Maps[/h1]
Battles are fought only in Encounter Battle mode on all maps, except for Normandy and Falls Creek.

[h1]Uprising Avatars[/h1]
For your victories in Uprising battles, you will be rewarded with a permanent avatar.
There are 7 avatar grades in total from Common to Legendary. The more you win, the higher the avatar grade you get!

[i]Harness these mystical abilities and turn them to your advantage![/i]
