notes.title: Update 5.6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/8827a982c4628b5433e6d5c89cdbc9d6296ac8fb.jpg[/img]

On December 5, you will be able to start hunting for avatars, feel like a participant of Operation Overlord when playing on the Normandy map, adorn your vehicles with new warpaints, and install boosters during the pre-battle countdown.      
   
https://youtu.be/hTD5HM67PVM

[h1]Main Changes and Improvements[/h1]      
Avatars were introduced into the game:      
Avatars are a fun new feature that will allow you to show off your personality and accomplishments in the game. Read more about them in the special article [url=/news/updates/avatars-5-6-update/]"Choose your avatar in Update 5.6!"[/url].      
[list][*]They will be kept in the new Avatars tab in the Storage, which is where you can install them.
[*]There are temporary and permanent avatars.
[*]With the release of Update 5.6, temporary avatars will start to drop from bonus containers.
[*]An avatar will be displayed:
[list][*]In the Garage instead of the Record button. Upon clicking the avatar icon, players will be taken to the Profile screen. 
[*]In the player's profile (formerly the Record screen).
[*]On the battle loading screen.
[*]On the team battle results screen.
[*]In the team list in battle. 
[*]In battle, next to the nickname of the ally that the player spectates after being destroyed.  
[*]In battle, next to the nickname of the enemy that destroyed the player's vehicle. [/list][/list]      
[url=/news/updates/normandy-map/]The Normandy map[/url] was added: the French coast in the midst of Operation Overlord. This map is available in Encounter battles and Supremacy mode for vehicles of Tier V and above.      
[url=/news/event/december-rating-battles/]December rating battles[/url] will start on December 5. As always, players of the Platinum League will be able to enjoy some exclusive advantages.       
Now, it will take some time before new players are able to train crew skills:      
[list][*]The Crew button and the tutorial tooltips for crew skill training will be activated in the Garage after receiving vehicles of Tier VI and above.
[*]At the same time, the skills themselves will be trained in the background—starting from the leftmost skill, until it reaches the maximum level. Players will be able to select another skill for training when a corresponding screen appears, provided that there are vehicles of Tier VI and above in their Garage.
[*]Now, all vehicles up to Tier V inclusive will always come with 100% crew mastery. 
[*]The first training in Regimental School to the level of 75% is now free. Subsequently, a normal fee will be charged.[/list]      
New warpaints were introduced, while some old ones were removed from sale:
[list][*]After the release of Update 5.6, the Fearless Lion, Sharp Spurs, Fierce Beak, Wise Raven, Glorious Eagle, Pumpkin Mayhem, Spooky Web, Unexpectable, Steppe Snowstorm, and Effective Concealment camouflage will not be available for purchase. 
[*][url=/news/updates/camouflage-5-6/]New warpaints[/url]: 
[list][*]The Exceptional Fighter legendary camouflage for the T-44. Cost: 1,450 gold.                                    [*]The Tectonic rare camouflage dedicated to WG Fest 2018. Cost: 65–1,200 gold depending on the vehicle tier
[*]The Cold-blooded rare camouflage. Cost: 65–1,200 gold depending on the vehicle tier. 
[*]The Frozen Flame rare camouflage. Cost: 65–1,200 gold depending on the vehicle tier. 
[*]The Glacial Armor rare camouflage. Cost: 65–1,200 gold depending on the vehicle tier.
[*]The Nine Lives common camouflage. Does not change the vehicle name in battle. Cost: 50–600,000 credits depending on the vehicle tier. [/list]      
[*]The following camouflages will be available for purchase again:
[list] [*]The "You Rock!" rare camouflage for the FV201 (A45). Cost: 1,070 gold.
[*]The Pixel Wave rare camouflage for the WZ-111. Cost: 620 gold.  
[*]The Digital Trace rare camouflage for the Type 59. Cost: 620 gold.[/list][/list]   
Boosters can now be activated on the battle loading screen:      
[list][*]It is now possible to install boosters during the pre-battle countdown. For that purpose, we added an interactive panel to the battle loading screen, where installed and not installed boosters are displayed.
[*]After the battle, only boosters activated by the player in the previous battle will be activated in the Garage.[/list]      
The characteristics of some vehicles were changed:       
[list][*]The economy of low-tier vehicles was changed. Tier I tanks are now repaired for free. The cost of repairing Tier II–IV vehicles was significantly reduced. 
[*]Tankenstein:
[list][*]The 130 mm B-13-S2 gun's mantlet armor was enhanced from 50 to 130 mm. [/list]
[*]Panther mit 8,8 cm L/71:
[list][*]Lower glacis plate armor was reinforced from 50 to 60 mm. 
[*]Hull side armor was enhanced from 50 and 40 mm to 60 mm.[/list]
[*]AMX 13 57:
[list][*]The vehicle’s concealment while moving was increased and is now equal to the vehicle’s concealment while stationary. [/list]
[*]ISU-130 , 130 mm S-26 gun:
[list][*]Dispersion at 100 m was decreased from 0.345 to 0.326 m.
[*]Aiming time was changed from 4.9 to 4.2 s.
[*]Dispersion on gun traverse was decreased.[/list] [/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1]      
Other improvements:  
[list][*]The German Tier X Maus can now be researched after the Tier IX Mäuschen only. Players can no longer research the Maus after the VK 45.02 (P) Ausf. B. 
[*]A second cluster was launched for the CIS region, which will improve the server’s ability to handle more online players. The online players counter is now divided into two parts. A player from the 1st cluster can invite a player from the 2nd cluster to join a platoon. While doing so, neither of them will have to enter the game again.
[*]After the update’s release, all Twister season items will be removed. Players will receive 30,000 credits as compensation for one Fan Banner, and 100 credits as compensation for one Support Point. Twister Coins will not be compensated.
[*]In the side menu, the Hall of Fame button that navigates to the list of top clans in the Hall of Fame on the portal will take the place of the Twister Season 2018 button. This button was also returned to the screen with the list of tournaments.
[*]The maximum rating earned in the current season (but excluding the maximum rating earned during calibrations) is now displayed in the Rating tab in the player's profile.
[*]The total number of victories in all battles fought in the current rating season is displayed in the bottom left corner of the screen.
[*]Up to four favorite vehicles are now displayed in the Rating tab. 
[*]Collector vehicles will no longer drop from bonus containers. 
[*]The "Enemy hit" ribbon was removed.
[*]The appearance of check boxes was improved. When enabled, a check mark is now displayed in orange.[/list]  
Bug fixes:      
[list][*]The cases where FPS dropped upon spotting enemy vehicles were fixed.
[*]The bug, where a white area appeared in the bottom left corner of the screen while loading the tournament team profile, was fixed.
[*]A sound now plays upon tapping the in-battle chat and settings buttons. 
[*]The Pzgr 40 K Armor-Piercing Composite Rigid shell in the 128 mm L50A gun of the VK 100.01 (P) is now displayed with the correct icon.
[*]The rate of victories in the list of clan members is now additionally highlighted in different colors.
[*]The bug, where the "BATTLE!" button was displayed in the Garage instead of the Repairs button, was fixed.
[*]Various screens, notifications, and descriptions were improved. 
[*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Update 5.5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/92f210e8cb869331b47b4ddac0f13fc051cb1578.jpg[/img]

Commanders, get ready to meet the new update on November 13! In Update 5.5, we added new German vehicles and camouflages, increased profitability in rating battles, and preserved the Wasteland map in regular battles. We also reworked more than 60 vehicles and improved the gameplay of low-tier vehicles.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O7Vx1uj1dRE
[h1]Main Changes and Improvements[/h1][list][*]The VK 100.01 (P), Mäuschen, and VK 72.01 (K) [url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/new-german-heavies/]heavy tanks[/url] were added to the German Tech Tree.
[list][*]The VK 100.01 (P) and Mäuschen can be researched after the Tiger (P).
[/*][*]The VK 72.01 (K) took the place of the Maus and can be researched after the VK 45.02 (P) Ausf. B.
[/*][*]Until the release of Update 5.6, the Maus can be researched after both the VK 45.02 (P) Ausf. B and Mäuschen.
[/*][*]Starting from Update 5.6, players will be able to research the Maus after the Mäuschen only.
[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/cbc9f4aa319d816bee702baa061e5833cc20e417.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The bonus to credits earned in rating battles was increased. Now it depends on the current rating, not on the league. The higher your rating, the more credits you will receive after battle:
[list][*]Gold League (3,000—3,999 rating points): a bonus of 0–32% was added to credits earned, depending on the current rating.
[/*][*]Platinum League (4,000—4,999 rating points): a bonus of 33–65% will now be added to credits earned instead of 30%, depending on the current rating.
[/*][*]Diamond League (5,000 rating points and above): a bonus of 66% and above (unlimited) will now be added to credits earned instead of 60%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]In Update 5.5, the Wasteland map will be available in regular battles and training rooms. We'd like to hear your opinion on this map outside the Mad Games mode and collect statistics to determine the future of this location. Your feedback is very much appreciated!

notes.title: Three German Giants
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/cbc9f4aa319d816bee702baa061e5833cc20e417.jpg[/img]

In Update 5.5, we'll put the German heavy vehicles' Tech Tree in order and replenish it with three Tier VIII-X tanks. A new Tier X tank VK 72.01 (K) with rear placement of the turret will take the place of the Maus and become a logical continuation of the VK 45.02 B, which has a similar configuration. Meanwhile, the Maus will head a new branch consisting of its previous projects: the VK 100.01 (P) and Mäuschen.

[quote]During Update 5.5, you'll be able to research the Maus after the VK 45.02 B. This means that if you were one step from the Maus before Update 5.5, you will still be able to research it, and you won’t have to research the Tier VIII and IX vehicles anew. Starting from Update 5.6, the Maus will only be unlocked after the Mäuschen.[/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/847436d17c8f7bc3b7226904f35067d867ea0ae1.jpg[/img]

Time to meet the new tanks! 

[h1]Tier VIII: the VK 100.01 (P)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/8875ad707bf87df9f30c920e75eaa97a59ed9076.jpg[/img]

Researched after the Tiger (P) for 78,500 exp.

The VK 100.01 (P) drives at a speed of 20 km/h, but this is reasonable considering its 200 mm upper armor plate and 230 mm frontal turret armor. This is particularly heavy protection for Tier VIII, and in capable hands the new tank will become a true mobile fortress.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/dd6ec71e7587ab08b3dca5a8b7c3eba673fbd565.jpg[/img]

It hasn't avoided having soft spots, either: they’re the tank's lower armor plate and commander's cupola. The cupola's armor doesn't slope, and a well-armed enemy will be able to penetrate it despite the impressive 200 mm of steel.

The 128 mm top gun of the VK 100.01 (P) is powerful but really slow. Capable of inflicting 460 HP of damage per shot, it takes 16 seconds to reload. It's possible some players will even prefer the regular 105 mm gun that deals less damage but makes more frequent and accurate shots.

[h1]Tier IX: the Mäuschen[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/46032dd1e8e51186d9bef8d1e23c2f1f904dddde.jpg[/img]

Researched after the VK 100.01 (P) for 160,500 exp.

This 168-ton "Mouseling" is a thicker and more mobile version of the VK 100.01 (P). The armor has become even heftier on the hull's sides and rear, as well as at the front and rear of the turret. The double tracks and powerful engine let this kid accelerate to 25 km/h—it's almost the Maus you've got here!

The lower armor plate has grown as thick as 180 mm, while the commander's cupola has acquired 220 mm of armor and moved to the other side of the turret. Despite the enhancements, these spots remain the “Mouseling's” main vulnerabilities in face-to-face combat as it now has to deal with Tier IX–X vehicles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/627b5db888a829413ee5e926a98ca4d878eccc3b.jpg[/img]

The Mäuschen's top gun is identical to that of the Maus, only with a decreased rate of fire and aiming speed. The 246 mm penetration together with the 460 hit points of single-shot damage make the new tank a dangerous enemy, while the availability of APCR shells means even the strongest opponents won’t have a chance.

[h1]Tier X: the VK 72.01 (K)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/2fd5f3418de527a7000d795b1f551c27e144be8c.jpg[/img]

Researched after the VK 45.02 Ausf. B for 245,000 exp.

The E 100’s twin, only with a rear placement of the turret and thicker armor. These tanks have practically identical armament, as well as similar dynamics and top speeds.

The whole of the VK 72.01 (K) frontal hull is protected with 240 mm of armor. The upper armor plate has a slope and is almost impenetrable. The lower armor plate is less sloped but provides good protection when angled. The easiest way to penetrate the frontal hull armor is by hitting the small panel between the upper and lower armor plates: it doesn't have a slope and serves as the spot with the highest chance of penetration.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/c163dafc91ba41e50bd14df0f0a34810f3e3ffba.jpg[/img]

The turret of the VK 72.01 (K) resembles that of the Löwe: just as round and wearing a big gun mantlet. Don't let the 200 mm of armor in the characteristics fool you as the gun mantlet adds another 200 mm on top of that!

Unlike the E 100, the new Tier X tank has only one gun. This 150 mm gun takes more than 17 seconds to reload, but is capable of an impressive 640 HP of damage and penetrates 258 mm of armor, while her HE shells can really hurt if the enemy is careless enough to expose a weak spot.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/2229768833513f9844234e21abaef6d38713ad6f.jpg[/img]

The German giants have appeared on the horizon. Prepare for battle on these superheavy steel monsters!

notes.title: The Never-Ending Battle between Good and Evil Is Upon Us
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/c90d4dfc020a9c0ed92abe964ebc035bf12b8f0e.jpg[/img]

The world has cracked in two, and these eternal rivals rise once more from the nether realm. 

https://youtu.be/7kG22VBPLfA
No need to choose a side: this time, you can command both vehicles that won their fame on the World of Tanks Blitz battlefields. With just a little luck and a 10% chance, you can become the owner of these cherished vehicles via containers that will be in the Store from October 26 to November 2. 

[b]Every Helsing or Dracula container will always bring you from 3 to 5 rewards: [/b]
[list]
[*] The Helsing H0 or T6 Dracula, depending on the container (10% chance)
[*] 150–10,000 gold
[*] 50,000–250,000 credits
[*] 1 or 2 Rare certificates for Free XP (2,300 Free XP)
[*] 3–25 Common certificates for Free XP (200 Free XP)
[*] 10–25 parts of the certificate for 24 hours of Premium Account
[*] 5 Epic Combat XP Boosters (+90%)
[*] 5 Epic Free XP boosters (+500%)
[*] 5 Epic Crew XP boosters (+250%)
[*] 5 Epic Credit boosters (10,000–50,000 credits) [/list] 

And don't miss the new in-game item—a Certificate for Free XP. Activate it and research the next tank in the Tech Tree faster! 

If you wish to obtain more Free XP, a bundle containing a Common certificate for 200 Free XP will also be available in the Store from October 26 to November 2. 

[h1]The terror that flaps in the night[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/95e14eb55605d255610aaf694ac8eb12c00cc7b4.jpg[/img]

Just like a bat in black, the T6 Dracula flies around the battlefield taking out one enemy after another. The Dracula's suspension is enchanted: the tracks are protected from the first direct hit, and in case of damage, they restore themselves in less than two seconds. This vampire pays for this ability with an increased chance of fire. 

[url=https://media-wbp.wgcdn.co/media/filer_public/06/2f/062f4a11-0fa7-4071-9dc6-abc447d8eb58/t6-dracula-stats-en.jpg]View the vehicle characteristics[/url] 

[h1]The light in the darkness[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/cf4d08a12669a2e51e6995d70662e2ab8561c916.jpg[/img]

An elegant Tier VII tank destroyer with golden inserts, the Helsing H0 is a perfect combination of style and devastating power, thanks to its twin gun resembling a crossbow. It fires twice in a row, just as you’d expect, with an interval of 0.25 seconds. The second shot is fired automatically. 

[url=https://media-wbp.wgcdn.co/media/filer_public/13/02/1302097a-ebc9-4ea7-916c-064f4d177674/helsing-h0-stats-en.jpg]View the vehicle characteristics[/url]

notes.title: The Road Warriors
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/2e1b5666eedb5f9ad7b7570985dbefdb4db1d8ca.jpg[/img]

A storm is coming. The biggest one in recent times. In these zero visibility conditions, only fools and madmen will leave the Garage. You don't look like a fool — you're still alive. So, I guess it's just a bunch of madmen. Fine, let's go then...Stop! Does everyone here have their Tier V vehicles? If not, get yourself the Scavenger at least. Everybody else — attention!

Hot coffee in the morning and homemade pastries? A myth. French fries and burgers? Fiction. TV shows and music? A history long forgotten. You are in the Wasteland. Only a few settlements remain here, plundered by a gang of psychos. There are locals that need resources to survive the storm. You may be a madman, but you don’t work for free — there will be rewards, plenty of them. But don't just hide in the bushes, otherwise you won't get anything.

[h1]Task[/h1]

Here's a VHS with short instructions:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UuvDsT9zKRs
It's simple, really. Open the map. There you will find two routes and marked settlements. Earn fuel and supplies for the nearest settlement, seize your reward, and move forward. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/33e6e30778a3bf063c0e5d8f2ac948eb1b26b439.png[/img]

You can hit the road from October 17 through October 25. The task must be completed in 10 days.  Then you will have an extra 8 days to purchase resources using gold. We will wrap it up on November 12

[list]
    [*]CIS: Individual start from October 17, 8:00 (MSK) through October 25, 8:00 (MSK). 
[*]Europe: Individual start from October 17, 8:00 (CEST) through October 25, 8:00 (CEST). 
[*]North America: Individual start from October 17, 4:00 (PT), 7:00 (ET) through October 25, 4:00 (PT), 7:00 (ET). 
[*]Asia: Individual start from October 17, 8:00 (UTC+8) through October 25, 8:00 (UTC+8). 
[/list]

Keep in mind — you have to collect a whole lot of resources. Only the most skilled players will be able to cross the entire Wasteland!

[b]Biogas[/b]

These days, Biogas is worth its weight in gold. It is normally used for tanks, but the locals also use it as fuel for power generators in their settlements. You can earn Biogas both in regular battles and in the Mad Games arenas. Each win will earn you 50–100 cans of Biogas depending on your vehicle tier. 

Here's the formula: 10 cans of Biogas multiplied by the vehicle tier.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/77bed9700f64f81d16d4158a06e8f8e3eb16ead9.png[/img]

By the way, don't expect to sit on the sidelines while others are fighting for victory: you can get Biogas only if you earn at least 300 base Combat XP.

[b]Cookies[/b]

Apart from Biogas, you will also need Cookies. This nutritious delicacy doesn't go stale or lose its taste. Besides, it goes really well with tea from the dust of Indian roads . You can find Cookies across the Wasteland. As a rule, they are packaged in Common Containers that protect food from radiation.

On average you can find 667 Cookies in each Container. Maybe more, maybe less.

[h1]Plunder[/h1]

You will get plenty of rewards for completing the task:
[list]
    [*]The Gravedigger
[*]The Tankenstein
[*]1 certificate for 9 hours of Premium Account
[*]67 Rare Combat XP boosters
[*]67 Rare Crew XP boosters
[*]67 Rare Free XP boosters
[*]20,000 Free XP
[/list]
[b]Tankenstein[/b]

One of the routes will lead you to the Tankenstein. You’ve probably already heard about this finalist of "the most dreadful tank" contest. Two hundred years ago, a mad scientist assembled it from the parts of other vehicles. Thick armor, increased profitability, and two powerful guns — you can also mount an alternative gun for 100 Combat XP. Prepare to make your enemy's existence a nightmare.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/ccff9bcb8dfcb2d747ddabab6872ff7f952e0c3a.jpg[/img]

It is still unclear how this heavy tank made it through the apocalypse without falling apart, but the ruthless Tankenstein is ready to fight again!

[b]Gravedigger[/b]

The second route will lead you to the Gravedigger. In years gone by (in 2018 to be more precise), Peter Pound©, the Principal Vehicle designer of Mad Max: Fury Road, drew some sketches of this vehicle. And when the old world collapsed, the mad Wasteland engineers constructed a working prototype.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/dd822c506feb5c53cb455347247c0f8dc38aa536.jpg[/img]

This vehicle is equipped with a 6-pounder 57 mm Nailgun with 6 shells in the magazine. It's loading time is just 0.67 seconds. The whole magazine takes roughly 11 seconds to reload, so stock up on shells and prepare for nonstop shooting.

The vehicle's armor is able to survive the attacks of most Tier VII medium and heavy tanks. The Gravedigger also features reliable frontal armor thanks to the extreme ricochet angles of its upper and lower plates. The sides, however, are a bit thin, but you can still sidescrape. 

Moreover, the vehicle features decent dynamics and the highest weight for its tier. The combination of speed, weight, and armor is a powerful one if you want to finish off your enemies by ramming them. So, don't hesitate to crush everything that moves.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/fbc0472bc78dd8416b2baaecc6ec99ddbfa22a68.jpg[/img]

Besides this, the Gravedigger is a Collector vehicle, so you can always sell it for 2,500 Gold in tough times.

Well, let's hope we didn't miss anything important... Ah yes, if you happen to use the Tankenstein or Gravedigger in the Mad Games arenas, don't forget about modifications. The first one is equipped with solid Uranium Shield and Half-Life Discharge, which increases your damage. The second one can boast Chameleon Concealment (hello invisibility, my old friend!) and Battle Coordinator, which improves some gun characteristics.

Well, that's all Folks!

© Peter Pound, Principal Vehicle Designer and Concept Artist, Mad Max Fury Road.

Besides this, the Gravedigger is a Collector vehicle, so you can always sell it for 2,500 Gold in tough times.

The first one is equipped with solid Uranium Shield and Half-Life Discharge, which increases your damage. The second one can boast Chameleon Concealment (hello invisibility, my old friend!) and Battle Coordinator, which improves some gun characteristics.

notes.title: How to Get the Scavenger
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/67c1e289f1dbc4abc29647d4de3c53cd26db9caa.jpg[/img]

Well hello there, survivor! Word has it you were kinda taken aback at the general meeting. They say that our life sucks and we have to fight for food and water all the time. Well, I agree. I'm not going to comfort you and pretend that we're sleeping on feather beds. But right now, you can calm down a little: my assignment won't be difficult.

So, here’s the story. The other day, I received an invitation from our elders to have some tea... I mean, some water with dust. And they said: ‘We have decided to invest in the future!’ Do you hear that? They’re geniuses! There’s a reason they’re the elders! We'll give a tank to the warriors, so that they can get more fuel and supplies for us. All you need to do is prove that you are worth your salt, which means winning 50 battles. You have to admit, it's not too much to ask. They are definitely very generous people!

https://youtu.be/UuvDsT9zKRs

The mission is simple. But I know how absent-minded you newcomers can be: you always forget everything and then tag along and ask the same questions over and over again. That's why I've recorded every single thing. Here, take the dictaphone: have a listen, remember everything, and tell the others. You see, there are too many of you and too few functioning devices.

[h1]Detailed instructions in 3.. 2.. 1..[/h1]

[code]Enter the game from October 17 through November 7. Score 50 victories in regular battles or in the Mad Games arenas within 10 days. Then click the “Win It!” button in the Garage and get the Scavenger.
End of record.[/code]

It's a snap, isn't it? Here's a piece of paper, where I've jotted down everything by date. You are free to decide when to start the mission.

[h1]Individual Start and Timelines[/h1]

Upon entering the game from October 17 through November 7 for the first time, your 10-day countdown will start. If you manage to win 50 battles during this time, you will get the Scavenger for free. The second stage of the mission will begin after 10 days. During this stage, you will be able to bring some gold to the elders, and they will turn a blind eye to your insufficient number of victories and give the tank to you. The second stage will last for 3 days.{list]
[*]Europe: individual start from October 17, 8:00 (CEST) to November 7, 7:00 (CET).
[*]North America: individual start from October 17, 4:00 (PT), 7:00 (ET) to November 7, 4:00 (PT), 7:00 (ET).
[*]Asia: individual start from October 17, 8:00 (UTC+8) through November 7, 8:00 (UTC+8).
[*]CIS: individual start from October 17, 8:00 (MSK) through November 7, 8:00 (MSK).[/list]

Battles on vehicles with special modifications will be available in the Mad Games arenas from October 17 through November 12. But you will not be able to fight at night from 0:00 (UTC) to 5:00 (UTC). Break schedule by servers:[list]
[*]Europe: from 2:00 (CEST) to 8:00 (CEST) / from 1:00 (CET) to 7:00 (CET).
[*]North America: from 22:00 (PT), 1:00 (ET) to 4:00 (PT), 7:00 (ET).
[*]Asia: from 2:00 (UTC+8) to 8:00 (UTC+8).
[*]CIS: from 2:00 (МSK) to 8:00 (МSK).[/list]

Entrance to the arenas in the battle type selection menu:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/1a3c246ed1c81cc04e646dac7fa6a33206d051e0.jpg[/img]

Now follow me, let's have a closer look at this tank.

[h1]Hope of the Wasteland[/h1]

Here it is, our beauty. Don't look at the rusty bits—the weather here isn’t always, heh, sunny, so the armor certainly suffers. But the turret is solid enough: 75 mm of frontal sloped armor. Bounce off enemy shells, block damage, and survive. While you’re holding position, the decent depression and elevation angles (8 and 12 degrees respectively) of the 75 mm gun will allow you to strike back.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/e5d41d47ec544bbb41b22884ca9733c07de37348.jpg[/img]

And strike back effectively! There are two guns at your disposal—just choose the appropriate one. The standard Scourge gun penetrates 110 mm of armor and inflicts 160 HP of damage with an AP shell. You can also mount an alternative howitzer for 12,000 Combat XP. Unlucky are those enemies who dare get too close, since the Shellthrower gun can cause 250 HP of damage with an AP shell.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/6308a00b69f812a9fed89684f185598edcd46bb3.jpg[/img]

The speed isn’t as high as that of the lightning-quick M7, but the tank can easily move forward at 50 km/h and backward at 20 km/h. This vehicle also has a high crossing capacity on different terrains, and that makes sense: we’ve only seen smooth roads in the pictures from old magazines.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/b657049067bce6a2385a29a520c3de4ff6ebd63a.jpg[/img]

If you are already tuned into the Mad Games mode, featuring various modifications, here are some more things for you to think about. The Scavenger comes with the Saboteur System and Accelerator modifications installed, which makes it an assault tank on the battlefield. The Accelerator will allow for both rushing into battle and quickly escaping, while the sandstorm and Saboteur System will help you cover your retreat. You can move around the battlefield like a flash and hit the enemy's weak spots.

[h1]A Tank with History[/h1]

I'm absolutely sure that you'll want to get this tank, whatever its characteristics. Since it isn’t just another vehicle to be claimed and forgotten. In years gone by (in 2018 to be more precise), Peter Pound©, the Principal Vehicle Designer of the Mad Max: Fury Road movie, drew some tank sketches in the post-apocalyptic style.

When the old world collapsed, our engineers decided to construct this particular prototype. People liked this idea, and now it is the most popular tank in the Wasteland. So Peter literally predicted the future. It's fantastic, isn't it?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/9c4df47a7a7a1ea8c0cbb45b81c0e76f637bebb7.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, the Scavenger is a collector vehicle. This means that in hard times, when the going gets tough, you will be able to sell it for 250 gold.

[h1]Last but Not Least[/h1]

I see you've already started thinking about winning strategies. Good on you! Guess what else we appreciate? Team spirit! Members of the same team wear similar clothes. That's what we did before the apocalypse and that's what we do now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/7f9e467df30ff5e2bc81ad7a991bb900cb485487.jpg[/img]

Turn round the corner and you will see a booth that’s a tone darker than the others—this is our shop. There’s nothing to distract the local seamstresses, so the shop's product range is expanded on a regular basis.

[url=https://shop.wotblitz.com/]See the merch[/url]

I think that's all for now. Meanwhile, make yourself at home and look around. As for me, I'll go and give further instructions. There are still the [url=https://wotblitz.ru/en/news/event/rush-mad-games/]Gravedigger and Tankenstein[/url], so be ready to pull up your socks to earn them. Take care!

Let engines roar and so forth.

© Peter Pound, Principal Vehicle Designer and Concept Artist, Mad Max Fury Road.

notes.title: Update 5.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/92f210e8cb869331b47b4ddac0f13fc051cb1578.jpg[/img]

Update 5.4 will bring interface and balance improvements, new attachments and camouflages, as well as fixes and changes you asked for! New vehicles, map, battle type with mod... oops, wrong news. You didn't see anything, okay?

[quote]Update 5.4 will be available on October 10.[/quote]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nd663xwDYUM
[h1]Main Changes and New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]The characteristics of the 121B, SU-122-54, T95E2, 59-Patton, Nameless, and Dicker Max were improved. The models of the M60, Waffenträger auf Pz. IV, IS-2 Sh, and Hafen were fixed. Read [url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/vehicle-changes-in-update-5-4/]this article[/url] to find out more.[/*]
[*]We continue to simplify the interface. Removing currency names in the Garage (did anyone even notice this?) and relocating bonus containers were the first steps. In Update 5.4, we rearranged the buttons in the Garage to group all vehicle configuration options in one place. Of course, it will feel unusual at first, but you will forget about the old interface after only a couple of days. Here's what changed:
[list][*]The Crew and Upgrades buttons were moved down and are now located above the vehicle panel next to the Appearance button.[/*]
[*]The boosters button took the place of the Crew button next to the main orange button. Now you will always remember to install them before battle!
[/*]
[*]The Record button is now located to the left of the player's nickname. It makes sense when the owner's name is displayed next to their medals.
[/*]
[*]The ping indicator and XP multiplier timer are now located to the right of the "Battle!" button.[/*]
[*]There are more changes to come! Regular game updates allow us to further improve the interface and make necessary changes.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/f9322b7bc9448f1d40d3aeb59db9d9dcfd00eae2.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Matchmaker rules applied in rating battles were changed:[list]
[*]Now each team can have up to seven heavy or medium tanks, and up to three light tanks or tank destroyers. As before, teams have an equal number of vehicles of the same class.[/*]
[*]Platoons are no longer available in rating battles. This change will allow for faster matchmaking. Rating battles without platoons will become more fair: teams are matched according to their total rating, while platoons with different ratings often resulted in unbalanced teams. Besides this, cunning fellows will no longer be able to enter easier battles by taking advantage of a huge difference in rating when creating platoons.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]A new vehicle type called collector vehicles was introduced to the game.[list]
[*]These vehicles can neither be found in the Tech Tree nor freely accessed. Collector vehicles can be obtained in in-game events, purchased during special offers in the Store, and received as a gift.[/*]
[*]Similar to the parameters of researchable vehicles, those of collector vehicles may be changed in exceptional cases.[/*]
[*]Vehicles that are currently available in the game can become collector vehicles in the future. For example, when a researchable tank is removed from the Tech Tree.[/*]
[*]Collector vehicles have a blue background in the game.[/*]
[*]Players will be able to sell some of them for gold.[/*]
[*]In Update 5.4, there are two collector vehicles: the Gravedigger and Scavenger. Stay tuned to learn more about them.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Two Halloween-themed [url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/blitz-horror-story/]attachments and camouflages[/url] were introduced.[/*][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/1dfbaed3e4705ea33fd889bb5394634a7cbc527b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a3ba74b649bb92cb1deb0f97614ca239d95b4923.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The cost of refreshing a completed mission was reduced from 300 to 100 gold.[/*]
[*]As part of the global change to the initial game experience, newcomers will fight mostly against each other rather than against experienced players.[/*]
[*]The game no longer supports Windows Mobile and iOS 7. The PC version of the game will still be released on Windows, and iOS 7 users will be able to continue playing after updating iOS to version 8 or later.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1][list][*]Ribbons are no longer displayed on the Battle Results screen if they are disabled in the settings.
[/*][*]The bug, where a ribbon was displayed upon causing damage to or hitting an enemy vehicle that had disappeared from spotting range, was fixed.
[/*][*]Clan tags are now displayed in the list of tournament team members.
[/*][*]Orders, stripes, and medals of the Twister season became accumulative.
[/*][*]The bug, where the number of Ace Tanker mastery badges was displayed incorrectly, was fixed.
[/*][*]Settings in the Other tab (e.g., the Record Replays option) are no longer reset after a re-login.
[/*][*]The reload indicator is no longer displayed above a destroyed ally.
[/*][*]On touch devices, the bug, where using the new Auto-aim resulted in the player tracking one vehicle with their reticle while the shell hit another, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where the room creator could not remove players from the training room because the respective button was not displayed, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where an enemy spotted at the map border was still displayed on the minimap after disappearing from spotting range, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where the time left until the battle end was displayed incorrectly after minimizing and maximizing the game client window, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where the chat and fire buttons, as well as speed were displayed over the panel with damaged modules in battle, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where an outline was not displayed around the vehicle that destroyed another player, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where repaired modules of the enemy vehicle were displayed incorrectly upon spotting it for the second time, was fixed.
[/*][*]The bug, where the number of items to be combined was displayed incorrectly in the Storage, was fixed.
[/*][*]On Android devices, the bug, where attachments were no longer displayed in battle upon restarting the game, was fixed.
[/*][*]Players can now select a battle type after receiving vehicles of Tier V or above.
[/*][*]The bug, where switching between regular and rating battles worked incorrectly when playing in a platoon, was fixed.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Blitz horror story
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/879b7217a081bb21eedb312c2adc14dd18dabd32.jpg[/img]
One of the best tactics is to sow fear and panic among your enemies from the very beginning. A high caliber, thick armor, a nickname with a huge number of exclamation marks and, of course, "dreadful" camouflage are well suited for this! Update 5.4 will also bring the brand-new "Halloween" attachments and warpaints. 

[h1]Spooky Web[/h1]
If on a dark night you find yourself exploring a far abandoned corner, you are sure to find a spider there. Or there may be more than one, who knows? They are weaving their webs there, distracting careless victims, and then immediately launching a shocking attack!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/b037b6426b9ed29f58d11e1189721fc1dc83118c.jpg[/img]
Camouflage price: from 35 gold to 500 gold depending on the vehicle's tier.

[h1]Pumpkin Mayhem[/h1]
While the hostesses bake pumpkin pies and prepare sweets for the children, you are free to roam and frighten them back to their parents, making your presence known in bright orange.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/1dfbaed3e4705ea33fd889bb5394634a7cbc527b.jpg[/img]
Camouflage price: from 45 gold to 680 gold depending on the vehicle's tier.

[h1]Wasted Shot[/h1]
Some say that this missile stuck in the hull is a mark from another world. Legend has it that its owner gets +10 to fearlessness when rushing the mid. The only thing we know for sure is its price — 410 gold for Tier VII vehicles, 530 gold for Tier VIII vehicles, and 240 gold for the M4A2E4 Sherman.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a3ba74b649bb92cb1deb0f97614ca239d95b4923.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tank-o'-lantern[/h1]
The old legend says that the Jack's candle helps souls find their way home. This one, however, will definitely help defeated enemies find their way back to the Garage. Available for only 315 gold for Tier VII vehicles, 410 gold for Tier VIII vehicles, and 185 gold for the M4A2E4 Sherman.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/8b95caeb6c64550de795c1c7d77a1cafa5ae8af9.jpg[/img]

The "Halloween" attachments are available for the most popular Tier VII-VIII vehicles and the Sherman Premium version: IS-3, IS, IS-5 (Oject 730), IS-6, KV-4, Т-43, Т-44, LTTB, T-54 ltwt., SU-152, ISU-152, AMX M4 mle. 45, AMX 50 100, AMX 13 75, AMX 13 90, Tiger I, Tiger (P), Tiger II, Löwe, Panther I, Spähpanzer SP I C, Spähpanzer Ru 251, Jagdpanther, Rhm.-Borsig Waffenträger, T29, M4A2E4 Sherman, T26E4 SuperPershing,  M41 Walker Bulldog, T49, T-34-1.

notes.title: The Fast-Firing FV201 (A45)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a98dbe60fa56f43434c3174d3fb4c99fe5c73a25.jpg[/img]

Let’s get to know the newbie, the FV201 (A45). First off, the French “autoloaders” will be envious of his outstanding rate of fire. The Brit has a strong, robust and fast-turning turret and superb gun depression angles, so he can use the hilly terrain to his advantage throughout the battle.

This gentleman isn’t so great when turning so he’s not set to become a rally driver, but certainly picks up speed when going in a straight line; simply press the accelerator and you’re hitting “max speed”. To top it all off, the FV201 (A45) earns even more credits per battle! Take command and to the victor go the spoils!

[quote]Until October 19, bundles featuring the FV201 (A45), with and without Equipment, are available in the Premium Store. Pick up the package to suit your personal taste.[/quote]

[h1]FV201 — A barrage of shots [/h1]

Just like other British heavies, the FV201 is a combination of measured slowness and a crazy rate of fire. But now onto the most pressing information, the stats: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a62b11a3843053a310da46dd7bb4b35d43fef1ec.jpg[/img]

The armored body of the FV201 (A45) is not as impressive as that of all its peers, but this disadvantage is levelled out by a decent margin of hit points. Except for the “tin roof”, the tower is pretty well protected: 152mm frontal combined with a thick gun mask. Add to this, the great depression of the gun and we have a recipe that’s simple for any tanker in the FV201 (A45): hide your hull behind obstacles or hilly terrain and return those shells to sender with your durable tower.

The maximum speed of the FV201 (A45) is 31km/h, and the tank speeds up in seconds. This helps the machine to arrive on time at the best firing positions and contribute to the enemy team’s destruction. On the other hand, the Brit doesn’t handle turns very well and certainly slows down when taking corners. But the lights and mediums preying on this slow-turning target are out of luck: the tower turns quicker than Benedict Arnold and will be ready to blow off your tracks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/b65bf07bf7dcb2f561287551680e5133b542eb03.jpg[/img]

Now let’s draw our attention to the main feature—the gun! If an unsuspecting enemy runs into the sight of the FV201 (A45), they will remember their mistake as their tank might now look like Swiss cheese, getting struck once every 3.6 seconds. Thanking this gentleman for the newly received extra vent holes with reciprocal fire won’t work. The Brit’s DPM for the exceeds over 2600! If you bring Equipment and Consumables, the reload time will decrease to 3.2 seconds with a DPM of 3000!

A standard AP round offers 171mm of penetration; that’s enough to take on more tanks of Tier VI and VII. When dealing with Tier VIII steel beasts, you will have to look back to your book on weak spots. At least the gun allows you to be fairly accurate. Use your pinpoint accuracy to deal damage, and if in a tight situation, sacrifice the damage by loading APCR rounds: they can penetrate 239mm of armor!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/06690ba27bba7d5095982d5276c0a76ec055fdd2.jpg[/img]

The FV201 (A45) is a born and bred second line fighter, able to continuously fire at enemy targets. He can not only cope with damage, but also sacrifice a couple of shots to track an enemy. Stopped dead in his tracks, this tank will unleash one shot at the Brit, but no bother, he will return three.

Low one-time damage and a high rate of fire means that the FV201 doesn’t perform well when playing peek-a-boom and exchanging shots with enemies. To effectively use the gun, keep the enemy in your sights for as long as possible. Use all your advantages: large stock of shells, good accuracy and stabilization. You know what that means—shooting on the move. Don’t wait for the enemy around the corner to reload. Burst in and deal damage!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/adc431f62a87dca78f8a2c4e3c180a45aa321164.jpg[/img]

For such maneuvers, you will need a strong ally with good armor. If there isn’t anyone helping you out, choose routes with uneven terrain and objects to hide the hull.

Now that you know this gentleman better, you will be able to achieve outstanding victories and earn a decent amount of credits for each trip to the battlefield. The rapid-firing Brit is waiting!

But the lights and mediums preying on this slow-turning target are out of luck: the tower turns quicker than Benedict Arnold and will be ready to blow off your tracks.
If an unsuspecting enemy runs into the sight of the FV201 (A45), they will remember their mistake as their tank might now look like Swiss cheese, getting struck once every 3.6 seconds.
Thanking this gentleman for the newly received extra vent holes with reciprocal fire won’t work.
The Brit’s DPM for the exceeds over 2600!
If you bring Equipment and Consumables, the reload time will decrease to 3.2 seconds with a DPM of 3000!
A standard AP round offers 171mm of penetration; that’s enough to take on more tanks of Tier VI and VII.
When dealing with Tier VIII steel beasts, you will have to look back to your book on weak spots.
At least the gun allows you to be fairly accurate.
Use your pinpoint accuracy to deal damage, and if in a tight situation, sacrifice the damage by loading APCR rounds: they can penetrate 239mm of armor!
The FV201 (A45) is a born and bred second line fighter, able to continuously fire at enemy targets.
He can not only cope with damage, but also sacrifice a couple of shots to track an enemy.
Stopped dead in his tracks, this tank will unleash one shot at the Brit, but no bother, he will return three.
Low one-time damage and a high rate of fire means that the FV201 doesn’t perform well when playing peek-a-boom and exchanging shots with enemies.
To effectively use the gun, keep the enemy in your sights for as long as possible.
Use all your advantages: large stock of shells, good accuracy and stabilization.
You know what that means—shooting on the move.
Don’t wait for the enemy around the corner to reload.
Burst in and deal damage!
For such maneuvers, you will need a strong ally with good armor.
If there isn’t anyone helping you out, choose routes with uneven terrain and objects to hide the hull.
Now that you know this gentleman better, you will be able to achieve outstanding victories and earn a decent amount of credits for each trip to the battlefield.
The rapid-firing Brit is waiting!

notes.title: The First Hunter: The WZ-120-1G FT
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/9b39a4a3369903ed5eaf2d19523c987a7135249e.jpg[/img]

Today we’re sharing the recipe for the ideal tank destroyer. 

Take a Type 59, carefully cut around the turret and remove it. Add a crafty one instead, sloped as much as possible. Weld together until a hard seal forms. Insert a powerful long-barreled gun and fill with Premium income. 

Congratulations! If you followed the formula to the letter, the first Chinese tank destroyer in the game is ready. Assume direct control of the WZ-120-1G FT and speed into battle! 

[quote]Until September 30, “The First Hunter” bundle featuring the WZ-120-1G FT is available in the Store. All the equipment is unlocked in the tank—simply press “Battle!” and start dealing damage.[/quote]

[h1]Daring, Bold, and Deadly[/h1]

The game already has tank destroyers based on medium tanks: the SU-122-44 and the SU-122-54 combine decent protection with agility and firepower. Our newcomer, the WZ-120-1G FT, has these qualities too: just check its stats! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/55133895b2e313639768b4f63efc6333e1ab72dd.jpg[/img]

The WZ-120-1G FT is equipped with a 122mm Tier X cannon able to penetrate 248 mm of armor with a single AP shell and 310 mm with HEAT. Tricks like shielding your weak spots and angling just won’t work against the WZ-120-1G FT: For this hunter, there are enough vulnerabilities on most of its opponents to target!

The damage that the new tank destroyer can dish out is also quite impressive. 400 points with a single shot (just with an AP round) combines perfectly with its short reloading time, meaning you can deal a damage per minute of more than 2500—even without Provisions and Equipment taken into count!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/d1c242598ac6a9b27fb128688f68105628257ed2.jpg[/img]

[quote]While the WZ-120-1G FT punches hard, it’s also well protected. The 120mm thick glacis plate is sloped at a low angle and will shrug off lots of enemy rounds or make them ricochet. To guarantee a damaging hit, an opponent should have around 220 mm of armor penetration![/quote]

The lower front plate of the new Chinese offers less protection, being 80 mm thick. But it’s very compact and sloped: To break through, an enemy tank needs roughly 150 mm of armor penetration. 

However, the sides and the rear of the WZ-120-1G FT have so little armor that any flanking adversary can score a hit. But a sneaky foe’s glee will be brief: the Chinese TD is a ‘descendant’ of the Type 59 and as such can turn pretty fast, so an enemy is unlikely to run circles around you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/66206fe73f425e1ff16dcb2558ebc7f0d91dbef4.jpg[/img]

The Type 59 ancestry shows in our hunter’s mobility too. The WZ-120-1G FT is quick to accelerate to 40 km/h, and that opens a whole lot of tactical opportunities. Taking a great firing position in a short time? Simple! Rushing the enemy with a bunch of medium tanks? Easy! Covering an ally retreat and then repelling an enemy assault on the other flank? No probs!

The WZ-120-1G FT shows itself to be a very flexible vehicle with the ability to achieve so much just in a single battle. The new TD is an asset both for your teammates and for yourself. Your side gets a valuable ally, and you get to enjoy the feeling of being victorious, while earning lots of Credits in every fight. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/3daa06d261ecbdefce397bd750e3effefbe98fe7.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a9e476bff4298bdece7f7e543490f5d32ddbde1e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/372508082bfe9d1af637c99f05c06878b1b0a30e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 5.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/659055022f231e30540fb4987835d7c6a369276f.jpg[/img]

The upcoming update is smaller in scope than some of our other updates. But we are releasing it in the shortest time possible, which means that all subsequent updates will be released earlier too. Update 5.3 will be available on September 12.

[h1]Main Changes and Improvements[/h1][list][*]Bonus containers (the ones you got used to opening every day) were moved to the separate Containers tab in the Store. A gift icon will notify you of a new container that can be opened for free.
[/*][*]Now you can also open bonus containers from the window with the description of their content.
[/*][*]The Tasks button in the Garage was renamed Missions. Only combat missions will be displayed here.
[/*][*]With Update 5.3, after completing the battle tutorial, newcomers will play mixed-type battles for some time. In these battles, bots fight instead of some players. Gradually, the number of players in mixed-type battles will increase, bots will become stronger, and their number will reduce. Thus, mixed-type battles will smoothly change into regular battles.
[/*][*]The mechanism of adding maps in regular battles was changed:[list]
[*]Battles on only Tier I vehicles are fought on the Fort Despair map.
[/*][*]Battles on Tier I–II vehicles are fought on the Fort Despair and Mines maps.
[/*][*]When entering a battle on Tier II–III vehicles or Tier III–IV vehicles, you can play on the Fort Despair, Mines, or Mirage maps.
[/*][*]The Black Goldville, Dead Rail, Copperfield, Falls Creek, and Himmelsdorf maps were added to the battles on Tier IV–V vehicles.
[/*][*]Starting from Tier VI, all maps are available.[/*][/list]
[/*][*]To make battles more diverse, the map selection mechanism was updated. Now, the server stores the last ten maps you fought on and tries to select something new. Since it is not easy to satisfy the demands of all players, you can still get a map from your last ten. But even in this case, the system checks all maps, starting from those you played on most rarely.
[/*][*]Repairs in training rooms became free.
[/*][*]Characteristics of M4A1 Revalorisé were improved:[list]
[*]Reload time was decreased from 10.54 to 9.58 s.
[/*][*]Cost of Armor-Piercing Composite Rigid shells was reduced from 1,200 to 760.
[/*][*]Turret armor (front/sides/rear) was reinforced from 63/63/63 to 90/65/65 mm.
[/*][*]Gun mantlet armor was enhanced from 89 to 100 mm.[/*][/list]
[/*][*]The Mecha Phoenix legendary camouflage for the O-47 tank is now permanently available, not only as part of bundles in the Store. Cost to unlock: 1,590 gold.
[/*][/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/e01fed8d6e6fdcc15107a163817144091029514f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h1][list][*]The voiceover, which played upon damaging the suspension or gun by a penetrating hit, was changed from "Enemy is hit!" to "Penetration".
[/*][*]On sensor devices, the work of Auto-aim was fixed in cases when you track one vehicle with your reticle, but the shell flies towards another.
[/*][*]Upon unlocking a camouflage or attachment, it is now installed automatically if the selected slot is empty. Camouflage is still installed manually in other slots.
[/*][*]Mouse sensitivity settings are no longer reset when switching to another tab of the settings.
[/*][*]The bug, where the exhaust smoke effect was not played 100 seconds after the battle started, was fixed.
[/*][*]Replays no longer freeze when you pause and fast-forward them.
[/*][*]The LIVE indicator is now displayed in the menu once the tournament is live-streamed.
[/*][*]The bug, where the notification of insufficient consumables was displayed when they were installed in all slots, was fixed.
[/*][*]Various screens, notifications, and descriptions were improved.
[/*][*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: T 55A: The Universal Fighter
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/24b9e5842c77e16f818c9ee9165d8bc6035d2ef6.jpg[/img]

What is the T 55A? It’s when you break into a drawn-out shootout, take out a couple of enemies and proudly leave the chaos you caused with others fearful that you are coming for them. When you ricochet a shell from a devastating gun, just smile and don’t give them a chance to reload. When you’ve tracked your prey, circle and tear them apart, then enter the heat of battle with enemy mediums. And all of this can take place in just one battle! 

[quote]Until September 14, the “Universal Fighter” bundle with the Enriched T 55A medium tank is available in the Store. All the equipment is unlocked in the tank—simply press “Battle!” and start unleashing carnage.[/quote]

[h1]The T 55A is ready for anything[/h1]

Stemming from the development of the iconic Soviet T-54 tank, the T 55A received its best traits: it’s dynamic with excellent maneuverability, a fast-turning turret and a quick-firing and accurate gun, even at full speed. Add to the mix great armor and you get a jack of all trades.

Each of the T 55A’s strengths are proven by its stats. At first glance, these figures are obvious: this tank will rip and tear. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/0250ed419279d694ec49c4b169a15b978edd7c0f.jpg[/img]

Although the frontal armor is lacking 20 mm compared to the T-54, the T 55A remains a sufficiently protected machine by medium tank standards. These lost millimeters in the body are almost unnoticeable: thanks to the slope, the effective thickness of the frontal armor reaches approximately 200 mm. The turret has thick armor and can ricochet—this will save a lot of your HP. 

The decent armor doesn’t prevent the T 55A from being a very mobile machine with high power-to-weight ratio. You can quickly accelerate and overcome obstacles at an average speed of 45 km/h, reaching 50–52 km/h in a straight line or 58 km/h when going downhill.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/f1f12274cec0baf115283b4bde18c3bf6d1f175f.jpg[/img]

The T 55A is armed with one of the fastest guns available to Tier IX medium tanks. Without any upgrades or equipment, you will fire every 7 seconds, dealing 310 damage per shot. The armor penetration of AP shells will suffice for any occasion, if we don’t include frontal crossfire with heavies. Such situations should be avoided, but if it’s already pressing on you, use HEAT to penetrate an average of 270 mm. 

[quote]Effective gun + Enriched T 55A = increased credit income for every fight[/quote]

In addition to the basic stats, the gun also has excellent stabilization. Movement, turning and firing minimally affect the scatter so you will be able to shoot effectively even at full speed. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/b196fe7ed7394ec56faf90b578c59eba154b1339.jpg[/img]

Like his researchable “elder brother”, the T 55A suggests an aggressive style of play. Capture the high land, avoid the enemy from the flanks, break into the very heat of battle, distract and torment enemy tanks in a most brash manner. The T 55A is one of the vehicles that can take out anyone and win a fight that seemed lost. If two of them are in a platoon, someone’s in trouble. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/fbd52f7004e1641210b9de19a379d0afc3aab119.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/d080ae615850e402806560e04f4ba4303393081b.jpg[/img]

[i]The T 55A is not a Premium tank. Its earnings correspond to that of Tier IX vehicles with activated enrichment. If necessary, the characteristics of the T 55A may be adjusted to improve game balance. [/i]

notes.title: The Furious ISU-130
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/12875db9c143fa2b40e5d7935cf23ad9f9c1734a.jpg[/img]

Try out a new Premium tank destroyer and enjoy its unusual gameplay. The gun of the ISU-130 uses two types of armor-piercing shells: the first penetrates 230 mm of armor and deals 460 HP of damage, the second penetrates 195 mm of armor and deals 530 HP of damage. When combined with a high rate of fire and equipment, this new tank destroyer can inflict up to 3,600 HP of damage per minute. Devastate enemy ranks and fill your coffers with credits! 

[quote]Bundles including the new ISU-130 with different sets of equipment are available in the in-game Store until September 14. Pick the bundle you like and roll out![/quote]

[h1]A 130 mm Caliber Argument [/h1]

The ISU-130 is a gun first and foremost. The rest is just a means of transportation. A quick glance at this vehicle's characteristics is enough to see that the ISU-130 is the ultimate damage dealer. It will teach your enemies the true meaning of damage — imminent and devastating!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/810c60075b54d56ca035b25856a66ab1add649ef.jpg[/img]

While dealing damage to the enemy, act wisely. Don't forget that you have almost no armor. If you're lucky enough, the large gun mantlet will protect you from enemy shells. But don't overestimate it and be careful. The dynamic characteristics of the ISU-130 are similar to those of its researchable "brother" the ISU-152. This means that the ISU-130 features an average speed of 30 km/h (without equipment) and turns around rather slowly.

But you will forget all about its drawbacks after taking your first shot. Perfect gun characteristics and enhanced shells make this new tank destroyer a dangerous opponent, which will quickly relieve the enemy team of excessive vehicles. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a3e6c6fce32a50bb23cb31f371d990dbd15650cb.jpg[/img]

If you see a well-armored tank in your reticle, use your main shells: they penetrate 230 mm of armor and deal 460 HP of damage. That's enough to make enemies think twice before approaching you. 

[quote]The real fun begins when you meet weaker armored tanks or when heavily armored monsters are reckless enough to expose their weak spots to your fire. The second AP shell penetrates 195 mm of armor, but its effectiveness considerably increases to 530 HP of damage. Do not hide your ammo panel in battle and switch to the second type of AP shells more often.[/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/a5c01626fe5a57db3ed00379ecc04ce3c013a69f.jpg[/img]

While playing on the ISU-130, stay away from close combat and follow the offensive of your allies, or take an advantageous position and defend the lane. Team up with your allies: your traverse speed is not good enough to confront a medium or light tank on your own. 

If you keep these tips in mind and fire accurately, the ISU-130 will show perfect battle performance and bring you piles of credits!

notes.title: Take it easy!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/369f0b5dd3456f4f07f494fde13931cb7d29a1bd.jpg[/img]

Hello-o, tankers! It's high time we played a game with you. The rules will be really simple, but be attentive... Let's see how great your desire to win is!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QDiuuNfviCQ

Unbridled joy and prizes every day! Light the wick, start the fireworks, and make your way to any Tier X vehicle with ease!

[h1]Attention: individual start![/h1]

When entering the game for the first time from August 23 to September 11, you'll join the main phase where you'll be able to earn a special currency and use it to complete the in-game event stages. If you enter the game for the first time before August 28, this phase will last 14 days, or less if you join later.

[quote]To compete the whole in-game event, start before August 28.[/quote]

When the main phase is over, you'll have 3 more days to complete the remaining stages, only using in-game gold.

[list]
[*]CIS : individual start from August 23, 12:00 (MSK) to September 11, 12:00 (MSK). The event ends at 12:00 (MSK) on September 14. 
[*]Asia : individual start from 17:00 (UTC+8) on August 23, to 17:00 (UTC+8) on September 11. The event ends at 17:00 (UTC+8) on September 14. 
[*]North America : individual start from 02:00 (PT), 05:00 (ET) on August 23 to 02:00 (PT), 05:00 (ET) on September 11. The event ends at 2:00 (PT), 5:00 (ET) on September 14. 
[*]Europe : individual start from 11:00 (CEST) on August 23 to 11:00 (CEST) on September 11. The event ends at 11:00 (CEST) on September 14. 
[/list]

[h1]Light it up to Tier X![/h1]

By clicking Take it easy! in the Garage you'll see a series of tasks... You do like pyrotechnics, don't you? The wick is smoldering already but it lacks the fireworks: to be on the safe side, the security team hid them in the warehouse and gives them out daily, one at a time, with signature confirmation, and upon demonstration of a recent combat achievement certificate.

[quote]The wick connects 14 stages, which can be unlocked using Fireworks—one for each stage. The Fireworks are handed out once a day as a reward for your first victory. Score one victory a day for two weeks and you'll complete all stages! It couldn't be easier![/quote]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/2095f22ef752260cd121572ba6ca3f0e3f266f75.jpg[/img]

After completing all stages, you'll receive: 

[list]
[*]A rare certificate for researching Tier VI vehicles (50% less XP). 
[*]A rare certificate for researching Tier VII vehicles (50% less XP). 
[*]A rare certificate for researching Tier VIII vehicles (50% less XP). 
[*]A rare certificate for researching Tier IX vehicles (50% less XP). 
[*]A rare certificate for researching Tier X vehicles (50% less XP). 
[*]4 certificates for 24 hours of Premium Account. 
[*]20 Epic Credit boosters.
[*]15 Epic Combat XP boosters.
[*]50 Rare Crew XP boosters.
[*]40 Rare Cooldown boosters. 
[*]40 Rare Free XP boosters. 
[*]30 Rare Credit boosters. 
[*]20 Rare Combat XP boosters. 
[/list]

[h1]Certificates for vehicle research[/h1]

It's a new type of in-game item that will speed up the research process for the vehicles you find most appealing.

[list]
[*]The research certificate in your Storage activates your XP discount for researching vehicles of a certain tier.
[*]When researching a vehicle, you may choose to apply or save the discount. This is convenient if you want to spend it on another vehicle. 
[*]The discount can be applied only to experience required for researching the vehicle. It doesn't apply to intermediary modules. 
[/list]

Score at least one victory per day, use certificates, and unlock the vehicles you've always wanted—just take it easy!

notes.title: Update 5.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/659055022f231e30540fb4987835d7c6a369276f.jpg[/img]

Commanders, get ready to hit the road! We are setting off for a top-secret military base in the mountains. On our way, we will update the game to version 5.2 to get access to the new features. There are many useful things among them, but we recommend you pay special attention to ribbons: they promptly inform you about your successful actions during the battle. And don’t forget to check the list of improved vehicles. You don't want any surprises when you least expect them, do you?

[quote]Update 5.2 will be released on August 22![/quote]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RAE4xN8fk20
[h1]Main Changes and New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/map-faust/]A new map was added—Faust[/url]: a military base located among snowy mountains. This map is available in Encounter battles and Supremacy mode for vehicles of Tier V and above.[/*]
[*]Ribbons—notifications of player's actions during the battle. Read [url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/ribbons/]this article[/url] to find out more about ribbon mechanics and grades.[/*]
[*][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/rating-battles-efficiency/]Conditions for earning rating points[/url] were changed in rating battles. Now, a change of the player's rating depends on their battle effectiveness.[/*]
[*]The Precision Fire skill is now accompanied by a sound, which plays upon the third successful shot and when the skill is activated.[/*]
[*]A column showing the date of the player's latest battle was added to clan statistics.[/*]
[*]The amounts of inflicted and blocked damage are now displayed in replays.[/*]
[*]Training rooms become available after the player gets a vehicle of Tier V or above or receives an invite to a training room.[/*]
[*]Тренировочные комнаты теперь становятся доступны после появления в Ангаре техники не ниже V уровня или при приглашении в тренировочную комнату.[/*]
[*]The American Eagle rare attachment is now available for the T23E3, T34, T26E4 SuperPershing, and M48A1 Patton. Cost: from 2,500 to 4,000 gold depending on the vehicle tier.[/*]

notes.title: The French Legionnaire
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/2ce1754e6c94aa8734364e9334c28a3b3cbecf92.jpg[/img]

A new French Premium tank with roots in America enters the fight! Lead the M4A1 Revalorisé into battle and rip apart enemy vehicles with its precise, hard-hitting gun to earn impressive amounts of credits in every fight!

[quote]Until August 31, the “French Legionnaire” bundle with the Premium M4A1 Revalorisé is available in the game store. All nine of the equipment slots are open, so you can fight with maximum efficiency![/quote]

[h1]Upgraded Sherman[/h1]

Why’s this “Sherman” at Tier VIII, when all his American counterparts are Tiers V-VI? Well, the colossal firepower that the French engineers gave the M4A1 when upgrading it is why.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/71ee0a551e4776f27a67f1aebce01936a5878c46.jpg[/img]

The armor of the French medium is nothing more than a formality, but this isn’t something new to French enthusiasts. The armor won’t stop many shots and you can only counter this by keeping alert and on the move. Luckily, you have a powerful engine to help you with this—the tank can quickly accelerate and maneuver to dodge shells.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/5e2b2f3249f5fa7ce6960e04feef53e7e78923bd.jpg[/img]

The main feature of the M4A1 Revalorisé is its magnificent firepower. Its gun rarely fires, but is effective and damaging when it does: 310 damage per shot with 200 mm of armor penetration. For thicker armored opponents, the arsenal of M4A1 holds shells that are able to break through 250 mm with an average damage of 260.

Experienced commanders will appreciate the additional advantage of the gun—a 10-degree angle of depression. For this medium, it’s very useful when hiding behind terrain as it gives an extra level of protection from enemy shells.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/d296e4843b8eadfc9f9ad56258cbbaf970403c01.jpg[/img]

The role of the M4A1 Revalorisé in battle is fire support for more solid medium tanks or “heavies”, drawing damage from the flanks. Avoid close combat at all times and deal damage from afar. Choose your route so there’re always allies or cover nearby for when you need to reload.

With great power comes great responsibility: leave the brawling to the others, you need to utilize your alpha effectively. Taking this tank into battle isn’t an easy ride, but when mastered, it will reward you with great amounts of credits and excellent battle results.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/44f82e8678983cbd9c23d945d7cbe46de9733193.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/faff156c2a485d58fed433cb9ade21f78ac93f45.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494313/c0697f0e540ba4747fad3fbfdf7d40d860ce867f.jpg[/img]
